// ---------------------------------------------------------------- JC-LAZO-THEME-1009-001
// LIGHT AND DARK. Every colour that sits on a surface goes through one of three calls:
// _lzFg (text and icons), _lzBg (cards, sheets, fields, the canvas), _lzLine (borders and the
// gold hairline). In light mode they return the colour untouched - the dashboard you know.
// In dark mode (mission control) surfaces become plum-black glass, dark text becomes ivory,
// and gold, plum buttons and accents stay. The mode is 'system' | 'light' | 'dark' in
// SharedPreferences lazo_theme, shared by the couple and vendor dashboards.
bool _lzDark = false;
String _lzThemePref = 'system';
const Color _lzSurface = Color(0xFF1E1023); // dark card glass
const Color _lzCanvas = Color(0xFF140A17); // dark canvas
const Color _lzText = Color(0xFFF3ECE5);
const Color _lzMuted = Color(0xFFB7AABF);

Color _lzFg(Color c) {
  if (!_lzDark) return c;
  final int v = c.value & 0x00FFFFFF;
  if (v == 0x241E2B || v == 0x000000 || v == 0x141414) return _lzText.withOpacity(c.opacity);
  if (v == 0x6B5F72 || v == 0x8A7D90 || v == 0x8A7F90 || v == 0x5C5262) return _lzMuted.withOpacity(c.opacity);
  if (v == 0x52284F || v == 0x3D1C3B || v == 0x4A2147 || v == 0x6A3A66) return const Color(0xFFE2C6DE).withOpacity(c.opacity);
  final HSLColor h = HSLColor.fromColor(c);
  if (h.lightness >= 0.5) return c;
  return h.withLightness(0.74).withSaturation(h.saturation.clamp(0.0, 0.55)).toColor();
}

Color _lzBg(Color c) {
  if (!_lzDark) return c;
  final int v = c.value & 0x00FFFFFF;
  final double a = c.opacity;
  if (v == 0xFAF6F0) return (a > .97 ? _lzCanvas : _lzSurface).withOpacity(a);
  if (v == 0xFFFDF9 || v == 0xFFFFFF || v == 0xFFFDF8) return _lzSurface.withOpacity(a);
  final HSLColor h = HSLColor.fromColor(c);
  if (h.lightness <= 0.75) return c;
  // a tinted light surface (pale gold, pale red, pale green ...) keeps a whisper of its hue
  return Color.lerp(_lzSurface, h.withLightness(0.5).toColor(), 0.12)!.withOpacity(a);
}

Color _lzLine(Color c) {
  if (!_lzDark) return c;
  final HSLColor h = HSLColor.fromColor(c);
  if (h.lightness <= 0.75) return c;
  if ((c.value & 0x00FFFFFF) == 0xFFFFFF) return Colors.white.withOpacity(c.opacity * .14);
  return const Color(0xFFD9B77C).withOpacity(.26 * c.opacity);
}

Color? _lzFgN(Color? c) => c == null ? null : _lzFg(c);
Color? _lzBgN(Color? c) => c == null ? null : _lzBg(c);
Color? _lzLineN(Color? c) => c == null ? null : _lzLine(c);

bool _lzResolveDark(BuildContext context) {
  if (_lzThemePref == 'dark') return true;
  if (_lzThemePref == 'light') return false;
  return MediaQuery.platformBrightnessOf(context) == Brightness.dark;
}

// JC-LAZO-THEME-1009-001: the Appearance control - three segments, gold on the chosen one.
Widget _lzThemePicker(void Function(String) onPick) {
  Widget seg(String v, IconData icon, String label) {
    final bool on = _lzThemePref == v;
    return Expanded(
      child: GestureDetector(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onTap: () => onPick(v),
        child: AnimatedContainer(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
          curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
          height: 40,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: on ? const Color(0xFFD9B77C) : Colors.transparent,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
          ),
          child: Row(mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center, children: <Widget>[
            Icon(icon, size: 16, color: on ? const Color(0xFF3D1C3B) : _lzFg(const Color(0xFF6B5F72))),
            const SizedBox(width: 6),
            Text(label,
                style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 13,
                    fontWeight: on ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w600,
                    color: on ? const Color(0xFF3D1C3B) : _lzFg(const Color(0xFF6B5F72)))),
          ]),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  return Container(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
    decoration: BoxDecoration(
      color: _lzBg(const Color(0xFFFAF6F0)).withOpacity(_lzDark ? 1 : .9),
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
      border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(const Color(0xFFE6D6B8))),
    ),
    child: Row(children: <Widget>[
      seg('light', Icons.light_mode_rounded, 'Light'),
      seg('dark', Icons.dark_mode_rounded, 'Dark'),
      seg('system', Icons.brightness_auto_rounded, 'Auto'),
    ]),
  );
}

  // ---------------- v131: FOLDABLE CARDS ----------------
  // The big cards on the hub fold to a one-line row that still carries the
  // headline, so a folded card keeps earning its row. What is folded lives on
  // the couple doc (layout.collapsed) and follows them across devices. The
  // hero, the desk tiles and the June bar are structure and never fold.
  Set<String> _folded = <String>{};
  String _foldsSynced = '';

  void _syncFolds(Map<String, dynamic> d) {
    final Map<String, dynamic> lay = d['layout'] is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(d['layout'] as Map)
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    final List<String> l = ((lay['collapsed'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[])
        .map((dynamic e) => e.toString())
        .toList()
      ..sort();
    final String sig = l.join(',');
    if (sig == _foldsSynced) return;
    _foldsSynced = sig;
    _folded = l.toSet();
  }

  Future<void> _toggleFold(String k) async {
    setState(() {
      if (!_folded.remove(k)) _folded.add(k);
      _foldsSynced = (_folded.toList()..sort()).join(',');
    });
    try {
      await _coupleRef.set(<String, dynamic>{
        'layout': <String, dynamic>{'collapsed': _folded.toList()}
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO fold: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Widget _foldBtn(String k, {bool onDark = false}) {
    final bool folded = _folded.contains(k);
    return Tooltip(
      message: folded ? 'Unfold' : 'Fold',
      child: _Press(
        scale: .88,
        tick: _Tick.select,
        onTap: () => _toggleFold(k),
        child: Container(
          width: 26,
          height: 26,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            shape: BoxShape.circle,
            color: _lzBg(onDark ? ivory.withOpacity(.14) : plum.withOpacity(.05)),
            border:
                Border.all(color: _lzLine(onDark ? ivory.withOpacity(.3) : goldLine)),
          ),
          child: Icon(
              folded ? Icons.expand_more_rounded : Icons.expand_less_rounded,
              size: 16,
              color: _lzFg(onDark ? ivory : muted)),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // The card, or its folded row. `gap` matches the spacing the card carries
  // beneath itself.
  Widget _fold(String k, String title, String? summary, Widget card,
      {double gap = 0}) {
    final bool folded = _folded.contains(k);
    Widget child;
    if (!folded) {
      child = card;
    } else if (summary == null) {
      child = const SizedBox.shrink();
    } else {
      child = Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: gap),
        child: _Press(
          scale: .985,
          dim: .92,
          tick: _Tick.select,
          onTap: () => _toggleFold(k),
          child: _glass(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 11, 12, 11),
            child: Row(children: <Widget>[
              Text(title, style: _serif(size: 20, height: 1)),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(summary,
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: _lzFg(muted))),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              _foldBtn(k),
            ]),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
    return AnimatedSize(
      duration: Duration(milliseconds: _reducedMotion(context) ? 0 : 320),
      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
      alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
      child: KeyedSubtree(key: ValueKey<bool>(folded), child: child),
    );
  }

  // The one line the folded weather card keeps.
  String? _weatherFoldSummary(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    final String metro = (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString();
    if (metro.isEmpty || !kMetroLatLng.containsKey(metro)) {
      return 'Tell June your city';
    }
    final dynamic ts = couple['weddingDate'];
    final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
    final DateTime day =
        ts is Timestamp ? ts.toDate() : DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day);
    WidgetsBinding.instance
        .addPostFrameCallback((_) => _loadWeather(day, metro));
    final Map<String, dynamic>? w = _wxCache['${_ymd(day)}|$metro'];
    if (w == null) return 'Reading the sky\u2026';
    return '${w['hi']}\u00b0 \u00b7 ${_wmoLabel(w['code'] as int)} \u00b7 ${_metroLabel(metro)}';
  }

  bool _showImportCard(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    if (couple['importDismissedAt'] != null || couple['importedAt'] != null)
      return false;
    final dynamic c = couple['createdAt'] ?? couple['setupDoneAt'];
    if (c is Timestamp && DateTime.now().difference(c.toDate()).inDays > 21)
      return false;
    return true;
  }

  // -- CSV: a small RFC-4180 reader (quotes, commas in quotes, CRLF) --
  List<List<String>> _parseCsv(String text) {
    final List<List<String>> rows = <List<String>>[];
    List<String> row = <String>[];
    final StringBuffer cell = StringBuffer();
    bool inQ = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
      final String ch = text[i];
      if (inQ) {
        if (ch == '"') {
          if (i + 1 < text.length && text[i + 1] == '"') {
            cell.write('"');
            i++;
          } else {
            inQ = false;
          }
        } else {
          cell.write(ch);
        }
      } else if (ch == '"') {
        inQ = true;
      } else if (ch == ',') {
        row.add(cell.toString());
        cell.clear();
      } else if (ch == '\n' || ch == '\r') {
        if (ch == '\r' && i + 1 < text.length && text[i + 1] == '\n') i++;
        row.add(cell.toString());
        cell.clear();
        if (row.any((String c) => c.trim().isNotEmpty)) rows.add(row);
        row = <String>[];
      } else {
        cell.write(ch);
      }
    }
    row.add(cell.toString());
    if (row.any((String c) => c.trim().isNotEmpty)) rows.add(row);
    return rows;
  }

  int _colIndex(List<String> headers, List<String> wants) {
    for (final String w in wants) {
      for (int i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
        final String h =
            headers[i].toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9]'), '');
        if (h == w) return i;
      }
    }
    for (final String w in wants) {
      for (int i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
        final String h =
            headers[i].toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9]'), '');
        if (h.contains(w)) return i;
      }
    }
    return -1;
  }

  Future<void> _importGuestsCsv(BuildContext sheetCtx) async {
    final FilePickerResult? res = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
        type: FileType.custom,
        allowedExtensions: <String>['csv', 'txt', 'tsv'],
        withData: true);
    if (res == null || res.files.isEmpty || res.files.first.bytes == null)
      return;
    String text = String.fromCharCodes(res.files.first.bytes!);
    try {
      text = utf8.decode(res.files.first.bytes!, allowMalformed: true);
    } catch (_) {}
    if (text.contains('\t') && !text.contains(','))
      text = text.replaceAll('\t', ',');
    final List<List<String>> rows = _parseCsv(text);
    if (rows.length < 2) {
      _toast('That file has no guest rows.');
      return;
    }
    final List<String> h = rows.first;
    final int iFirst = _colIndex(h, <String>['firstname', 'first']);
    final int iLast = _colIndex(h, <String>['lastname', 'last', 'surname']);
    final int iName =
        _colIndex(h, <String>['guestname', 'fullname', 'name', 'guest']);
    final int iEmail = _colIndex(h, <String>['email', 'emailaddress']);
    final int iPhone = _colIndex(h, <String>['phone', 'mobile', 'cell']);
    final int iParty = _colIndex(
        h, <String>['partyname', 'party', 'household', 'group', 'family']);
    final int iRsvp = _colIndex(
        h, <String>['rsvpstatus', 'rsvp', 'attending', 'response', 'status']);
    final int iMeal =
        _colIndex(h, <String>['meal', 'mealchoice', 'entree', 'dinner']);
    final int iPlus = _colIndex(h, <String>[
      'plusones',
      'plusone',
      'additionalguests',
      'guests',
      'partysize'
    ]);
    final int iAddr =
        _colIndex(h, <String>['address', 'street', 'mailingaddress']);
    if (iName < 0 && iFirst < 0) {
      _toast(
          'Couldn\u2019t find a name column. Check the file has headers like First Name / Last Name.');
      return;
    }
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> guests = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    String cell(List<String> r, int i) =>
        (i >= 0 && i < r.length) ? r[i].trim() : '';
    int rsvpYes = 0;
    for (final List<String> r in rows.skip(1)) {
      // v139: Knot and Zola exports carry First / Last; a column that only
      // CONTAINS "name" (First Name) used to win and drop every surname
      String name = (iFirst >= 0 || iLast >= 0)
          ? ('${cell(r, iFirst)} ${cell(r, iLast)}').trim()
          : '';
      if (name.isEmpty && iName >= 0) name = cell(r, iName);
      if (name.isEmpty) continue;
      final String rsvpRaw = cell(r, iRsvp).toLowerCase();
      final String rsvp = rsvpRaw.contains('accept') ||
              rsvpRaw == 'yes' ||
              rsvpRaw.contains('attending') && !rsvpRaw.contains('not')
          ? 'yes'
          : (rsvpRaw.contains('decline') ||
                  rsvpRaw == 'no' ||
                  rsvpRaw.contains('not attending')
              ? 'no'
              : 'pending');
      if (rsvp == 'yes') rsvpYes++;
      int plus = 0;
      final String pRaw = cell(r, iPlus).toLowerCase();
      if (pRaw.isNotEmpty) {
        final int? n = int.tryParse(pRaw.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9]'), ''));
        if (n != null)
          plus = iPlus >= 0 && h[iPlus].toLowerCase().contains('size')
              ? (n - 1).clamp(0, 20)
              : n.clamp(0, 20);
        else if (pRaw == 'yes' || pRaw == 'true') plus = 1;
      }
      guests.add(<String, dynamic>{
        'name': name,
        'email': cell(r, iEmail),
        'phone': cell(r, iPhone),
        'party': cell(r, iParty),
        'rsvp': rsvp,
        'meal': cell(r, iMeal),
        'plusOnes': plus,
        'address': cell(r, iAddr),
        'source': 'import',
        'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });
    }
    if (guests.isEmpty) {
      _toast('No guests found in that file.');
      return;
    }
    final int parties = guests
        .map((Map<String, dynamic> g) => (g['party'] ?? '').toString())
        .where((String p) => p.isNotEmpty)
        .toSet()
        .length;
    final bool? ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext d) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
        title: Text('Found ${guests.length} guests', style: _serif(size: 24)),
        content: Text(
            '${guests.length} guest${guests.length == 1 ? '' : 's'}${parties > 0 ? ', $parties parties' : ''}${rsvpYes > 0 ? ', $rsvpYes already RSVP\u2019d yes' : ''}.\n\nFirst few: ${guests.take(4).map((Map<String, dynamic> g) => g['name']).join(', ')}${guests.length > 4 ? '\u2026' : ''}\n\nGuests already on your list are kept; anyone with the same name is skipped.',
            style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14, height: 1.45)),
        actions: <Widget>[
          TextButton(
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(d, false)),
              child:  Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted)))),
          FilledButton(
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: gold, foregroundColor: plumDeep),
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(d, true)),
              child: const Text('Add them')),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (ok != true) return;
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> existing =
          await _coupleRef.collection('guests').get();
      final Set<String> have = existing.docs
          .map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
              (d.data()['name'] ?? '').toString().trim().toLowerCase())
          .toSet();
      int added = 0;
      WriteBatch b = FirebaseFirestore.instance.batch();
      int inBatch = 0;
      for (final Map<String, dynamic> g in guests) {
        if (have.contains(g['name'].toString().toLowerCase())) continue;
        have.add(g['name'].toString().toLowerCase()); // v139: no dupes within the file
        b.set(_coupleRef.collection('guests').doc(), g);
        added++;
        inBatch++;
        if (inBatch >= 400) {
          await b.commit();
          b = FirebaseFirestore.instance.batch();
          inBatch = 0;
        }
      }
      if (inBatch > 0) await b.commit();
      await _coupleRef.set(
          <String, dynamic>{'importedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()},
          SetOptions(merge: true));
      _toast(
          '$added guest${added == 1 ? '' : 's'} added${added < guests.length ? ' (${guests.length - added} already on your list)' : ''}.');
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Could not import: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> _juneImport(Map<String, dynamic> args) async {
    try {
      final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable(
          'juneImport',
          options: HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: const Duration(seconds: 90)));
      final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> r = await fn.call(args);
      return Map<String, dynamic>.from(r.data as Map);
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      _toast(e.message ?? 'June couldn\u2019t read that.');
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('June couldn\u2019t read that: $e');
    }
    return null;
  }

  Future<String?> _askText(String title, String hint, {int lines = 6}) async {
    final TextEditingController c = TextEditingController();
    final bool? ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext d) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
        title: Text(title, style: _serif(size: 24)),
        content: SizedBox(
            width: 460,
            child: TextField(
                controller: c,
                minLines: lines,
                maxLines: lines + 6,
                autofocus: true,
                style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                decoration: _lightDeco('', hint: hint))),
        actions: <Widget>[
          TextButton(
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(d, false)),
              child:  Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted)))),
          FilledButton(
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: gold, foregroundColor: plumDeep),
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(d, true)),
              child: const Text('Read it')),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (ok != true) return null;
    return c.text.trim().isEmpty ? null : c.text.trim();
  }

      builder: (BuildContext d) => AlertDialog(

        title: Text(title, style: _serif(size: 24)),
        content: SizedBox(
            width: 460,
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
                child: Text(body,
                    style:  TextStyle(
                        color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 13.5, height: 1.5)))),
        actions: <Widget>[
          TextButton(
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(d, false)),
              child:  Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted)))),
          FilledButton(
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: gold, foregroundColor: plumDeep),
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(d, true)),
              child: Text(cta)),
        ],
      ),
    );
    return ok == true;
  }

  Future<void> _importWebsite(
      BuildContext sheetCtx, Map<String, dynamic> couple) async {
    final String? input = await _askText('Your current wedding website',
        'Paste the link (zola.com/wedding/\u2026, theknot.com/us/\u2026) or paste the page\u2019s text.',
        lines: 4);
    if (input == null) return;
    _toast('June is reading it\u2026');
    final Map<String, dynamic>? r =
        await _juneImport(<String, dynamic>{'kind': 'website', 'input': input});
    if (r == null) return;
    final Map<String, dynamic> site = r['site'] is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(r['site'] as Map)
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    final List<dynamic> regs =
        r['registryLinks'] is List ? r['registryLinks'] as List : <dynamic>[];
    final List<String> lines = <String>[];
    void add(String label, dynamic v) {
      if (v != null && v.toString().trim().isNotEmpty)
        lines.add(
            '$label: ${v.toString().trim().length > 140 ? v.toString().trim().substring(0, 140) + '\u2026' : v.toString().trim()}');
    }

    add('Names', site['names']);
    add('Date', site['dateIso']);
    add('Venue', site['venueName']);
    add('Address', site['venueAddress']);
    add('Ceremony', site['ceremonyTime']);
    add('Reception', site['receptionTime']);
    add('Dress code', site['dressCode']);
    add('Hotel block', site['hotelBlock']);
    add('Travel', site['travelNotes']);
    add('Story', site['story']);
    if (regs.isNotEmpty)
      lines
          .add('Registries: ${regs.length} link${regs.length == 1 ? '' : 's'}');
    if (lines.isEmpty) {
      _toast(
          'June couldn\u2019t find wedding details there. Try pasting the page text instead.');
      return;
    }
    if (!await _previewOk(
        'Here\u2019s what June found', lines.join('\n'), 'Use it')) return;
    try {
      final Map<String, dynamic> clean = <String, dynamic>{};
      for (final String k in <String>[
        'names',
        'story',
        'venueName',
        'venueAddress',
        'ceremonyTime',
        'cocktailTime',
        'receptionTime',
        'sendOffTime',
        'dressCode',
        'hotelBlock',
        'transport',
        'parking',
        'travelNotes',
        'dateIso',
        'dateDisplay'
      ]) {
        if ((site[k] ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty)
          clean[k] = site[k].toString().trim();
      }
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> q = await FirebaseFirestore
          .instance
          .collection('weddingSites')
          .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
          .limit(1)
          .get();
      if (q.docs.isNotEmpty) {
        await q.docs.first.reference.set(<String, dynamic>{
          ...clean,
          'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
        }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      } else {
        await _coupleRef.set(
            <String, dynamic>{'siteDraft': clean}, SetOptions(merge: true));
      }
      final Map<String, dynamic> cp = <String, dynamic>{
        'importedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
      };
      if ((clean['names'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty &&
          (couple['names'] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty)
        cp['names'] = clean['names'];
      if ((clean['dateIso'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty &&
          couple['weddingDate'] == null) {
        final DateTime? d = DateTime.tryParse(clean['dateIso'].toString());
        if (d != null) cp['weddingDate'] = Timestamp.fromDate(d);
      }
      await _coupleRef.set(cp, SetOptions(merge: true));
      if (regs.isNotEmpty) {
        final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> c = await _coupleRef.get();
        final List<Map<String, dynamic>> cur = <Map<String, dynamic>>[
          for (final dynamic e
              in (c.data()?['registryLinks'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[])
            if (e is Map) Map<String, dynamic>.from(e)
        ];
        for (final dynamic e in regs) {
          if (e is! Map) continue;
          final String url = (e['url'] ?? '').toString();
          if (!_urlOk(url) ||
              cur.any((Map<String, dynamic> l) => l['url'] == url)) continue;
          final List<String>? st = _storeFor(url);
          cur.add(<String, dynamic>{
            'label':
                (e['label'] ?? (st == null ? 'Registry' : st[1])).toString(),
            'url': url,
            'store': st == null ? '' : st[1]
          });
        }
        await _saveRegistry(cur);
      }
      _toast(q.docs.isNotEmpty
          ? 'Your Lazo website is updated.'
          : 'Saved. Open Website to pick a design - it\u2019s pre-filled.');
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Could not save: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _importBudget(BuildContext sheetCtx) async {
    final String? choice = await showDialog<String>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext d) => SimpleDialog(
        backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
        title: Text('Import a budget', style: _serif(size: 24)),
        children: <Widget>[
          SimpleDialogOption(
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(d, 'file')),
              child:  Text('Upload a spreadsheet or screenshot',
                  style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 15))),
          SimpleDialogOption(
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(d, 'text')),
              child:  Text('Paste the budget as text',
                  style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 15))),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (choice == null) return;
    final Map<String, dynamic> args = <String, dynamic>{'kind': 'budget'};
    if (choice == 'file') {
      final FilePickerResult? res = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
          type: FileType.custom,
          allowedExtensions: <String>[
            'csv',
            'txt',
            'png',
            'jpg',
            'jpeg',
            'webp'
          ],
          withData: true);
      if (res == null || res.files.isEmpty || res.files.first.bytes == null)
        return;
      final String ext = (res.files.first.extension ?? '').toLowerCase();
      if (ext == 'csv' || ext == 'txt') {
        args['input'] =
            utf8.decode(res.files.first.bytes!, allowMalformed: true);
      } else {
        if (res.files.first.bytes!.lengthInBytes > 4500 * 1024) {
          _toast('That image is too large - try a smaller screenshot.');
          return;
        }
        args['imageBase64'] = base64Encode(res.files.first.bytes!);
        args['imageType'] = ext == 'png'
            ? 'image/png'
            : (ext == 'webp' ? 'image/webp' : 'image/jpeg');
      }
    } else {
      final String? t = await _askText('Paste your budget',
          'Photographer 2,400 planned / 2,400 paid\nFlorist 1,500 planned\u2026',
          lines: 8);
      if (t == null) return;
      args['input'] = t;
    }
    _toast('June is reading it\u2026');
    final Map<String, dynamic>? r = await _juneImport(args);
    if (r == null) return;
    final List<dynamic> lines =
        r['lines'] is List ? r['lines'] as List : <dynamic>[];
    if (lines.isEmpty) {
      _toast('June couldn\u2019t find budget lines there.');
      return;
    }
    double total = 0;
    final List<String> show = <String>[];
    final Map<String, Map<String, num>> byCat = <String, Map<String, num>>{};
    for (final dynamic e in lines) {
      if (e is! Map) continue;
      final String slug = (e['category'] ?? '').toString();
      final num planned = e['planned'] is num ? e['planned'] as num : 0;
      final num paid = e['paid'] is num ? e['paid'] as num : 0;
      if (!kCategories.any((Map<String, String> c) => c['slug'] == slug))
        continue;
      final Map<String, num> cur =
          byCat.putIfAbsent(slug, () => <String, num>{'planned': 0, 'paid': 0});
      cur['planned'] = (cur['planned'] ?? 0) + planned;
      cur['paid'] = (cur['paid'] ?? 0) + paid;
      total += planned;
    }
    for (final MapEntry<String, Map<String, num>> en in byCat.entries) {
      show.add(
          '${_catLabel(en.key)}: ${_railMoney((en.value['planned'] ?? 0).toDouble())} planned${(en.value['paid'] ?? 0) > 0 ? ', ${_railMoney((en.value['paid'] ?? 0).toDouble())} paid' : ''}');
    }
    if (show.isEmpty) {
      _toast(
          'June found lines but couldn\u2019t match them to vendor categories.');
      return;
    }
    if (!await _previewOk(
        '${show.length} budget lines, ${_railMoney(total)} planned',
        show.join('\n'),
        'Use them')) return;
    try {
      final WriteBatch b = FirebaseFirestore.instance.batch();
      for (final MapEntry<String, Map<String, num>> en in byCat.entries) {
        b.set(
            _planRef.doc(en.key),
            <String, dynamic>{
              'budgetPlanned': en.value['planned'],
              if ((en.value['paid'] ?? 0) > 0) 'budgetActual': en.value['paid']
            },
            SetOptions(merge: true));
      }
      await b.commit();
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> c = await _coupleRef.get();
      final num curTotal =
          c.data()?['budgetTotal'] is num ? c.data()!['budgetTotal'] as num : 0;
      await _coupleRef.set(<String, dynamic>{
        if (curTotal <= 0 && total > 0) 'budgetTotal': total,
        'importedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      _toast('Budget imported.');
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Could not save: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _importVendors(
      BuildContext sheetCtx, Map<String, dynamic> couple) async {
    final String? t = await _askText('Vendors you\u2019ve already booked',
        'One per line. Name, what they do, and the amount if you know it:\nAtavia Weddings, photographer, \$2,400\nThe Farm at South Mountain, venue',
        lines: 7);
    if (t == null) return;
    _toast('June is reading it\u2026');
    final Map<String, dynamic>? r = await _juneImport(<String, dynamic>{
      'kind': 'vendors',
      'input': t,
      'metroId': (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString()
    });
    if (r == null) return;
    final List<dynamic> vs =
        r['vendors'] is List ? r['vendors'] as List : <dynamic>[];
    if (vs.isEmpty) {
      _toast('June couldn\u2019t find vendors there.');
      return;
    }
    final List<String> show = <String>[];
    for (final dynamic e in vs) {
      if (e is! Map) continue;
      show.add(
          '${e['name']} - ${_catLabel((e['category'] ?? '').toString())}${e['amount'] is num && (e['amount'] as num) > 0 ? ' - ${_railMoney((e['amount'] as num).toDouble())}' : ''}${(e['lazoVendorId'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty ? ' (on Lazo)' : ''}');
    }
    if (!await _previewOk(
        '${show.length} booked vendor${show.length == 1 ? '' : 's'}',
        show.join('\n'),
        'Add to my team')) return;
    try {
      final WriteBatch b = FirebaseFirestore.instance.batch();
      for (final dynamic e in vs) {
        if (e is! Map) continue;
        final String slug = (e['category'] ?? '').toString();
        if (!kCategories.any((Map<String, String> c) => c['slug'] == slug))
          continue;
        b.set(
            _planRef.doc(slug),
            <String, dynamic>{
              'status': 'booked',
              'vendorName': (e['name'] ?? '').toString(),
              if ((e['lazoVendorId'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty)
                'vendorId': e['lazoVendorId'].toString(),
              if (e['amount'] is num && (e['amount'] as num) > 0)
                'budgetActual': e['amount'],
              'bookedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
              'source': 'import',
            },
            SetOptions(merge: true));
      }
      await b.commit();
      await _coupleRef.set(
          <String, dynamic>{'importedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()},
          SetOptions(merge: true));
      _toast('Added to your vendor team.');
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Could not save: $e');
    }
  }

  // ---------------- v97: SAVED VENDORS ----------------
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _savedList(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> out = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    for (final dynamic e
        in (couple['savedVendors'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[]) {
      if (e is Map) out.add(Map<String, dynamic>.from(e));
    }
    return out;
  }

  bool _isSaved(Map<String, dynamic> couple, String placeId) =>
      _savedList(couple)
          .any((Map<String, dynamic> e) => e['placeId'] == placeId);

  Future<void> _toggleSave(Map<String, dynamic> v, {bool quiet = false}) async {
    final String pid = (v['placeId'] ?? '').toString();
    if (pid.isEmpty) return;
    final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> c = await _coupleRef.get();
    final Map<String, dynamic> couple = c.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> list = _savedList(couple);
    final bool already =
        list.any((Map<String, dynamic> e) => e['placeId'] == pid);
    if (already) {
      list.removeWhere((Map<String, dynamic> e) => e['placeId'] == pid);
    } else {
      final List<dynamic> cats =
          v['categories'] is List ? v['categories'] as List : const <dynamic>[];
      list.insert(0, <String, dynamic>{
        'placeId': pid,
        'name': (v['name'] ?? '').toString(),
        'category': cats.isEmpty ? '' : cats.first.toString(),
        'metroId': (v['metroId'] ?? '').toString(),
        'image': (v['coverUrl'] ??
                ((v['gallery'] is List && (v['gallery'] as List).isNotEmpty)
                    ? (v['gallery'] as List).first
                    : (v['logoUrl'] ?? '')))
            .toString(),
        'startingPrice': (v['startingPrice'] ?? '').toString(),
        'verified': v['verified'] == true,
        'savedAt': DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,
      });
    }
    await _coupleRef.set(
        <String, dynamic>{'savedVendors': list.take(60).toList()},
        SetOptions(merge: true));
    if (!quiet)
      _toast(already
          ? 'Removed from saved.'
          : 'Saved. It\u2019s on your home under Saved vendors.');
  }

  // A "Save" heart on a public vendor page sends ?save=<vendorId>; the auth
  // flow stashes it across signup.
  Future<void> _openPendingSave() async {
    if (_uid == null) return;
    String id = '';
    try {
      id = (Uri.base.queryParameters['save'] ?? '').trim();
    } catch (_) {}
    SharedPreferences? prefs;
    try {
      prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      if (id.isEmpty) id = (prefs.getString('lazo_pending_save') ?? '').trim();
    } catch (_) {}
    if (id.isEmpty) return;
    try {
      await prefs?.remove('lazo_pending_save');
    } catch (_) {}
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> vs =
          await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('vendors').doc(id).get();
      final Map<String, dynamic>? vd = vs.data();
      if (vd == null) return;
      final Map<String, dynamic> v = Map<String, dynamic>.from(vd);
      v['placeId'] = vs.id;
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> c = await _coupleRef.get();
      if (_isSaved(c.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{}, vs.id)) return;
      await _toggleSave(v, quiet: true);
      _toast(
          '${v['name'] ?? 'That vendor'} is saved - it\u2019s on your home.');
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO pending save: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Widget _savedCard(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> saved = _savedList(couple);
    if (saved.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();

                    SizedBox(

  // v144: the meetlazo.com/welcome/<hook>/ landing pages (the Meta ad funnels)
  // send ?from=welcome-<page>&intent=<yes|website|budget|import>&names=&date=
  // &metro=&design=&source=&guests= (+ utm_*). Names, date and city land on the
  // couple doc when it has none, first-touch attribution is kept once on
  // couples.acq, and the intent opens the screen the ad promised. URL first;
  // else the JSON the auth flow stashed in SharedPreferences
  // 'lazo_pending_welcome' (goNamed drops the query string).
  Future<void> _openPendingWelcome() async {
    if (_uid == null) return;
    Map<String, String> p = <String, String>{};
    try {
      final Map<String, String> q = Uri.base.queryParameters;
      final bool ours = (q['from'] ?? '').startsWith('welcome') ||
          (q['intent'] ?? '').isNotEmpty ||
          (q['names'] ?? '').isNotEmpty ||
          (q['date'] ?? '').isNotEmpty;
      if (ours) p = Map<String, String>.from(q);
    } catch (_) {}
    SharedPreferences? prefs;
    try {
      prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      if (p.isEmpty) {
        final String raw = prefs.getString('lazo_pending_welcome') ?? '';
        if (raw.isNotEmpty) {
          final dynamic j = jsonDecode(raw);
          if (j is Map) {
            p = j.map((dynamic k, dynamic v) =>
                MapEntry<String, String>(k.toString(), (v ?? '').toString()));
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    if (p.isEmpty) return;
    try {
      await prefs?.remove('lazo_pending_welcome');
    } catch (_) {}
    final String from = (p['from'] ?? '').trim();
    final String intent = (p['intent'] ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    final String names = (p['names'] ?? '').trim();
    final String dateS = (p['date'] ?? '').trim();
    final String metro =
        (p['metro'] ?? p['metroId'] ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    final String design =
        (p['design'] ?? p['template'] ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    final String source = (p['source'] ?? '').trim();
    final int? guests = int.tryParse((p['guests'] ?? '').trim());
    try {
      // let _loadCoupleId land first so a partner's shared plan is the target
      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 600));
      if (!mounted) return;
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> c = await _coupleRef.get();
      final Map<String, dynamic> couple = c.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
      final Map<String, dynamic> up = <String, dynamic>{};
      if (names.isNotEmpty &&
          names.length <= 80 &&
          (couple['names'] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty) {
        up['names'] = names;
      }
      if (dateS.isNotEmpty && couple['weddingDate'] == null) {
        final DateTime? d = DateTime.tryParse(dateS);
        if (d != null && d.year >= 2024 && d.year <= 2040) {
          up['weddingDate'] = Timestamp.fromDate(d);
        }
      }
      if (metro.isNotEmpty &&
          (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty &&
          kMetros.any((Map<String, String> m) => m['id'] == metro)) {
        up['metroId'] = metro;
      }
      if (guests != null &&
          guests > 0 &&
          guests <= 2000 &&
          couple['guestEstimate'] == null) {
        up['guestEstimate'] = guests;
      }
      if (couple['acq'] == null && (from.isNotEmpty || intent.isNotEmpty)) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> acq = <String, dynamic>{
          'from': from,
          'intent': intent,
          if (source.isNotEmpty) 'source': source,
          'at': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        };
        for (final String k in <String>[
          'utm_source',
          'utm_medium',
          'utm_campaign',
          'utm_content',
          'utm_term',
          'fbclid'
        ]) {
          final String v = (p[k] ?? '').trim();
          if (v.isNotEmpty) acq[k] = v.length > 200 ? v.substring(0, 200) : v;
        }
        up['acq'] = acq;
      }
      if (up.isNotEmpty) {
        up['updatedAt'] = FieldValue.serverTimestamp();
        await _coupleRef.set(up, SetOptions(merge: true));
      }
      final Map<String, dynamic> merged = <String, dynamic>{...couple, ...up};
      // give the shell a frame to mount, like the other handlers
      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 500));
      if (!mounted) return;
      switch (intent) {
        case 'website':
          if (design.isNotEmpty) {
            try {
              await prefs?.setString('lazo_pending_template', design);
            } catch (_) {}
            await _openPendingTemplate(); // v96 path: opens the editor on it
          } else {
            setState(() => _view = _View.website);
          }
          break;
        case 'budget':
          Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan =
              <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
          try {
            final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> ps = await _planRef.get();
            plan = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{
              for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d
                  in ps.docs)
                d.id: d.data()
            };
          } catch (_) {}
          if (!mounted) return;
          await _budgetSheet(merged, plan);
          break;
        case 'import':
          await _importSheet(merged);
          break;
        default:
          final bool missing = (merged['names'] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty ||
              merged['weddingDate'] == null ||
              (merged['metroId'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty;
          if (missing) {
            await _setupSheet(merged);
          } else if (up.isNotEmpty) {
            _toast('Welcome. Your date and city are in - here’s your plan.');
          }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO pending welcome: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  // v96: they chose a design on meetlazo.com/wedding-websites ("Use Sage").
  // The auth flow stashes it; if they have no site yet, open the editor on
  // that design so the first thing they see is the site they came for.
  Future<void> _openPendingTemplate() async {
    if (_uid == null) return;
    String tpl = '';
    String pal = '';
    try {
      tpl = (Uri.base.queryParameters['template'] ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
      pal = (Uri.base.queryParameters['palette'] ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    } catch (_) {}
    SharedPreferences? prefs;
    try {
      prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      if (tpl.isEmpty)
        tpl = (prefs.getString('lazo_pending_template') ?? '')
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase();
      if (pal.isEmpty)
        pal = (prefs.getString('lazo_pending_palette') ?? '')
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase();
    } catch (_) {}
    if (tpl.isEmpty) return;
    try {
      await prefs?.remove('lazo_pending_template');
      await prefs?.remove('lazo_pending_palette');
    } catch (_) {}
    const List<String> known = <String>[
      'sage',
      'noir',
      'dune',
      'fete',
      'tide',
      'flora',
      'atelier',
      'verona',
      'shore',
      'summit',
      'ranch',
      'starlit',
      'frost',
      'harvest',
      'aquarelle',
      'prism',
      'meadow',
      'gilded',
      'marigold',
      'papel',
      'peony'
    ];
    if (!known.contains(tpl)) return;
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> q = await FirebaseFirestore
          .instance
          .collection('weddingSites')
          .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
          .limit(1)
          .get();
      if (q.docs.isNotEmpty)
        return; // they already have a site; don't override it
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> c = await _coupleRef.get();
      final Map<String, dynamic> couple = c.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 700));
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _pendingTemplate = tpl;
        _pendingPalette = pal;
        _view = _View.website;
      });
      final String defNames = (couple['names'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      _editWebsite(couple, null, defNames);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO pending template: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  // v93: the reason they signed up was a vendor. Open that conversation
  // before they have to find it again. The auth flow stashes ?vendor= in a
  // preference because goNamed drops the query string; a direct hit with
  // ?vendor= on this page works too.
  Future<void> _openPendingVendor() async {
    if (_uid == null) return;
    String vendorId = '';
    try {
      vendorId = (Uri.base.queryParameters['vendor'] ?? '').trim();
    } catch (_) {}
    SharedPreferences? prefs;
    try {
      prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      if (vendorId.isEmpty) {
        vendorId = (prefs.getString('lazo_pending_vendor') ?? '').trim();
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    if (vendorId.isEmpty) return;
    try {
      await prefs?.remove('lazo_pending_vendor');
    } catch (_) {}
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> vs = await FirebaseFirestore
          .instance
          .collection('vendors')
          .doc(vendorId)
          .get();
      final Map<String, dynamic>? vd = vs.data();
      if (vd == null || !mounted) return;
      final Map<String, dynamic> v = Map<String, dynamic>.from(vd);
      v['placeId'] = vs.id;
      // Give the shell a frame to mount, then open the composer.
      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 600));
      if (!mounted) return;
      _sendInquiry(v);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO pending vendor: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadCoupleId() async {
    if (_uid == null) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> u =
          await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('users').doc(_uid).get();
      final String cu = (u.data()?['coupleUid'] ?? '').toString();
      if (cu.isNotEmpty && cu != _uid && mounted) {
        setState(() => _coupleIdCache = cu);
        _ensureCoupleChime(cu);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO coupleId: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  // ---------------- v91: SHARED LIVE STREAMS ----------------
  // One Firestore listener per query, the same Stream object every build, and
  // the latest snapshot replayed to late subscribers - so a card that scrolls
  // back into view never draws an empty frame.
  Stream<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _liveQuery(
      String key, Query<Map<String, dynamic>> Function() build) {
    _Live<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>? l = _liveQ[key];
    if (l == null) {
      l = _Live<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(() => build().snapshots());
      _liveQ[key] = l;
    }
    return l.stream;
  }

  Stream<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _liveDoc(
      String key, DocumentReference<Map<String, dynamic>> Function() build) {
    _Live<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>? l = _liveD[key];
    if (l == null) {
      l = _Live<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
          () => build().snapshots());
      _liveD[key] = l;
    }
    return l.stream;
  }

  Stream<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _inqStream() {
    return _liveQuery(
        'inq:$_cid',
        () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
            .collection('inquiries')
            .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid));
  }

  QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? _inqLatest() =>
      _liveQ['inq:$_cid']?.latest;

  List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _inqList(
      AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
    return (s.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[])
        .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
            (d.data()['status'] ?? '') != 'flagged')
        .toList();
  }

  // ---------------- v91: TYPE + SMALL HELPERS ----------------
  Widget _glyphSwitch(Widget child) => AnimatedSwitcher(
        duration: Duration(milliseconds: _reducedMotion(context) ? 0 : 160),
        switchInCurve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
        switchOutCurve: Curves.easeIn,
        transitionBuilder: (Widget w, Animation<double> a) => ScaleTransition(
            scale: Tween<double>(begin: .7, end: 1).animate(a),
            child: FadeTransition(opacity: a, child: w)),
        child: child,
      );

  TextStyle _serif(
      {double size = 24,
      FontWeight weight = FontWeight.w600,
      Color? color,
      double height = 1.05}) {
    // v130: display sizes tighten as they grow; body stays at 0.
    final double track = size >= 26 ? -0.015 * size : 0;
    try {
      return GoogleFonts.cormorantGaramond(
          fontSize: size,
          fontWeight: weight,
          color: (color ?? _lzFg(plum)),
          height: height,
          letterSpacing: track,
          fontFeatures: const <FontFeature>[FontFeature.liningFigures()]);
    } catch (_) {
      return TextStyle(
          fontFamily: 'serif',
          fontSize: size,
          fontWeight: weight,
          color: (color ?? _lzFg(plum)),
          height: height,
          letterSpacing: track);
    }
  }

  // v130: screens slide in from the right and leave the way they came. The
  // hub - the thing underneath - only fades. A key that ends in ':root'
  // marks "underneath".
  Widget _viewSwitch(Widget child) {
    final bool reduced = _reducedMotion(context);
    return AnimatedSwitcher(
      duration: Duration(milliseconds: reduced ? 140 : 260),
      reverseDuration: Duration(milliseconds: reduced ? 140 : 200),
      switchInCurve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
      switchOutCurve: Curves.easeInCubic,
      layoutBuilder: (Widget? current, List<Widget> previous) => Stack(
        fit: StackFit.expand,
        children: <Widget>[...previous, if (current != null) current],
      ),
      transitionBuilder: (Widget c, Animation<double> a) {
        final Key? k = c.key;
        final bool root = k is ValueKey<String> && k.value.endsWith(':root');
        final Widget faded = FadeTransition(opacity: a, child: c);
        if (reduced || root) return faded;
        return SlideTransition(
          position: Tween<Offset>(begin: const Offset(.04, 0), end: Offset.zero)
              .animate(a),
          child: faded,
        );
      },
      child: child,
    );
  }

  Widget _screenKeyed(Widget screen) => KeyedSubtree(
      key: ValueKey<String>(
          _view == _View.hub ? 'hub:root' : 'view:${_view.name}'),
      child: screen);

  static const List<String> _kMo = <String>[
    'Jan',
    'Feb',
    'Mar',
    'Apr',
    'May',
    'Jun',
    'Jul',
    'Aug',
    'Sep',
    'Oct',
    'Nov',
    'Dec'
  ];
  static const List<String> _kMoLong = <String>[
    'January',
    'February',
    'March',
    'April',
    'May',
    'June',
    'July',
    'August',
    'September',
    'October',
    'November',
    'December'
  ];

  String _shortDate(DateTime d) => '${_kMo[d.month - 1]} ${d.day}';
  String _longDate(DateTime d) =>
      '${_kMoLong[d.month - 1]} ${d.day}, ${d.year}';

  String _initials(String name) {
    final List<String> parts = name
        .replaceAll('&', ' ')
        .split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
        .where((String w) => w.isNotEmpty && w.toLowerCase() != 'and')
        .toList();
    if (parts.isEmpty) return 'L';
    if (parts.length == 1) return parts.first[0].toUpperCase();
    return (parts[0][0] + parts[1][0]).toUpperCase();
  }

  String _ago(dynamic ts) {
    if (ts is! Timestamp) return '';
    final Duration d = DateTime.now().difference(ts.toDate());
    if (d.inMinutes < 1) return 'now';
    if (d.inMinutes < 60) return '${d.inMinutes}m';
    if (d.inHours < 24) return '${d.inHours}h';
    if (d.inDays < 7) return '${d.inDays}d';
    return _shortDate(ts.toDate());
  }

  String _catLabel(String slug) {
    for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
      if (c['slug'] == slug) return c['label'] ?? slug;
    }
    return slug;
  }

  String _metroLabel(String id) {
    for (final Map<String, String> m in kMetros) {
      if (m['id'] == id) return m['label'] ?? id;
    }
    return '';
  }

  // The month a category usually needs to be booked by, for this couple.
  DateTime? _dueFor(String slug, DateTime? wedding) {
    if (wedding == null) return null;
    final int lead = kLeadMonths[slug] ?? 6;
    return DateTime(wedding.year, wedding.month - lead, 1);
  }

  Widget _pill(String label, Color c, {bool solid = false}) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 3),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: _lzBg(solid ? c : c.withOpacity(.14)),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
        border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(c.withOpacity(solid ? 1 : .5))),
      ),
      child: Text(label,
          style: TextStyle(
              color: _lzFg(solid ? ivory : (c == gold ? const Color(0xFF8A6A2F) : c)),
              fontSize: 11,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
    );
  }

  void _toast(String message) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
      backgroundColor: plumDeep,
      behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
      content: Text(message, style: const TextStyle(color: ivory)),
    ));
  }

  // JC-LAZO-VIEWSWITCH-0917-001: the two dashboards each bounce the other
  // role on load, so a manual view switch leaves a short-lived flag that the
  // receiving guard consumes once. Kept in SharedPreferences because the two
  // widgets are separate files and cannot share a static; the two-minute
  // window means a stale flag can never strand a vendor on the couple side.
  static const String _kViewSwitchKey = 'lazo_view_switch_at';

  Future<void> _markViewSwitch() async {
    try {
      final SharedPreferences p = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await p.setInt(_kViewSwitchKey, DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<bool> _consumeViewSwitch() async {
    try {
      final SharedPreferences p = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final int t = p.getInt(_kViewSwitchKey) ?? 0;
      if (t <= 0) {
        return false;
      }
      await p.remove(_kViewSwitchKey);
      return DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch - t < 120000;
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _guardRole() async {
    if (_uid == null) {
      return;
    }
    // v146: a vendor on the couple side is in preview mode, with the bar and
    // the way back always on screen - nothing to bounce.
    if (_previewVendor != null) {
      return;
    }
    if (await _consumeViewSwitch()) {
      return; // v130: they asked to be here
    }
    try {
      final snap =
          await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('users').doc(_uid).get();
      final data = snap.data();
      if (data == null) {
        return;
      }
      final String role = data['role'] == null ? '' : data['role'].toString();
      if (role == 'vendor') {
        // v146: late discovery (seeding hadn't resolved yet): stay, in preview.
        if (_previewVendor == null) {
          final Map<String, dynamic>? pv = await _loadPreviewVendor();
          if (mounted) setState(() => _previewVendor = pv ?? <String, dynamic>{'name': 'Your business'});
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO role guard error: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  void _celebrate() {
    final rnd = math.Random();
    const colors = [
      Color(0xFFD9B77C),
      Color(0xFFC9A45C),
      Color(0xFFE8CFA0),
      Color(0xFF52284F),
      Color(0xFF6A3A66),
      Color(0xFFFAF6F0),
      Color(0xFFE8B4B8),
    ];
    final pieces = <_ConfettiPiece>[];
    for (int i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
      final bool ribbon = rnd.nextDouble() > 0.62;
      pieces.add(_ConfettiPiece(
        x: rnd.nextDouble(),
        startY: -0.08 - rnd.nextDouble() * 0.30,
        speed: 0.85 + rnd.nextDouble() * 0.55,
        size: ribbon ? 5 + rnd.nextDouble() * 4 : 7 + rnd.nextDouble() * 6,
        swayAmp: 0.015 + rnd.nextDouble() * 0.045,
        swayFreq: 1.6 + rnd.nextDouble() * 2.6,
        phase: rnd.nextDouble() * math.pi * 2,
        rotSpeed: (rnd.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 7,
        color: colors[rnd.nextInt(colors.length)],
        delay: rnd.nextDouble() * 0.34,
        span: 0.58 + rnd.nextDouble() * 0.42,
        ribbon: ribbon,
      ));
    }
    // v130: reduced motion skips the confetti; the banner and toast stay.
    if (_reducedMotion(context)) return;
    setState(() {
      _confetti = pieces;
      _confettiOn = true;
    });
    _confettiC.forward(from: 0);
  }

  void _toastC(String message) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
      backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
      behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
      content: Text(message,
          style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
    ));
  }

  // Agency, with forgiveness: the two delete buttons in this widget are
  // unlabelled x icons with no confirm step. A dialog on every tap would train
  // people to dismiss it, so the delete stays instant and becomes reversible.
  void _toastUndo(String message, Future<void> Function() undo) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
      ..hideCurrentSnackBar()
      ..showSnackBar(SnackBar(
        backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        duration: const Duration(seconds: 6),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
        content: Text(message,
            style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
        action: SnackBarAction(
          label: 'Undo',
          textColor: _lzFg(plum),
          onPressed: () async {
            try {
              await undo();
            } catch (_) {
              _toastC('Could not undo that.');
            }
          },
        ),
      ));
  }

  Future<void> _juneLoadHistory() async {
    if (_juneLoaded || _uid == null) {
      return;
    }
    _juneLoaded = true;
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> qs = await _coupleRef
          .collection('june')
          .orderBy('at', descending: true)
          .limit(30)
          .get();
      final List<Map<String, String>> hist = qs.docs.reversed
          .map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
              <String, String>{
                'role': (d.data()['role'] ?? 'user') as String,
                'content': (d.data()['content'] ?? '') as String,
              })
          .where((Map<String, String> mm) => (mm['content'] ?? '').isNotEmpty)
          .toList();
      if (hist.isNotEmpty && mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _juneMsgs
            ..clear()
            ..addAll(hist);
        });
        _juneScrollDown();
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  String _juneNavIntent(String text) {
    final String t = text.toLowerCase().trim();
    final RegExp lead = RegExp(
        r'^(open|go to|take me to|send me to|show me|bring up|navigate to|switch to|jump to)\s+(the |my |our )?');
    if (!lead.hasMatch(t)) return '';
    final String rest = t
        .replaceFirst(lead, '')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\b(tab|page|screen|section)\b'), '')
        .trim();
    for (final List<String> p in kJunePlaces) {
      for (final String alias in p[2].split('|')) {
        if (rest == alias ||
            rest.startsWith('$alias ') ||
            rest.endsWith(' $alias') ||
            rest == p[1].toLowerCase()) {
          return p[0];
        }
      }
    }
    return '';
  }

  void _juneGo(String key) {
    switch (key) {
      case 'home':
        setState(() => _view = _View.hub);
        break;
      case 'vendors':
        setState(() => _view = _View.vendors);
        break;
      case 'browse':
        _openBrowse();
        break;
      case 'messages':
        setState(() => _view = _View.messages);
        break;
      case 'dayof':
        setState(() => _view = _View.dayof);
        break;
      case 'guests':
        setState(() => _view = _View.guests);
        break;
      case 'seating':
        _openSeating();
        break;
      case 'music':
        _openMusic();
        break;
      case 'website':
        setState(() => _view = _View.website);
        break;
      case 'registry':
        setState(() => _view = _View.registry);
        break;
      case 'shopping':
        setState(() => _view = _View.shopping);
        break;
      case 'board':
        setState(() => _view = _View.board);
        break;
      case 'account':
        setState(() => _view = _View.account);
        break;
    }
  }

  String _junePlaceLabel(String key) {
    for (final List<String> p in kJunePlaces) {
      if (p[0] == key) return p[1];
    }
    return '';
  }

  Future<void> _juneSend() async {
    final String text = _juneC.text.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty || _juneBusy) {
      return;
    }
    // v113: "open music" doesn't need a model - it needs a page.
    final String go = _juneNavIntent(text);
    if (go.isNotEmpty) {
      setState(() {
        _juneMsgs.add(<String, String>{'role': 'user', 'content': text});
        _juneMsgs.add(<String, String>{
          'role': 'assistant',
          'content': 'Opening ${_junePlaceLabel(go)}. [[open:$go]]'
        });
        _juneC.clear();
      });
      _juneScrollDown();
      Future<void>.delayed(
          const Duration(milliseconds: 350), () => _juneGo(go));
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      _juneMsgs.add(<String, String>{'role': 'user', 'content': text});
      _juneC.clear();
      _juneBusy = true;
    });
    _juneScrollDown();
    try {
      final HttpsCallable fn =
          FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable('juneChat');
      final List<Map<String, String>> wire = <Map<String, String>>[
        <String, String>{'role': 'user', 'content': kJuneAppMap},
        <String, String>{'role': 'assistant', 'content': 'Understood.'},
        ..._juneMsgs,
      ];
      final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> res =
          await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{'messages': wire});
      final String reply = ((res.data as Map)['reply'] ?? '') as String;
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        _juneMsgs.add(<String, String>{'role': 'assistant', 'content': reply});
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        _juneMsgs.add(<String, String>{
          'role': 'assistant',
          'content': 'I lost my train of thought - try me again in a moment?'
        });
      });
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _juneBusy = false);
        _juneScrollDown();
      }
    }
  }

  // v113: light markdown (bold, bullets) and [[open:key]] buttons.
  Widget _juneRich(String raw, bool me) {
    final RegExp tok = RegExp(r'\[\[open:([a-z]+)\]\]');
    final List<String> opens =
        tok.allMatches(raw).map((RegExpMatch m) => m.group(1)!).toList();
    String text = raw.replaceAll(tok, '').trim();
    text = text.replaceAll(RegExp(r'^#{1,6}\s*', multiLine: true), '');
    text = text.replaceAll(RegExp(r'^\s*[-*]\s+', multiLine: true), '\u2022 ');
    final List<TextSpan> spans = <TextSpan>[];
    final RegExp bold = RegExp(r'\*\*(.+?)\*\*');
    int i = 0;
    for (final RegExpMatch m in bold.allMatches(text)) {
      if (m.start > i) spans.add(TextSpan(text: text.substring(i, m.start)));
      spans.add(TextSpan(
          text: m.group(1),
          style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)));
      i = m.end;
    }
    if (i < text.length) spans.add(TextSpan(text: text.substring(i)));
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: <Widget>[
        if (text.isNotEmpty)
          Text.rich(TextSpan(children: spans),
              style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 14, height: 1.45, color: _lzFg(me ? ivory : ink))),
        for (final String k in opens)
          if (_junePlaceLabel(k).isNotEmpty)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
              child: FilledButton.icon(
                style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: gold,
                    foregroundColor: plumDeep,
                    elevation: 0,
                    padding:
                        const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                    minimumSize: Size.zero,
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10))),
                onPressed: _h(() => _juneGo(k)),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_rounded, size: 15),
                label: Text('Open ${_junePlaceLabel(k)}',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
              ),
            ),
      ],
    );
  }

  void _juneScrollDown() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (_juneScroll.hasClients) {
        _juneScroll.animateTo(
          _juneScroll.position.maxScrollExtent,
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
          curve: Curves.easeOut,
        );
      }
    });
  }

  List<String> _siteGal = <String>[];
