                    controller: spentC,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                    style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink)),
                    decoration: _lightDeco('Spent \$')),
              ),
            ]),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, false)),
              child:  Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink)))),
          FilledButton(
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: gold, foregroundColor: plum),
            onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, true)),
            child: const Text('Save'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (ok != true) return;
    await _planRef.doc(slug).set({
      'vendorName': nameC.text.trim(),
      'budgetPlanned': double.tryParse(planC.text.trim()),
      'budgetActual': double.tryParse(spentC.text.trim()),
      'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      'updatedBy': _bdMe()[1], // v135: the last-change line on the budget card
    }, SetOptions(merge: true));
  }

  Future<void> _setWeddingDate(DateTime? current) async {
    final picked = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: current ?? DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 270)),
      // v139: after the wedding the picker asserted (initial before first)
      firstDate: (current != null && current.isBefore(DateTime.now()))
          ? current
          : DateTime.now(),
      lastDate: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 365 * 4)),
    );
    if (picked == null) return;
    await _coupleRef.set(
        {'weddingDate': Timestamp.fromDate(picked)}, SetOptions(merge: true));
  }

  void _openBrowse({String? category, String? metro}) {
    setState(() {
      if (category != null) _browseCat = category;
      if (metro != null) _browseMetro = metro;
      _view = _View.browse;
    });
    if (category != null) {
      _autoResearch(category);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _autoResearch(String slug) async {
    // Browsing a category IS researching it - the list listens, she doesn't file.
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d =
          await _planRef.doc(slug).get();
      final String st = (d.data()?['status'] ?? 'needed') as String;
      if (st == 'needed' || st.isEmpty) {
        await _planRef.doc(slug).set(<String, dynamic>{
          'status': 'researching',
          'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  // v139: the vendor's own category (their doc carries `categories`), so an
  // inquiry from name search, Saved or a deep link marks the right row
  String _vendorCat(Map<String, dynamic> v) {
    final Set<String> known =
        kCategories.map((Map<String, String> c) => c['slug'] ?? '').toSet();
    final dynamic cs = v['categories'];
    if (cs is List) {
      if (cs.map((dynamic e) => e.toString()).contains(_browseCat)) {
        return _browseCat;
      }
      for (final dynamic e in cs) {
        if (known.contains(e.toString())) {
          return e.toString();
        }
      }
    }
    final String one = (v['category'] ?? '').toString();
    if (known.contains(one)) {
      return one;
    }
    return _browseCat;
  }

  Future<void> _sendInquiry(Map<String, dynamic> v) async {
    final placeId = (v['placeId'] as String?) ?? '';
    final vendorName = (v['name'] as String?) ?? 'this vendor';
    if (placeId.isEmpty || _uid == null) return;
    // v146: a vendor looking around must never create a real inquiry
    if (_previewVendor != null) {
      _toast(
          'Preview mode: messaging vendors is off here. This is what a couple would see when they reach out to $vendorName.');
      return;
    }
    final String inqCat = _vendorCat(v);
    final coupleSnap = await _coupleRef.get();
    final couple = coupleSnap.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    if (!mounted) return;
    final msgC = TextEditingController(
        text:
            'Hi! We found you on Lazo and would love to hear about your availability and packages.');
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
        title: Text('Contact $vendorName',
            style:  TextStyle(
                color: _lzFg(plum), fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 17)),
        content: SizedBox(
          width: 400,
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              TextField(
                controller: msgC,
                maxLines: 4,
                style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                decoration: _lightDeco('Your message'),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              Row(children:  [
                Icon(Icons.verified_rounded, color: _lzFg(vGreen), size: 15),
                SizedBox(width: 6),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    'Sent as a verified couple with your date attached. Never sold, never shared.',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: _lzFg(muted)),
                  ),
                ),
              ]),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, false)),
              child:  Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink)))),
          FilledButton(
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: gold, foregroundColor: plum),
            onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, true), _Tick.medium),
            child: const Text('Send'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (ok != true) return;
    final ts = couple['weddingDate'];
    final Map<String, dynamic>? refBy =
        _pendingReferral != null && _pendingReferral!['vendorId'] == placeId
            ? <String, dynamic>{
                'vendorId': _pendingReferral!['fromVendorId'],
                'name': _pendingReferral!['fromVendorName']
              }
            : null;
    _pendingReferral = null;
    await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('inquiries').add({
      'coupleUid': _cid,
      'vendorId': placeId,
      'vendorName': vendorName,
      'message': msgC.text.trim(),
      'status': 'new',
      if (refBy != null) 'referredBy': refBy,
      'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      'structuredIntent': {
        'weddingDate': ts is Timestamp
            ? ts.toDate().toIso8601String().split('T').first
            : 'Date TBD',
        'metroId': _browseMetro,
        'category': inqCat,
      },
    });
    // The list listens: inquiring marks the category researching, with who
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> pd =
          await _planRef.doc(inqCat).get();
      final String pst = (pd.data()?['status'] ?? 'needed') as String;
      if (pst != 'booked' && pst != 'skipped') {
        await _planRef.doc(inqCat).set(<String, dynamic>{
          'status': 'researching',
          'vendorName': vendorName,
          'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    if (!mounted) return;
    final bool vUnclaimed = ((v['claimedBy'] ?? '') as String? ?? '').isEmpty;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
      backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
      duration: Duration(seconds: vUnclaimed ? 6 : 4),
      behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
      content: Text(
          vUnclaimed
              ? 'Sent \u2014 $vendorName hasn\u2019t joined Lazo yet, so we\u2019re letting them know a couple\u2019s waiting. Their phone & website are on their card meanwhile.'
              : 'Sent to $vendorName \uD83D\uDD17',
          style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
    ));
    _maybeAskPush();
  }

  // ---------------- v101: THE NOTIFICATION ASK ----------------
  // The OS prompt is one-shot: a No on first launch can never be taken back
  // from inside the app. So we never ask on landing, when nothing has
  // happened yet and there is no reason to say yes. We ask here, seconds
  // after she has messaged a vendor and genuinely wants to know when they
  // write back - and we ask ourselves first, so a No costs us nothing and
  // the next inquiry can ask again.
  // ---------------- v102: PUSH REGISTRATION, IN THE WIDGET ----------------
  // FlutterFlow only registers a token at startup, so granting permission
  // mid-session used to leave the device with no token until the next cold
  // launch. We do it here instead: ask, then fetch the token and write it in
  // FlutterFlow's own shape so its sender finds it.
  static const String kVapidKey =
      'BL9OflCUn1UyDwhFzdWQfsm_4yG5x7urzYbWGNvGhCbQgmsh5cNx-FX-VRRd4Q8dQpuWz04UG47Spu9VBj6CYdo';

  String get _pushDeviceType => kIsWeb
      ? 'web'
      : (defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.iOS ? 'ios' : 'android');

  Future<void> _writePushToken(String token) async {
    final String? uid = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.uid;
    if (uid == null || token.isEmpty) return;
    try {
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('users')
          .doc(uid)
          .collection('fcm_tokens')
          .doc(token)
          .set(<String, dynamic>{
        'fcm_token': token,
        'device_type': _pushDeviceType,
        'created_at': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO push token write: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  // Returns true only when permission was granted AND a token was written.
  Future<bool> _registerPush() async {
    try {
      final FirebaseMessaging fm = FirebaseMessaging.instance;
      final NotificationSettings st =
          await fm.requestPermission(alert: true, badge: true, sound: true);
      if (st.authorizationStatus != AuthorizationStatus.authorized &&
          st.authorizationStatus != AuthorizationStatus.provisional) {
        return false;
      }
      String? token;
      if (kIsWeb) {
        token = await fm.getToken(vapidKey: kVapidKey);
      } else {
        // iOS hands back the APNs token a beat after the grant; asking for
        // the FCM token before it lands throws.
        if (defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.iOS) {
          for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            final String? apns = await fm.getAPNSToken();
            if (apns != null && apns.isNotEmpty) break;
            await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 500));
          }
        }
        token = await fm.getToken();
      }
      if (token == null || token.isEmpty) return false;
      await _writePushToken(token);
      fm.onTokenRefresh.listen(_writePushToken);
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO push register: ' + e.toString());
      return false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _maybeAskPush({bool force = false}) async {
    if (_uid == null) return;
    if (!force) {
      try {
        final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> c = await _coupleRef.get();
        final Map<String, dynamic> d = c.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        // v139: per partner (pushAsk.{uid}); the plan-wide fields only count
        // for the creator, so a joining partner's devices register too
        Map<String, dynamic> mine = <String, dynamic>{};
        if (d['pushAsk'] is Map && (d['pushAsk'] as Map)[_uid] is Map) {
          mine = Map<String, dynamic>.from((d['pushAsk'] as Map)[_uid] as Map);
        } else if (_uid == _cid) {
          mine = <String, dynamic>{
            'answer': d['pushAskAnswer'],
            'at': d['pushAskedAt']
          };
        }
        if ((mine['answer'] ?? '') == 'yes') return;
        final dynamic asked = mine['at'];
        if (asked is Timestamp &&
            DateTime.now().difference(asked.toDate()).inDays < 30) return;
      } catch (_) {
        return;
      }
    }
    // Let the "Sent" confirmation land and be read before anything else
    // appears on top of it.
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 1400));
    if (!mounted) return;
    final bool? yes = await showModalBottomSheet<bool>(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
      isScrollControlled: true,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => SafeArea(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 20, 22, 22),
          child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                Row(children: <Widget>[
                  Container(
                    width: 38,
                    height: 38,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: plumDeep,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                    child: const Icon(Icons.notifications_active_rounded,
                        color: gold, size: 19),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  Expanded(
                      child: Text('Want a heads up when they write back?',
                          style: _serif(size: 23))),
                ]),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                 Text(
                    'Most vendors reply within a day or two. We\u2019ll let you know when one does - and for nothing else. No marketing, no reminders, no nudging you about your florist.',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: _lzFg(muted), height: 1.45)),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                SizedBox(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  child: FilledButton(
                    style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: gold,
                        foregroundColor: plumDeep,
                        elevation: 0,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 13)),
                    onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, true)),
                    child: const Text('Yes, let me know',
                        style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Center(
                  child: TextButton(
                    onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, false)),
                    child:  Text('Not now',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: _lzFg(muted), fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  ),
                ),
              ]),
        ),
      ),
    );
    if (yes != true) {
      await _stampPushAsk('no');
      return;
    }
    final bool ok = await _registerPush();
    // 'blocked' means they said yes to us and the OS said no - asking again
    // can't help, only a trip to system settings can.
    await _stampPushAsk(ok ? 'yes' : 'blocked');
    if (ok) _toast('Done - we\u2019ll let you know.');
  }

  Future<void> _stampPushAsk(String answer) async {
    try {
      await _coupleRef.set(<String, dynamic>{
        'pushAskedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'pushAskAnswer': answer,
        'pushAsk': <String, dynamic>{
          _uid!: <String, dynamic>{
            'answer': answer,
            'at': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
          }
        },
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO push ask stamp: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Future<void> _linkBooking(Map<String, dynamic> inq, String inquiryId) async {
    final intent =
        Map<String, dynamic>.from((inq['structuredIntent'] as Map?) ?? {});
    final slug = (intent['category'] as String?) ?? kCategories.first['slug']!;
    await _planRef.doc(slug).set({
      'status': 'booked',
      'vendorName': (inq['vendorName'] as String?) ?? '',
      'vendorId': (inq['vendorId'] as String?),
      'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    await _coupleRef.set({
      'linkedInquiries': FieldValue.arrayUnion([inquiryId]),
    }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    _celebrate();
  }

  // ---------------- v94: REGISTRY ----------------
  // A universal registry: links to wherever the registries live. Lazo never
  // hosts or marks one up. The site mirrors the list the moment it changes.
  static const List<List<String>> _kStores = <List<String>>[
    // host fragment, display name, brand color
    <String>['zola.com', 'Zola', '0xFF1A1A1A'],
    <String>['amazon.', 'Amazon', '0xFFFF9900'],
    <String>['target.com', 'Target', '0xFFCC0000'],
    <String>['crateandbarrel.com', 'Crate & Barrel', '0xFF222222'],
    <String>['williams-sonoma.com', 'Williams Sonoma', '0xFF2B2B2B'],
    <String>['potterybarn.com', 'Pottery Barn', '0xFF3B3B3B'],
    <String>['westelm.com', 'West Elm', '0xFF333333'],
    <String>['macys.com', "Macy's", '0xFFC8102E'],
    <String>['bloomingdales.com', "Bloomingdale's", '0xFF000000'],
    <String>['honeyfund.com', 'Honeyfund', '0xFFE8A33D'],
    <String>['theknot.com', 'The Knot', '0xFF0A5C5C'],
    <String>['myregistry.com', 'MyRegistry', '0xFF7A3F9C'],
    <String>['etsy.com', 'Etsy', '0xFFF1641E'],
    <String>['wayfair.com', 'Wayfair', '0xFF7B189F'],
    <String>['venmo.com', 'Venmo', '0xFF008CFF'],
    <String>['paypal.', 'PayPal', '0xFF003087'],
    <String>['cash.app', 'Cash App', '0xFF00D632'],
    <String>['airbnb.', 'Airbnb', '0xFFFF5A5F'],
    <String>['thingsremembered', 'Things Remembered', '0xFF8A6A2F'],
  ];

  // The store's own icon, fetched through our worker (meetlazo.com/icon/<host>,
  // which relays Google's favicon endpoint with the CORS header Flutter web
  // needs) - we never draw or alter a brand mark ourselves. Falls back to a
  // letter on a brand-colored tile if the icon can't be fetched.
  Widget _storeMark(String url, String fallbackLetter, Color color,
      {double size = 36}) {
    final String host = (Uri.tryParse(url)?.host ?? '').toLowerCase();
    final Widget letter = Container(
      width: size,
      height: size,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: _lzBg(color), borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(size * .28)),
      child: Center(
          child: Text(fallbackLetter,
              style: TextStyle(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                  fontSize: size * .42))),
    );
    if (host.isEmpty) return letter;
    return ClipRRect(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(size * .28),
      child: Container(
        width: size,
        height: size,
        color: _lzBg(Colors.white),
        padding: EdgeInsets.all(size * .14),
        child: Image.network(
          'https://meetlazo.com/icon/$host',
          width: size,
          height: size,
          fit: BoxFit.contain,
          errorBuilder: (BuildContext c, Object e, StackTrace? st) => letter,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  List<String>? _storeFor(String url) {
    final Uri? u = Uri.tryParse(url);
    final String host = (u?.host ?? url).toLowerCase();
    for (final List<String> st in _kStores) {
      if (host.contains(st[0])) return st;
    }
    return null;
  }

  bool _urlOk(String url) {
    final Uri? u = Uri.tryParse(url);
    return u != null &&
        (u.scheme == 'https' || u.scheme == 'http') &&
        u.host.contains('.');
  }

  // The wedding site shows the same list; keep it identical without waiting
  // for the next website save.
  Future<void> _syncRegistryToSite(
      List<Map<String, dynamic>> links, String note) async {
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> q = await FirebaseFirestore
          .instance
          .collection('weddingSites')
          .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
          .limit(1)
          .get();
      if (q.docs.isEmpty) return;
      await q.docs.first.reference.set(<String, dynamic>{
        'registryLinks': links,
        'registryNote': note,
        'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO registry sync: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Future<void> _saveRegistry(List<Map<String, dynamic>> links,
      {String? note}) async {
    final Map<String, dynamic> patch = <String, dynamic>{
      'registryLinks': links
    };
    if (note != null) patch['registryNote'] = note;
    await _coupleRef.set(patch, SetOptions(merge: true));
    String n = note ?? '';
    if (note == null) {
      try {
        final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> c = await _coupleRef.get();
        n = (c.data()?['registryNote'] ?? '').toString();
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    await _syncRegistryToSite(links, n);
  }

  Future<void> _addRegistryLink(List<Map<String, dynamic>> current,
      {String presetHost = '', String presetLabel = '', int editIndex = -1}) async {
    // v139: a tapped store icon prefills; editIndex >= 0 edits that row
    final Map<String, dynamic> ed =
        editIndex >= 0 && editIndex < current.length
            ? current[editIndex]
            : <String, dynamic>{};
    final TextEditingController labelC = TextEditingController(
        text: (ed['label'] ?? presetLabel).toString());
    final TextEditingController urlC = TextEditingController(
        text: (ed['url'] ?? (presetHost.isEmpty ? '' : 'https://$presetHost/'))
            .toString());
    String detected = '';
    String error = '';
    final bool? ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
          shape:
              RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
          title: Text('Add a registry', style: _serif(size: 24)),
          content: SizedBox(
            width: 440,
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                 Text(
                    'Paste the link guests would use. Any store, any fund - we recognize the big ones.',
                    style:
                        TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted), height: 1.4)),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: <Widget>[
                  for (final List<String> p in const <List<String>>[
                    <String>['Zola', 'https://www.zola.com/registry/'],
                    <String>['Amazon', 'https://www.amazon.com/wedding/'],
                    <String>['Target', 'https://www.target.com/gift-registry/'],
                    <String>['Honeymoon fund', 'https://www.honeyfund.com/'],
                    <String>['Venmo', 'https://venmo.com/u/'],
                  ])
                    ActionChip(
                      avatar: _storeMark(p[1], p[0][0], plum, size: 20),
                      label: Text(p[0],
                          style:  TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 12,
                              color: _lzFg(plum),
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                      backgroundColor: _lzBg(Colors.white),
                      side: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
                      onPressed: _h(() => setD(() {
                            urlC.text = p[1];
                            labelC.text = p[0] == 'Honeymoon fund'
                                ? 'Honeymoon fund'
                                : p[0];
                            detected = p[0];
                            error = '';
                          })),
                    ),
                ]),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextField(
                  controller: urlC,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.url,
                  autofocus: true,
                  style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14.5),
                  onChanged: (String v) {
                    final String u = v.trim().startsWith('http')
                        ? v.trim()
                        : 'https://${v.trim()}';
                    final List<String>? st = _storeFor(u);
                    setD(() {
                      detected = st == null ? '' : st[1];
                      if (st != null && labelC.text.trim().isEmpty)
                        labelC.text = st[1];
                      error = '';
                    });
                  },
                  decoration: _lightDeco('Registry link',
                          hint: 'https://www.zola.com/registry/yournames')
                      .copyWith(
                    suffixIcon: detected.isEmpty
                        ? null
                        : Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 10, top: 14),
                            child: Text(detected,
                                style:  TextStyle(
                                    color: _lzFg(vGreen),
                                    fontSize: 12,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                          ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextField(
                  controller: labelC,
                  style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14.5),
                  decoration: _lightDeco('Shown to guests as (optional)',
                      hint: 'Amazon, Our honeymoon fund\u2026'),
                ),
                if (error.isNotEmpty)
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
                    child: Text(error,
                        style:  TextStyle(
                            color: _lzFg(Color(0xFFB04343)), fontSize: 12.5)),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          actions: <Widget>[
            TextButton(
                onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx2, false)),
                child:  Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted)))),
            FilledButton(
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: gold, foregroundColor: plum),
              onPressed: _h(() {
                String url = urlC.text.trim();
                if (url.isEmpty) {
                  setD(() => error = 'Paste the registry link first.');
                  return;
                }
                if (!url.startsWith('http')) url = 'https://$url';
                if (!_urlOk(url)) {
                  setD(() =>
                      error = 'That doesn\u2019t look like a web address.');
                  return;
                }
                if (current.asMap().entries.any((MapEntry<int, Map<String, dynamic>> e) =>
                    e.key != editIndex &&
                    (e.value['url'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase() ==
                        url.toLowerCase())) {
                  setD(() => error = 'That link is already on your list.');
                  return;
                }
                urlC.text = url;
                Navigator.pop(ctx2, true);
              }),
              child: Text(editIndex >= 0 ? 'Save' : 'Add'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
    if (ok != true) return;
    final String url = urlC.text.trim();
    final List<String>? st = _storeFor(url);
    final String label = labelC.text.trim().isNotEmpty
        ? labelC.text.trim()
        : (st == null
            ? (Uri.tryParse(url)?.host ?? 'Registry').replaceFirst('www.', '')
            : st[1]);
    final Map<String, dynamic> row = <String, dynamic>{
      'label': label,
      'url': url,
      'store': st == null ? '' : st[1]
    };
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> next =
        List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(current);
    if (editIndex >= 0 && editIndex < next.length) {
      next[editIndex] = row; // v139: edit in place
    } else {
      next.add(row);
    }
    await _saveRegistry(next);
    _toast(editIndex >= 0
        ? 'Saved. Your website shows it now.'
        : 'Added. Your website shows it now.');
  }

  Future<void> _removeRegistryLink(
      List<Map<String, dynamic>> current, Map<String, dynamic> link) async {
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> restore =
        List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(current);
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> next = current
        .where((Map<String, dynamic> l) => l['url'] != link['url'])
        .toList();
    await _saveRegistry(next);
    final String label =
        (link['label'] ?? link['store'] ?? 'Registry link').toString();
    _toastUndo('Removed $label.', () => _saveRegistry(restore));
  }

  Future<void> _moveRegistryLink(
      List<Map<String, dynamic>> current, int from, int to) async {
    if (to < 0 || to >= current.length) return;
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> next =
        List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(current);
    final Map<String, dynamic> item = next.removeAt(from);
    next.insert(to, item);
    await _saveRegistry(next);
  }

  Future<void> _copyRegistryLink() async {
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> q = await FirebaseFirestore
          .instance
          .collection('weddingSites')
          .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
          .limit(1)
          .get();
      if (q.docs.isEmpty) {
        _toast('Make your wedding website first - the registry lives on it.');
        return;
      }
      final String url = 'https://meetlazo.com/w/${q.docs.first.id}/#registry';
      await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: url));
      _toast('Copied. That link goes on the invitation.');
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Could not copy: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openLink(String url) async {
    final uri = Uri.tryParse(url);
    if (uri != null && await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
      await launchUrl(uri,
          mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication, webOnlyWindowName: '_blank');
    }
  }

  // What the seating chart holds, read live from the same docs it writes.
  Widget _seatingCard(
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> guests) {
    return StreamBuilder<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _liveDoc(
          'seat:$_cid', () => _coupleRef.collection('seating').doc('main')),
      initialData: _liveD['seat:$_cid']?.latest,
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> d = s.data?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        final int tables =
            d['tables'] is List ? (d['tables'] as List).length : 0;
        int seated = 0;
        int coming = 0;
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> g in guests) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> m = g.data();
          if ((m['rsvp'] ?? '') == 'no') continue;
          coming++;
          if ((m['table'] ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty) seated++;
        }
        final bool started = tables > 0;
        final String headline =
            started ? '$seated of $coming seated' : 'Lay out your reception';
        final String sub = started
            ? '$tables table${tables == 1 ? '' : 's'} on the floor plan'
                '${coming - seated > 0 ? ' \u00b7 ${coming - seated} still to seat' : ' \u00b7 everyone has a seat'}'
            : 'Drop in tables, the dance floor and the bar, then drag guests to their seats. Send it to your planner when it\u2019s ready.';
        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
          child: _Press(
            scale: .985,
            dim: .92,
            onTap: _openSeating,
            child: _glass(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              radius: 20,
              tint: .6,
              borderColor: gold.withOpacity(.5),
              child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                Container(
                  width: 44,
                  height: 44,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    gradient:
                        const LinearGradient(colors: <Color>[plumDeep, plum]),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                  ),
                  child: const Icon(Icons.table_restaurant_rounded,
                      color: gold, size: 22),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        Text('Seating chart', style: _serif(size: 22)),
                        Text(headline,
                            style:  TextStyle(
                                color: _lzFg(ink),
                                fontSize: 14,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                        Text(sub,
                            style:  TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 12, color: _lzFg(muted), height: 1.35)),
                      ]),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                FilledButton(
                  style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: gold,
                      foregroundColor: plumDeep,
                      elevation: 0,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10))),
                  onPressed: _h(_openSeating),
                  child: Text(started ? 'Open' : 'Start',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                ),
              ]),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

            ? (sent['at'] is Timestamp
                ? 'Sent to ${(sent['vendorName'] ?? 'your DJ').toString()} \u00b7 ${_shortDate((sent['at'] as Timestamp).toDate())}'
                : 'Not sent to your DJ yet')
            : 'Search any song, hear the preview, and file it - the moments, your must-plays, the do-not-play list. Then send the whole plan to your DJ.';

  final Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> _wxCache =
      <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
  final Set<String> _wxLoading = <String>{};
  String _wxErr = '';
  String _wxSel = ''; // ymd of the date being shown ('' = wedding day)

  static const List<String> kKeyDateIdeas = <String>[
    'Engagement session',
    'Rehearsal dinner',
    'Welcome party',
    'Bridal shower',
    'Bachelor / bachelorette',
    'Day-after brunch',
    'Venue walkthrough',
    'Dress fitting',

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _keyDates(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    if (couple['keyDates'] is! List) return <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> out = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    for (final dynamic e in couple['keyDates'] as List) {
      if (e is Map &&
          e['date'] is Timestamp &&
          (e['label'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty) {
        out.add(Map<String, dynamic>.from(e));
      }
    }
    out.sort((Map<String, dynamic> a, Map<String, dynamic> b) =>
        (a['date'] as Timestamp).compareTo(b['date'] as Timestamp));
    return out;
  }

  Future<void> _addKeyDate(Map<String, dynamic> couple) async {
    final TextEditingController c = TextEditingController();
    DateTime? picked;
    String? chosen;
    final bool? ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx, StateSetter setD) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: _lzBg(cardBg),
          shape:
              RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
          title: Text('Add a date', style: _serif(size: 26)),
          content: SizedBox(
            width: 420,
            child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Wrap(
                    spacing: 6,
                    runSpacing: 6,
                    children: kKeyDateIdeas
                        .map((String i) => ActionChip(
                              label: Text(i,
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 12,
                                      color: _lzFg(chosen == i ? plumDeep : ivory),
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                              backgroundColor: _lzBg(chosen == i ? gold : plum),
                              surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
                              elevation: 0,
                              side: BorderSide(
                                  color:
                                      _lzLine(gold.withOpacity(chosen == i ? 1 : .6))),
                              onPressed: _h(() => setD(() {
                                    chosen = i;
                                    c.text = i;
                                  })),
                            ))
                        .toList(),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  TextField(
                    controller: c,
                    style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink)),
                    onChanged: (_) => setD(() => chosen = null),
                    decoration: _lightDeco('What is it?',
                        hint: 'Engagement session at the lake'),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  OutlinedButton.icon(
                    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                        foregroundColor: _lzFg(plum),
                        side:  BorderSide(color: _lzLine(goldLine))),
                    onPressed: _h(() async {
                      final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
                      final DateTime? d = await showDatePicker(
                        context: ctx,
                        initialDate: picked ?? now,
                        firstDate: DateTime(now.year - 1),
                        lastDate: DateTime(now.year + 3),
                      );
                      if (d != null) setD(() => picked = d);
                    }),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.event_rounded, size: 16),
                    label: Text(
                        picked == null ? 'Pick the day' : _longDate(picked!),
                        style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  ),
                ]),
          ),
          actions: <Widget>[
            TextButton(
                onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(false)),
                child:  Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted)))),
            FilledButton(
                style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: plum, foregroundColor: ivory),
                onPressed: _h((c.text.trim().isEmpty || picked == null)
                    ? null
                    : () => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(true)),
                child: const Text('Add')),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
    if (ok != true || picked == null) return;
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> list = _keyDates(couple)
      ..add(<String, dynamic>{
        'label': c.text.trim(),
        'date': Timestamp.fromDate(
            DateTime(picked!.year, picked!.month, picked!.day, 12))
      });
    try {
      await _coupleRef
          .set(<String, dynamic>{'keyDates': list}, SetOptions(merge: true));
      setState(() => _wxSel = _ymd(picked!));
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Could not save that date: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _removeKeyDate(
      Map<String, dynamic> couple, Map<String, dynamic> kd) async {
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> list = _keyDates(couple)
      ..removeWhere((Map<String, dynamic> e) =>
          e['label'] == kd['label'] &&
          (e['date'] as Timestamp).seconds ==
              (kd['date'] as Timestamp).seconds);
    try {
      await _coupleRef
          .set(<String, dynamic>{'keyDates': list}, SetOptions(merge: true));
      setState(() => _wxSel = '');
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Could not remove it: $e');
    }
  }

  static String _wmoLabel(int code) {
    if (code == 0) return 'Clear';
    if (code == 1) return 'Mostly sunny';
    if (code == 2) return 'Partly cloudy';
    if (code == 3) return 'Overcast';
    if (code == 45 || code == 48) return 'Foggy';
    if (code >= 51 && code <= 57) return 'Drizzle';
    if (code >= 61 && code <= 67) return 'Rain';
    if (code >= 71 && code <= 77) return 'Snow';
    if (code >= 80 && code <= 82) return 'Showers';
    if (code >= 85 && code <= 86) return 'Snow showers';
    if (code >= 95) return 'Thunderstorms';
    return 'Mixed';
  }

  static IconData _wmoIcon(int code) {
    if (code == 0 || code == 1) return Icons.wb_sunny_rounded;
    if (code == 2) return Icons.wb_cloudy_rounded;
    if (code == 3) return Icons.cloud_rounded;
    if (code == 45 || code == 48) return Icons.foggy;
    if (code >= 71 && code <= 86 && code != 80 && code != 81 && code != 82)
      return Icons.ac_unit_rounded;
    if (code >= 95) return Icons.thunderstorm_rounded;
    if (code >= 51) return Icons.water_drop_rounded;
    return Icons.wb_cloudy_rounded;
  }

  String _ymd(DateTime d) =>
      '${d.year}-${d.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${d.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';

  final Map<String, int> _wxFailAt = <String, int>{}; // v139

  Future<void> _loadWeather(DateTime wedding, String metro) async {
    final String key = '${_ymd(wedding)}|$metro';
    if (_wxCache.containsKey(key) || _wxLoading.contains(key)) return;
    // v139: after a failure, wait ten minutes instead of refetching on
    // every build
    final int? failed = _wxFailAt[key];
    if (failed != null &&
        DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch - failed < 600000) return;
    final List<double>? ll = kMetroLatLng[metro];
    if (ll == null) return;
    _wxLoading.add(key);
    _wxErr = '';
    Map<String, dynamic>? _wx;
    try {
      final DateTime today = DateTime(
          DateTime.now().year, DateTime.now().month, DateTime.now().day);
      final int daysOut = DateTime(wedding.year, wedding.month, wedding.day)
          .difference(today)
          .inDays;
      if (daysOut >= 0 && daysOut <= 15) {
        final Uri u = Uri.parse(
            'https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=${ll[0]}&longitude=${ll[1]}'
            '&daily=weather_code,temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_probability_max,wind_speed_10m_max,sunset'
            '&temperature_unit=fahrenheit&wind_speed_unit=mph&timezone=auto&start_date=${_ymd(wedding)}&end_date=${_ymd(wedding)}');
        final httpc.Response r =
            await httpc.get(u).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));
        final Map<String, dynamic> j =
            jsonDecode(r.body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
        final Map<String, dynamic> d =
            Map<String, dynamic>.from(j['daily'] as Map);
        _wx = <String, dynamic>{
          'mode': 'forecast',
          'hi': ((d['temperature_2m_max'] as List).first as num).round(),
          'lo': ((d['temperature_2m_min'] as List).first as num).round(),
          'code': ((d['weather_code'] as List).first as num).toInt(),
          'rainPct': _numAt(d['precipitation_probability_max']).round(),
          'wind': _numAt(d['wind_speed_10m_max']).round(),
          'sunset': (d['sunset'] as List).first.toString(),
          'daysOut': daysOut,
        };
      } else {
        // The same date, the last five years, in parallel.
        final int endYear = today.year -
            (wedding.month > today.month ||
                    (wedding.month == today.month && wedding.day > today.day)
                ? 1
                : 0);
        final List<Future<httpc.Response>> reqs = <Future<httpc.Response>>[];
        final List<int> years = <int>[];
        for (int y = endYear; y > endYear - 5; y--) {
          years.add(y);
          final String ds =
              '$y-${wedding.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${wedding.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
          reqs.add(httpc
              .get(Uri.parse(
                  'https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=${ll[0]}&longitude=${ll[1]}'
                  '&start_date=$ds&end_date=$ds&daily=weather_code,temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_sum,sunset'
                  '&temperature_unit=fahrenheit&timezone=auto'))
              .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 12)));
        }
        final List<httpc.Response> rs = await Future.wait(reqs);
        double hi = 0, lo = 0;
        int n = 0, rainy = 0;
        final Map<int, int> codes = <int, int>{};
        String sunset = '';
        for (final httpc.Response r in rs) {
          if (r.statusCode != 200) continue;
          final Map<String, dynamic> j =
              jsonDecode(r.body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
          if (j['daily'] is! Map) continue;
          final Map<String, dynamic> d =
              Map<String, dynamic>.from(j['daily'] as Map);
          final dynamic h = (d['temperature_2m_max'] as List).first;
          final dynamic l = (d['temperature_2m_min'] as List).first;
          if (h is! num || l is! num) continue;
          hi += h;
          lo += l;
          n++;
          final dynamic p = (d['precipitation_sum'] as List).first;
          if (p is num && p >= 1.0)
            rainy++; // under 1 mm is a trace, not a rainy day
          final dynamic c = (d['weather_code'] as List).first;
          if (c is num) codes[c.toInt()] = (codes[c.toInt()] ?? 0) + 1;
          if (sunset.isEmpty &&
              d['sunset'] is List &&
              (d['sunset'] as List).isNotEmpty) {
            sunset = (d['sunset'] as List).first.toString();
          }
        }
        if (n == 0) throw Exception('no history');
        int code = 1;
        int best = -1;
        codes.forEach((int c, int k) {
          if (k > best) {
            best = k;
            code = c;
          }
        });
        _wx = <String, dynamic>{
          'mode': 'typical',
          'hi': (hi / n).round(),
          'lo': (lo / n).round(),
          'code': code,
          'rainYears': rainy,
          'years': n,
          'sunset': sunset,
          'daysOut': daysOut,
        };
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO weather: ' + e.toString());
      _wxErr = 'Weather is unavailable right now.';
      _wx = null;
      _wxFailAt[key] = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;
    }
    _wxLoading.remove(key);
    if (_wx != null) _wxCache[key] = _wx;
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  static num _numAt(dynamic list) {
    if (list is List && list.isNotEmpty && list.first is num)
      return list.first as num;
    return 0;
  }

  String _sunsetClock(String iso) {
    // Open-Meteo returns local ISO like 2027-07-02T19:41; show 7:41 PM.
    final int t = iso.indexOf('T');
    if (t < 0 || iso.length < t + 6) return '';
    final int h = int.tryParse(iso.substring(t + 1, t + 3)) ?? 0;
    final String m = iso.substring(t + 4, t + 6);
    final int h12 = h % 12 == 0 ? 12 : h % 12;
    return '$h12:$m ${h < 12 ? 'AM' : 'PM'}';
  }

  String _weatherTip(Map<String, dynamic> w, {bool wedding = true}) {
    final int hi = w['hi'] as int;
    final int code = w['code'] as int;
    final bool wet = w['mode'] == 'forecast'
        ? (w['rainPct'] as int) >= 40
        : (w['rainYears'] as int) >= 2;
    if (!wedding) {
      if (wet)
        return 'Keep a backup day in mind - photographers reschedule for rain all the time.';
      if (hi >= 95)
        return 'Go early or go late - midday heat shows in faces and flowers.';
      if (hi <= 40)
        return 'Cold - layers that photograph well, and a warm car nearby.';
      if (code <= 1)
        return 'Clear - the hour before sunset is the one to book.';
      return 'Soft light if it stays cloudy - flattering, and no squinting.';
    }
    if (wet) return 'Ask your venue about the rain plan now, not the week of.';
    if (hi >= 95)
      return 'Shade, water and a short ceremony - guests remember the heat.';
    if (hi >= 85)
      return 'Warm one. Cocktail hour in the shade, and put water where guests stand.';
    if (hi <= 45)
      return 'Cold for an outdoor ceremony - heaters, wraps, or move it inside.';
    if (code <= 1)
      return 'Clear skies - sunset portraits will be worth planning around.';
    return 'Mild and easy. Not much to plan around.';
  }

  bool _teamExpanded = false;

  // A gold disc that reads as a made object rather than a coloured circle.
  // Three layers, because that is what the eye is actually reading:
  //
  //   BEZEL   a 1.2 rim that is near-white where the light hits and bronze
  //           where it turns away. A single flat border is the difference
  //           between a machined disc and a sticker - this is the layer that
  //           does most of the work.
  //   FACE    a four-stop ramp, champagne through gold into bronze, running
  //           the same direction as the light on the bezel.
  //   SPECULAR a soft hotspot up and left, where the highlight actually lands.
  //
  // The shadow is warm, not grey: gold spilling onto the plum underneath,
  // with a tight black contact line so it still touches the page.
  Widget _goldDisc({
    required double size,
    required IconData icon,
    required double iconSize,
    bool glow = true,
  }) {
    return Container(
      width: size,
      height: size,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        shape: BoxShape.circle,
        gradient: const LinearGradient(
          begin: Alignment.topLeft,
          end: Alignment.bottomRight,
          colors: <Color>[
            Color(0xFFFFF6E2),
            Color(0xFFE3C286),
            Color(0xFF9A7842),
          ],
          stops: <double>[0, .5, 1],
        ),
        boxShadow: glow
            ? <BoxShadow>[
                // Warm halo - the disc lighting the plum around it.
                BoxShadow(
                    color: gold.withOpacity(.30),
                    blurRadius: 28,
                    spreadRadius: -4,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 8)),
                BoxShadow(
                    color: Colors.black.withOpacity(.34),
                    blurRadius: 22,
                    spreadRadius: -6,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 12)),
                BoxShadow(
                    color: Colors.black.withOpacity(.22),
                    blurRadius: 5,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 2)),
              ]
            : <BoxShadow>[
                BoxShadow(
                    color: Colors.black.withOpacity(.22),
                    blurRadius: 10,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 4)),
              ],
      ),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(1.2), // the bezel's width
      child: DecoratedBox(
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
          shape: BoxShape.circle,
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            colors: <Color>[
              Color(0xFFF7E3B4),
              Color(0xFFDCB878),
              Color(0xFFC9A263),
              Color(0xFFA9843F),
            ],
            stops: <double>[0, .34, .66, 1],
          ),
        ),
        child: Stack(
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          children: <Widget>[
            Positioned.fill(
              child: DecoratedBox(
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  gradient: RadialGradient(
                    center: const Alignment(-.5, -.6),
                    radius: .9,
                    colors: <Color>[
                      Colors.white.withOpacity(.55),
                      Colors.white.withOpacity(0),
                    ],
                    stops: const <double>[0, .7],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            Icon(icon, color: plumDeep, size: iconSize),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // v131: the desk button, reworked on Apple's fluid-interface rules.
  //
  // DEPTH is two shadows, not one. A single wide blur reads as a sticker
  // printed on the page; real objects cast a tight contact shadow directly
  // under them AND a wider ambient one. The pair is what says 'above'.
  //
  // THE PRESS no longer fades the button out. Physical things do not go
  // translucent when you push them - they move, and the shadow tightens as
  // they get closer to the surface. Scale carries the whole gesture.
  //
  // THE HAPTIC moved to touch-down, onto the same frame as the scale. Fired
  // on release it was confirming something the finger had already finished.
  Widget _deskFab() {
    return Positioned(
      right: 18,
      bottom: 86, // v129: always above the Ask June bar (never shown on June)
      child: Material(
        key: _kTourFab,
        color: Colors.transparent,
        child: _Press(
          scale: .90,
          dim: 1, // no opacity change - see above
          tickOnDown: true,
          onTap: _deskSheet,
          child: _goldDisc(
            size: 58,
            icon: Icons.grid_view_rounded,
            iconSize: 25,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _deskSheet() async {
    // [label, icon, what it does, which screen it lands on]
    // The fourth entry is what lets a tile know it is the screen you are
    // already on. Seating and Music leave the dashboard for their own pages,
    // so they have no view to match and never light up.
    final List<List<dynamic>> items = <List<dynamic>>[
      <dynamic>[
        'Home',
        Icons.home_rounded,
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.hub),
        _View.hub
      ],

      ],

      ],

      ],
      <dynamic>[

      ],
      <dynamic>[

      ],
      <dynamic>[

      ],
      <dynamic>['Seating', Icons.table_restaurant_rounded, _openSeating, null],
      <dynamic>['Music', Icons.music_note_rounded, _openMusic, null],
      <dynamic>[
        'Website',
        Icons.language_rounded,
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.website),
        _View.website
      ],
      <dynamic>[
        'Registry',
        Icons.card_giftcard_rounded,
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.registry),
        _View.registry
      ],
      <dynamic>[
        'Shopping',
        Icons.shopping_bag_rounded,
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.shopping),
        _View.shopping
      ],
      <dynamic>[
        'Dream board',
        Icons.auto_awesome_mosaic_rounded,
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.board),
        _View.board
      ],
      <dynamic>[
        'Account',
        Icons.person_rounded,
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.account),
        _View.account
      ],
    ];
    // SPATIAL CONSISTENCY. The desk used to slide up from the bottom edge with
    // no relationship to the button that summoned it - tap a circle in the
    // corner, watch a full-width panel arrive from somewhere else. Now it
    // grows out of that corner and shrinks back into it, so the button and
    // the panel read as one object opening rather than two unrelated ones.
    //
    // The curve is critically damped, no overshoot: a tap carries no momentum,
    // and bounce belongs to gestures that were thrown. easeIn on the way out
    // mirrors easeOut on the way in, so the return retraces the path.
    //
    // Reduced motion keeps the plain slide - the vestibular problem is the
    // zoom, not the transition.
    final bool calm = _reducedMotion(context);
    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => SafeArea(
        child: AnimatedBuilder(
          // The route's OWN animation, not one of ours.
          //
          // Supplying a transitionAnimationController here and disposing it
          // after the await crashed the app: showModalBottomSheet's Future
          // completes when the route is popped, which is BEFORE the exit
          // animation has run, so the dispose tore the controller down
          // mid-flight and the next tick threw. Borrowing the route's
          // animation gives the same motion with no lifecycle to get wrong.
          animation: ModalRoute.of(ctx)?.animation ?? kAlwaysCompleteAnimation,
          builder: (BuildContext actx, Widget? panel) {
            if (calm) return panel!;
            final Animation<double> a =
                ModalRoute.of(actx)?.animation ?? kAlwaysCompleteAnimation;
            final double t = (a.status == AnimationStatus.reverse
                    ? Curves.easeInCubic
                    : Curves.easeOutCubic)
                .transform(a.value.clamp(0.0, 1.0));
            return Transform.scale(
              scale: .88 + .12 * t,
              // Roughly where the button sits: hard right, on the floor.
              alignment: const Alignment(.8, 1),
              child: panel,
            );
          },
          child: Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(10, 0, 10, 10),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 12, 16, 16),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              // Lit from above, like everything else here: one flat fill gave
              // the tiles nothing to sit in.
              gradient: const LinearGradient(
                begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                colors: <Color>[Color(0xFF3B1C3D), Color(0xFF291228)],
              ),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(26),
              border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
              boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[
                // A bigger surface reads as a thicker one: wider, softer, and
                // sitting further off the page than the button that opened it.
                BoxShadow(
                    color: Colors.black.withOpacity(.38),
                    blurRadius: 40,
                    spreadRadius: -4,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 18)),
                BoxShadow(
                    color: Colors.black.withOpacity(.26),
                    blurRadius: 10,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 3)),
              ],
            ),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: <Widget>[
                Container(
                    width: 44,
                    height: 4,
                    margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: gold.withOpacity(.45),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99))),
                Padding(

                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: gold.withOpacity(.9),
                          fontSize: 10.5,
                          letterSpacing: 2.2,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                ),
                GridView.count(
                  shrinkWrap: true,
                  physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                  crossAxisCount: 4,
                  mainAxisSpacing: 10,
                  crossAxisSpacing: 10,
                  childAspectRatio: .92,

  // One tile on the planning desk.
  //
  // The gold state is the point: a launcher whose first job is telling you
  // where you are had twelve identical squares and told you nothing. The tile
  // for the screen behind the sheet is lit, so the desk always answers 'here'
  // before you pick 'there'.
  //
  // Read at build time and never updated - correct, because tapping any tile
  // closes the sheet.
  Widget _deskSheetTile(BuildContext sheetCtx, List<dynamic> it) {
    final bool here = it.length > 3 && it[3] != null && it[3] == _view;
    const Color lit = Color(0xFFF7E3B4);
    return _Press(
      scale: .94,
      dim: 1,
      tickOnDown: true,
      onTap: () {
        Navigator.pop(sheetCtx);
        (it[2] as VoidCallback)();

      child: Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          // Top-lit face, same as the panel and the discs.
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topCenter,
            end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
            colors: here
                ? <Color>[gold.withOpacity(.34), gold.withOpacity(.14)]
                : <Color>[_lzBg(ivory).withOpacity(.13), _lzBg(ivory).withOpacity(.05)],
          ),
          border: Border.all(

          boxShadow: here
              ? <BoxShadow>[

  // The sky on the home. Reads the same cache the Day-of weather card fills.
  Widget _weatherHubWidget(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    final dynamic ts = couple['weddingDate'];
    final String metro = (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString();
    // Always present. Without a date it shows today in their city; without a
    // city it asks for one (the setup sheet writes couples.metroId).
    if (metro.isEmpty || !kMetroLatLng.containsKey(metro)) {
      return _Press(
        scale: .985,
        dim: .92,
        onTap: () => _setupSheet(couple),
        child: Container(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
            gradient: const LinearGradient(
                begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                colors: <Color>[Color(0xFF4A2B4C), plumDeep]),
          ),
          foregroundDecoration: BoxDecoration(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
              border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.55))),
          clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 16, 18, 16),
          child: Row(children: <Widget>[
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Text('WEATHER ON YOUR DAY',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: ivory.withOpacity(.7),
                            fontSize: 10.5,
                            letterSpacing: 1.8,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    const Text('Tell June your city',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: ivory,
                            fontSize: 16,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    Text(
                        'She\u2019ll show the real forecast as your date nears, and what that day is usually like there until then.',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: ivory.withOpacity(.75),
                            fontSize: 12.5,
                            height: 1.4)),
                  ]),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Icon(Icons.wb_sunny_rounded, color: gold.withOpacity(.9), size: 46),
          ]),
        ),
      );
    }
    final DateTime wedding = ts is Timestamp
        ? ts.toDate()
        : DateTime(
            DateTime.now().year, DateTime.now().month, DateTime.now().day);
    final bool hasDate = ts is Timestamp;
    WidgetsBinding.instance
        .addPostFrameCallback((_) => _loadWeather(wedding, metro));
    final Map<String, dynamic>? w = _wxCache['${_ymd(wedding)}|$metro'];
    final String city = _metroLabel(metro);
    final int code = w == null ? -1 : (w['code'] as int);
    final bool fc = w != null && w['mode'] == 'forecast';
    // sky tint by condition
    List<Color> sky;
    if (code < 0) {
      sky = <Color>[const Color(0xFF4A2B4C), const Color(0xFF3D1C3B)];
    } else if (code <= 1) {
      sky = <Color>[
        const Color(0xFF2E5C8A),
        const Color(0xFF7FB3D5),
        const Color(0xFFF2D7A0)
      ];
    } else if (code <= 3) {
      sky = <Color>[
        const Color(0xFF4C5C7A),
        const Color(0xFF8C9BB5),
        const Color(0xFFD9D2C5)
      ];
    } else if (code >= 71 && code <= 77) {
      sky = <Color>[
        const Color(0xFF5B6B8C),
        const Color(0xFFB9C7DB),
        const Color(0xFFEEF2F7)
      ];
    } else if (code >= 95) {
      sky = <Color>[
        const Color(0xFF2B2A45),
        const Color(0xFF4C4A72),
        const Color(0xFF8A86A8)
      ];
    } else {
      sky = <Color>[
        const Color(0xFF34506B),
        const Color(0xFF5F7E9C),
        const Color(0xFFA9BCCB)
      ];
    }
    final bool light = code >= 0 && (code <= 3 || (code >= 71 && code <= 77));
    final Color fg = light ? const Color(0xFF1E2430) : Colors.white;
    final Color fg2 = fg.withOpacity(.72);
    final String sunset =
        w == null ? '' : _sunsetClock((w['sunset'] ?? '').toString());
    final String rain = w == null
        ? ''
        : fc
            ? '${w['rainPct']}% rain'
            : (w['rainYears'] == 0
                ? 'Dry ${w['years']} of ${w['years']} years'
                : 'Rain ${w['rainYears']} of ${w['years']} years');
    // v130: laid out like a weather widget, not a stat row. The sky runs top
    // to bottom with light catching the upper edge, the temperature leads,
    // the condition and low sit beside it, the details ride in frosted
    // tiles, and the icon holds the corner.
    final bool loaded = w != null;
    final String condition = loaded
        ? _wmoLabel(code)
        : (_wxErr.isEmpty ? 'Reading the sky\u2026' : _wxErr);
    Widget tile(String t, {IconData? icon}) => Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 5),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: (light ? Colors.white : Colors.black)
                  .withOpacity(light ? .30 : .18),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
