            ]),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ===================================================================
  // vTOUR: THE FIRST-RUN TOUR (spotlight coach marks, no packages)
  // ===================================================================
  final GlobalKey _tourRootKey = GlobalKey();
  int _tourIdx = -1;
  List<_TourStep> _tourSteps = <_TourStep>[];
  Rect? _tourRect;
  bool _tourMeasuring = false;

  void _startTour(List<_TourStep> steps) {
    if (steps.isEmpty) return;
    setState(() {
      _tourSteps = steps;
      _tourIdx = 0;
      _tourRect = null;
    });
    _tourFocus();
  }

  void _tourGo(int delta) {
    final int next = _tourIdx + delta;
    if (next < 0 || next >= _tourSteps.length) {
      _endTour(completed: next >= _tourSteps.length);
      return;
    }
    setState(() => _tourIdx = next);
    _tourFocus();
  }

  Future<void> _tourFocus() async {
    if (_tourIdx < 0 || _tourIdx >= _tourSteps.length) return;
    final _TourStep st = _tourSteps[_tourIdx];
    st.before?.call();
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 60));
    BuildContext? tc = st.key?.currentContext;
    if (tc == null && st.key != null) {
      // target not on this screen - skip it
      if (mounted) _tourGo(1);
      return;
    }
    if (tc != null) {
      // Scroll only when the target is actually off-screen; ensureVisible
      // resolves when its animation ends, so no fixed wait is needed.
      bool needScroll = true;
      try {
        final RenderObject? rootRo0 =
            _tourRootKey.currentContext?.findRenderObject();
        final RenderObject? ro0 = tc.findRenderObject();
        if (rootRo0 is RenderBox && ro0 is RenderBox && ro0.hasSize) {
          final Offset o0 = ro0.localToGlobal(Offset.zero, ancestor: rootRo0);
          final double h0 = rootRo0.size.height;
          needScroll = o0.dy < 70 || o0.dy + ro0.size.height > h0 - 90;
        }
      } catch (_) {}
      if (needScroll) {
        try {
          await Scrollable.ensureVisible(tc,
              alignment: .25,
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 380),
              curve: Curves.easeInOutCubic);
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }
    if (!mounted) return;
    _tourMeasuring = true;
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      _tourMeasuring = false;
      if (!mounted) return;
      final RenderObject? rootRo =
          _tourRootKey.currentContext?.findRenderObject();
      final RenderObject? ro = st.key?.currentContext?.findRenderObject();
      Rect? r;
      if (rootRo is RenderBox && ro is RenderBox && ro.hasSize) {
        final Offset o = ro.localToGlobal(Offset.zero, ancestor: rootRo);
        r = Rect.fromLTWH(o.dx, o.dy, ro.size.width, ro.size.height).inflate(6);
      }
      setState(() => _tourRect = r);
    });
  }

  Widget _tourOverlay() {
    if (_tourIdx < 0 || _tourIdx >= _tourSteps.length)
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    final _TourStep st = _tourSteps[_tourIdx];
    final Rect? r = _tourRect;
    return Positioned.fill(
      child: LayoutBuilder(builder: (BuildContext lc, BoxConstraints cons) {
        final double w = cons.maxWidth, h = cons.maxHeight;
        final bool phone = w < 700;
        // card goes below the spotlight when there's room, else above
        final double cardW = phone ? w - 28 : 380;
        final bool below = r == null || r.bottom + 190 < h;
        final double top = r == null
            ? h * .35
            : (below ? r.bottom + 14 : (r.top - 14 - 180).clamp(12.0, h - 200));
        final double left = phone
            ? 14
            : (r == null
                ? (w - cardW) / 2
                : (r.left).clamp(14.0, w - cardW - 14));
        return Stack(children: <Widget>[
          Positioned.fill(
            child: GestureDetector(
              onTap: () => _tourGo(1),
              child: TweenAnimationBuilder<Rect?>(
                // v130: re-key when the ring first appears so it doesn't
                // grow out of the top-left corner (Rect.lerp from null).
                key: ValueKey<bool>(r == null),
                tween: RectTween(begin: r, end: r),
                duration:
                    Duration(milliseconds: _reducedMotion(context) ? 0 : 260),
                curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
                builder: (BuildContext bc, Rect? v, Widget? _) =>
                    CustomPaint(painter: _SpotlightPainter(v, plum)),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          AnimatedPositioned(
            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
            curve: Curves.easeOut,
            left: left,
            top: top,
            width: cardW,
            child: Material(
              color: Colors.transparent,
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 16, 18, 14),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: _lzBg(const Color(0xFFFFFDF9)),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                  border: Border.all(color: gold),
                  boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[
                    BoxShadow(
                        color: Colors.black.withOpacity(.35),
                        blurRadius: 30,
                        offset: const Offset(0, 12)),
                  ],
                ),
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Row(children: <Widget>[
                      const Icon(Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
                          color: gold, size: 16),
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(st.title,
                            style:  TextStyle(
                                color: _lzFg(plum),
                                fontSize: 16,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      ),
                      Text('${_tourIdx + 1} of ${_tourSteps.length}',
                          style:  TextStyle(
                              color: _lzFg(Color(0xFF6B5F72)),
                              fontSize: 11,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    ]),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Text(st.body,
                        style:  TextStyle(
                            color: _lzFg(Color(0xFF241E2B)),
                            fontSize: 13.5,
                            height: 1.45)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    Row(children: <Widget>[
                      TextButton(
                        onPressed: _h(() => _endTour(completed: false)),
                        child:  Text('Skip',
                            style: TextStyle(
                                color: _lzFg(Color(0xFF6B5F72)),
                                fontSize: 12.5,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                      ),
                      const Spacer(),
                      if (_tourIdx > 0)
                        TextButton(
                          onPressed: _h(() => _tourGo(-1)),
                          child:  Text('Back',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  color: _lzFg(plum),
                                  fontSize: 12.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                        ),
                      FilledButton(
                        style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: plum,
                            elevation: 0,
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 16, vertical: 10),
                            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10))),
                        onPressed: _h(() => _tourGo(1)),
                        child: Text(
                            _tourIdx == _tourSteps.length - 1 ? 'Done' : 'Next',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                color: Colors.white,
                                fontSize: 13,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      ),
                    ]),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ]);
      }),
    );
  }

  // ---- couple-specific ----
  final GlobalKey _kTourSetup = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourHero = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourWeek = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourTeam = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourMessages = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourDayOf = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourJune = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourFab = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourRail = GlobalKey();
  bool _tourChecked = false;

  void _maybeStartCoupleTour(Map<String, dynamic> couple, bool needsSetup) {
    if (_tourChecked || _tourIdx >= 0) return;
    // The hub renders once with an empty map before the couple doc arrives -
    // deciding on that frame started the tour for everyone, every load.
    if (couple.isEmpty) return;
    // v139: per partner - a joining partner gets the tour too. A legacy
    // tourDoneAt with no tourDoneBy counts for the plan's creator only.
    final List<dynamic> doneBy =
        couple['tourDoneBy'] is List ? couple['tourDoneBy'] as List : <dynamic>[];
    final bool doneForMe = doneBy.contains(_uid) ||
        (doneBy.isEmpty && couple['tourDoneAt'] != null && _uid == _cid);
    if (doneForMe) {
      _tourChecked = true;
      return;
    }
    _tourChecked = true;
    Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 900), () {
      if (mounted && _view == _View.hub)
        _startTour(_coupleTourSteps(needsSetup: needsSetup));
    });
  }

  List<_TourStep> _coupleTourSteps({required bool needsSetup}) {
    return <_TourStep>[
      _TourStep('Welcome to your planning desk',
          'Everything for the wedding lives on this one page - your vendors, messages, money, website and day-of plan. Here is the thirty-second lay of the land.'),
      if (needsSetup)
        _TourStep('Start here - one minute with June',
            'Your names, the date, the city, a rough budget and the vendors you actually need. Everything on the page builds from that, so this comes first.',
            key: _kTourSetup),
      _TourStep('The countdown',
          'Days to go, what June thinks you should do next, and four honest numbers: vendors booked, next up, budget, vendor replies.',
          key: _kTourHero),
      _TourStep('This week, with June',
          'Three concrete steps, in order, with a button each. She only lists what is actually waiting on you.',
          key: _kTourWeek),
      _TourStep('Your vendor team',
          'The categories you said you need - not our fifteen, yours. Tap in to see when couples in your city usually book each one and to check a date.',
          key: _kTourTeam),
      _TourStep('Messages',
          'One thread per vendor. Proposals, contracts and payments all happen inside the thread. This tile lights up when someone is waiting on you.',
          key: _kTourMessages),
      _TourStep('Day-of',
          'Timeline, guests, seating, music - and one tap to share any of them with your vendors when the time comes. Website, budget and saved vendors sit right beside it.',
          key: _kTourDayOf),
      _TourStep('Ask June anything',
          'She knows your plan, your budget and your city. "Is \u002435k realistic here?" "What should I ask a photographer?" Ask from any screen.',
          key: _kTourJune),
      if (!_hasRail)
        _TourStep('Your desk button',
            'Every screen - Vendor team, Browse, Messages, Day-of, Guests, Seating, Music, Website, Registry - is one tap away here.',
            key: _kTourFab)
      else
        _TourStep('The planning desk',
            'Every screen is listed here. You can always come back to the tour from Account.',
            key: _kTourRail),
    ];
  }

  Future<void> _endTour({required bool completed}) async {
    _tourChecked = true;
    setState(() {
      _tourIdx = -1;
      _tourSteps = <_TourStep>[];
      _tourRect = null;
    });
    try {
      await _coupleRef.set(<String, dynamic>{
        'tourDoneAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'tourCompleted': completed,
        'tourDoneBy': FieldValue.arrayUnion(<dynamic>[_uid]),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  // v118.1: sheets sit on ivory but the app theme is built for the dark
  // canvas, so a bare OutlineInputBorder() picked up near-invisible theme
  // colors - fields looked like empty space. Explicit light-surface styling.
  InputDecoration _lightDeco(String label, {String? hint, String? prefix}) {
    return InputDecoration(
      labelText: label.isEmpty ? null : label,
      labelStyle:  TextStyle(
          color: _lzFg(plum), fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
      floatingLabelStyle:  TextStyle(
          color: _lzFg(plum), fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
      hintText: hint,
      hintStyle: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink.withOpacity(.35)), fontSize: 15),
      prefixText: prefix,
      prefixStyle:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 16),
      filled: true,
      fillColor: _lzBg(Colors.white),
      contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 14),
      border: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: gold, width: 1.2)),
      enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: gold, width: 1.2)),
      focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: plum, width: 1.6)),
    );
  }

  // ===================================================================
  // v120: THE DESK - six tiles, one line each, tap to open the screen
  // ===================================================================
  Widget _deskTiles(
      Map<String, dynamic> couple,
      Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan,
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> inqs,
      DateTime? wedding,
      int? daysOut,
      bool twoUp) {
    int booked = 0, active = 0;
    for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
      final String st = (plan[c['slug']]?['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
      if (st == 'skipped') continue;
      active++;
      if (st == 'booked') booked++;
    }
    int unread = 0, contracts = 0;
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in inqs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
      final dynamic last = m['lastMessageAt'];
      final dynamic read = m['coupleLastReadAt'];
      if ((m['lastMessageRole'] ?? '') == 'vendor' &&
          last is Timestamp &&
          (read is! Timestamp || last.compareTo(read) > 0)) unread++;
      if ((m['contractStatus'] ?? '') == 'sent') contracts++;
    }
    final num budgetTotal =
        couple['budgetTotal'] is num ? couple['budgetTotal'] as num : 0;
    double committed = 0;
    for (final Map<String, dynamic> p in plan.values) {
      if ((p['status'] ?? '') == 'booked')
        committed += _spentOf(p).toDouble(); // v140
    }
    final int saved =
        ((couple['savedVendors'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[]).length;

    final List<Widget> tiles = <Widget>[
      KeyedSubtree(
        key: _kTourTeam,
        child: _deskTile(
          Icons.checklist_rounded,
          'Vendor team',
          booked == 0 ? '0 of $active booked' : '$booked of $active booked',
          booked == 0
              ? 'Nobody yet - that\u2019s normal'
              : (booked == active
                  ? 'All booked'
                  : 'Next: ${_nextUpLabel(plan, wedding)}'),
          () => setState(() => _view = _View.vendors),
          hot: false,
        ),
      ),
      KeyedSubtree(
        key: _kTourMessages,
        child: _deskTile(
          Icons.chat_bubble_rounded,
          'Messages',
          inqs.isEmpty
              ? 'No threads yet'
              : '${inqs.length} thread${inqs.length == 1 ? '' : 's'}',
          contracts > 0
              ? '$contracts contract${contracts == 1 ? '' : 's'} to sign'
              : unread > 0
                  ? '$unread new repl${unread == 1 ? 'y' : 'ies'}'
                  : 'Inbox is clear',
          () => setState(() => _view = _View.messages),
          hot: unread > 0 || contracts > 0,
        ),
      ),
      StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
        stream: _liveQuery('dayof:$_cid', () => _dayofRef.orderBy('time')),
        initialData: _liveQ['dayof:$_cid']?.latest,
        builder: (BuildContext c,
            AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> sn) {
          final int n = sn.data?.docs.length ?? 0;
          return KeyedSubtree(
            key: _kTourDayOf,
            child: _deskTile(
              Icons.event_rounded,
              'Day-of',
              n == 0 ? 'No timeline yet' : '$n moment${n == 1 ? '' : 's'}',
              daysOut == null
                  ? 'Set your date first'
                  : (n == 0
                      ? 'Build it, share it'
                      : 'Timeline, guests, seating, music'),
              () => setState(() => _view = _View.dayof),
              hot: false,
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
      StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
        stream: _liveQuery(
            'site:$_cid',
            () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
                .collection('weddingSites')
                .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
                .limit(1)),
        initialData: _liveQ['site:$_cid']?.latest,
        builder: (BuildContext c,
            AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> sn) {
          final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? doc =
              (sn.data?.docs.isNotEmpty ?? false) ? sn.data!.docs.first : null;
          return _deskTile(
            Icons.language_rounded,
            'Website',
            doc == null ? 'Not built yet' : 'meetlazo.com/w/${doc.id}',
            doc == null ? 'Free, ten minutes' : 'Story, RSVPs, registry',
            () => setState(() => _view = _View.website),
            hot: false,
          );
        },
      ),
      _deskTile(
        Icons.account_balance_wallet_rounded,
        'Budget',
        budgetTotal <= 0 ? 'Not set' : _railMoney(budgetTotal.toDouble()),
        budgetTotal <= 0
            ? 'Even a rough number helps'
            : (committed <= 0
                ? 'Nothing committed yet'
                : '${_railMoney(committed)} committed'),
        () => _budgetSheet(couple, plan),
        hot: false,
      ),
      _deskTile(
        Icons.favorite_rounded,
        'Saved vendors',
        saved == 0 ? 'None saved' : '$saved saved',
        saved == 0 ? 'Tap the heart on any vendor' : 'Check their dates',
        () => saved == 0
            ? setState(() => _view = _View.browse)
            : showModalBottomSheet<void>(
                context: context,
                backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
                isScrollControlled: true,
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 640),
                shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
                    borderRadius:
                        BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
                builder: (BuildContext ctx) => SafeArea(
                  child: SingleChildScrollView(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 18, 18, 22),
                    child: _savedCard(couple),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
        hot: false,
      ),
    ];
    return LayoutBuilder(builder: (BuildContext lc, BoxConstraints cons) {
      final int cols = cons.maxWidth >= 900 ? 3 : 2;
      final double w = (cons.maxWidth - (cols - 1) * 12) / cols;
      return Wrap(
        spacing: 12,
        runSpacing: 12,
        children: <Widget>[
          for (final Widget t in tiles) SizedBox(width: w, child: t)
        ],
      );
    });
  }

  String _nextUpLabel(
      Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan, DateTime? wedding) {
    String nextSlug = '';
    DateTime? nextBy;
    for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
      final String slug = c['slug'] ?? '';
      final String st = (plan[slug]?['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
      if (st == 'booked' || st == 'skipped') continue;
      final DateTime? by = _dueFor(slug, wedding);
      if (nextSlug.isEmpty ||
          (by != null && (nextBy == null || by.isBefore(nextBy)))) {
        nextSlug = slug;
        nextBy = by;
      }
    }
    return nextSlug.isEmpty ? 'done' : _catLabel(nextSlug);
  }

  Widget _deskTile(
      IconData icon, String title, String big, String sub, VoidCallback onTap,
      {required bool hot}) {
    return _Press(
      onTap: onTap,
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 14, 14, 14),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: _lzBg(const Color(0xFFFAF6F0).withOpacity(.94)),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
          border: Border.all(
              color: _lzLine(hot ? gold : gold.withOpacity(.45)), width: hot ? 1.6 : 1),
        ),
        child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              Row(children: <Widget>[
                Container(
                  width: 30,
                  height: 30,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: gold.withOpacity(.18),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(9),
                      border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.5))),
                  child: Icon(icon, color: _lzFg(plum), size: 16),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(title.toUpperCase(),
                      style:  TextStyle(
                          color: _lzFg(plum),
                          fontSize: 10.5,
                          letterSpacing: 1.6,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                ),
                if (hot)
                  Container(
                      width: 8,
                      height: 8,
                      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                          color: gold, shape: BoxShape.circle)),
                 Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded, color: _lzFg(muted), size: 18),
              ]),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              Text(big,
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: _serif(
                      size: 22,
                      color: _lzFg(ink),
                      weight: FontWeight.w600,
                      height: 1.05)),
              const SizedBox(height: 3),
              Text(sub,
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: _lzFg(muted))),
            ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  // v121: what the vendor told us about who they work with, shown before the
  // couple inquires - the honest version of "contact for pricing".
  Widget _worksWithLine(Map<String, dynamic> v) {
    final Map<String, dynamic> p =
        Map<String, dynamic>.from((v['prefs'] as Map?) ?? <String, dynamic>{});
    final List<String> bits = <String>[];
    if (p['minBudget'] is num && (p['minBudget'] as num) > 0)
      bits.add('books from ${_railMoney((p['minBudget'] as num).toDouble())}');
    final num gMin = p['guestMin'] is num ? p['guestMin'] as num : 0;
    final num gMax = p['guestMax'] is num ? p['guestMax'] as num : 0;
    if (gMin > 0 || gMax > 0)
      bits.add(
          '${gMin > 0 ? gMin.round() : 'any'}\u2013${gMax > 0 ? gMax.round() : 'any'} guests');
    if (p['travelMiles'] is num && (p['travelMiles'] as num) > 0)
      bits.add('travels ${(p['travelMiles'] as num).round()} mi');
    final String note = (p['note'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (bits.isEmpty && note.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 10, 12, 10),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: gold.withOpacity(.14),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.5))),
        child: Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
               Icon(Icons.info_outline_rounded,
                  size: 15, color: _lzFg(Color(0xFF8A6A2F))),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      if (bits.isNotEmpty)
                        Text(
                            '${bits.first[0].toUpperCase()}${bits.first.substring(1)}${bits.length > 1 ? ' \u00b7 ' + bits.sublist(1).join(' \u00b7 ') : ''}',
                            style:  TextStyle(
                                color: _lzFg(ink),
                                fontSize: 12.5,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                      if (note.isNotEmpty)
                        Text('\u201c$note\u201d',
                            style:  TextStyle(
                                color: _lzFg(muted),
                                fontSize: 12,
                                height: 1.35,
                                fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
                    ]),
              ),
            ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ===================================================================
  // v123: YOUR VENDOR'S TEAM (recommendations from booked pros)
  // ===================================================================
  Map<String, dynamic>? _pendingReferral;
  Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> _recsCache =
      <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
  String _recsFor = '';

  // couples/{cid}/recs keyed by vendorId; cached per couple, refreshed by stream
  Map<String, dynamic>? _recFor(String categorySlug) {
    if (_recsFor != _cid) {
      _recsFor = _cid;
      _liveQuery('recs:$_cid', () => _coupleRef.collection('recs'))
          .listen((QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> s) {
        _recsCache = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{
          for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in s.docs)
            d.id: d.data()
        };
        if (mounted) setState(() {});
      });
    }
    for (final Map<String, dynamic> r in _recsCache.values) {
      if ((r['category'] ?? '') == categorySlug) return r;
    }
    return null;
  }

  Future<void> _checkDateWithRec(Map<String, dynamic> rec) async {
    final String vid = (rec['vendorId'] ?? '').toString();
    if (vid.isEmpty) return;
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> vs =
          await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('vendors').doc(vid).get();
      if (!vs.exists) {
        _toastC('That vendor isn\u2019t on Lazo yet.');
        return;
      }
      final Map<String, dynamic> v = <String, dynamic>{
        ...vs.data()!,
        'placeId': vs.id
      };
      _pendingReferral = <String, dynamic>{
        'vendorId': vid,
        'fromVendorId': rec['fromVendorId'],
        'fromVendorName': rec['fromVendorName']
      };
      _browseCat = (v['category'] ?? _browseCat).toString();
      await _sendInquiry(v);
    } catch (e) {
      _toastC('Could not open that vendor.');
    }
  }

  // ---- JC-LAZO-COUPLE-0920-LIC-001: the marriage license ----
  Map<String, dynamic>? _licData;
  bool _licLoading = false;
  String _licErr = '';

  Future<void> _loadLicenseData() async {
    if (_licData != null || _licLoading) return;
    _licLoading = true;
    try {
      final httpc.Response r = await httpc
          .get(Uri.parse('https://meetlazo.com/marriage-license/data.json'))
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));
      if (r.statusCode == 200) {
        final dynamic j = jsonDecode(r.body);
        if (j is Map) _licData = Map<String, dynamic>.from(j);
      } else {
        _licErr = 'Could not load license details.';
      }
    } catch (e) {
      _licErr = 'Could not load license details.';
      debugPrint('LAZO license data: ' + e.toString());
    } finally {
      _licLoading = false;
      if (mounted) setState(() {});
    }
  }

  String _licDate(DateTime d) {
    const List<String> m = <String>[
      'Jan',
      'Feb',
      'Mar',
      'Apr',
      'May',
      'Jun',
      'Jul',
      'Aug',
      'Sep',
      'Oct',
      'Nov',
      'Dec'
    ];
    return '${m[d.month - 1]} ${d.day}';
  }

  Widget _licenseCard(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    final bool done = couple['licenseDone'] == true;
    final String metro = (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString();
    if (_licData == null && !_licLoading && _licErr.isEmpty) {
      _loadLicenseData();
    }
    Map<String, dynamic>? st;
    List<dynamic> offices = const <dynamic>[];
    String stateSlug = '';
    if (_licData != null && metro.isNotEmpty) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> ms = _licData!['metros'] is Map
          ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(_licData!['metros'] as Map)
          : <String, dynamic>{};
      final Map<String, dynamic> me = ms[metro] is Map
          ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(ms[metro] as Map)
          : <String, dynamic>{};
      stateSlug = (me['state'] ?? '').toString();
      offices =
          me['offices'] is List ? me['offices'] as List : const <dynamic>[];
      final Map<String, dynamic> sts = _licData!['states'] is Map
          ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(_licData!['states'] as Map)
          : <String, dynamic>{};
      if (sts[stateSlug] is Map)
        st = Map<String, dynamic>.from(sts[stateSlug] as Map);
    }
    DateTime? wd;
    final dynamic ts = couple['weddingDate'];
    if (ts is Timestamp) wd = ts.toDate();
    String window = '';
    if (st != null && wd != null) {
      final int v =
          st['valid_days'] is num ? (st['valid_days'] as num).toInt() : 0;
      final int w =
          st['wait_days'] is num ? (st['wait_days'] as num).toInt() : 0;
      final DateTime latest = wd.subtract(Duration(days: w));
      if (v > 0) {
        final DateTime earliest = wd.subtract(Duration(days: v));
        window = 'Apply between ${_licDate(earliest)} and ${_licDate(latest)}';
      } else {
        window = 'Apply by ${_licDate(latest)} - it does not expire';
      }
      final int daysToLatest = latest.difference(DateTime.now()).inDays;
      if (!done && daysToLatest < 0) {
        window +=
            ' · that was ${-daysToLatest} day${daysToLatest == -1 ? '' : 's'} ago';
      } else if (!done && daysToLatest <= 14) {
        window +=
            ' · ${daysToLatest == 0 ? 'today' : 'in $daysToLatest day${daysToLatest == 1 ? '' : 's'}'}';
      }
    }
    final String fee = st == null ? '' : (st['fee_text'] ?? '').toString();
    final String issuer = st == null ? '' : (st['issuer'] ?? '').toString();
    final String stateName = st == null ? '' : (st['name'] ?? '').toString();
    final String siteUrl = stateSlug.isEmpty
        ? 'https://meetlazo.com/marriage-license/'
        : 'https://meetlazo.com/marriage-license/$stateSlug/';

    Future<void> toggle() async {
      try {
        await _coupleRef.set(<String, dynamic>{
          'licenseDone': !done,
          'licenseDoneAt':
              done ? FieldValue.delete() : FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      } catch (e) {
        _toast('Could not save that: ' + e.toString());
      }
    }

    return _glass(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
      radius: 22,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(children: <Widget>[
             Expanded(
              child: Text('Marriage license',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      color: _lzFg(plum), fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
            ),
            _Press(
              tick: _Tick.select,
              onTap: toggle,
              child: Container(
                padding:
                    const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 6),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: _lzBg(done ? vGreen : Colors.white),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                  border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(done ? vGreen : goldLine)),
                ),
                child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
                  Icon(
                      done
                          ? Icons.check_rounded
                          : Icons.radio_button_unchecked_rounded,
                      size: 14,
                      color: _lzFg(done ? Colors.white : muted)),
                  const SizedBox(width: 5),
                  Text(done ? 'We have it' : 'Not yet',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: _lzFg(done ? Colors.white : plum),
                          fontSize: 12,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                ]),
              ),
            ),
          ]),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          if (done)
             Text(
                'Bring it on the day - the officiant signs it and returns it to the office.',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted), height: 1.4))
          else if (st == null) ...<Widget>[
            Text(
                _licLoading
                    ? 'Looking up your state…'
                    : (metro.isEmpty
                        ? 'Set your city in Account and we’ll show the fee, the office and when to apply.'
                        : (_licErr.isNotEmpty
                            ? _licErr
                            : 'The fee, the office and when to apply, for your state.')),
                style:
                     TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted), height: 1.4)),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            _Press(
              onTap: () async {
                final Uri u = Uri.parse(siteUrl);
                if (await canLaunchUrl(u))
                  await launchUrl(u, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
              },
              child:  Text('Every state, on meetlazo.com →',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      color: _lzFg(plum),
                      fontSize: 12.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
            ),
          ] else ...<Widget>[
            Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: <Widget>[
              _licPill(fee, 'fee'),
              _licPill((st['wait_text'] ?? '').toString(), 'wait'),
              _licPill((st['valid_text'] ?? '').toString(), 'lasts'),
              _licPill(
                  (st['witnesses'] is num && (st['witnesses'] as num) > 0)
                      ? '${(st['witnesses'] as num).toInt()} witness${(st['witnesses'] as num) > 1 ? 'es' : ''}'
                      : 'No witnesses',
                  'ceremony'),
            ]),
            if (window.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              Row(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                     Icon(Icons.event_available_rounded,
                        size: 16, color: _lzFg(Color(0xFF8A6A2F))),
                    const SizedBox(width: 6),
                    Expanded(
                        child: Text(window,
                            style:  TextStyle(
                                color: _lzFg(Color(0xFF8A6A2F)),
                                fontSize: 13,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                height: 1.35))),
                  ]),
            ],
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Text(
                issuer.trim().isEmpty
                    ? '$stateName: both of you go, with photo ID.'
                    : '$stateName: issued by the ${issuer.toLowerCase()}. Both of you go, with photo ID.',
                style:
                     TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted), height: 1.4)),
            if ((st['course'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty)
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
                child: Text((st['course'] ?? '').toString(),
                    style:  TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12, color: _lzFg(muted), height: 1.4)),
              ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            for (final dynamic o in offices.take(3))
              if (o is Map)
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),
                  child: _Press(
                    onTap: () async {
                      final Uri u =
                          Uri.parse((o['site'] ?? siteUrl).toString());
                      if (await canLaunchUrl(u))
                        await launchUrl(u,
                            mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
                    },
                    child: Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 9, 12, 9),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: _lzBg(Colors.white),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(goldLine))),
                      child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                        Expanded(
                          child: Column(
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: <Widget>[
                                Text(
                                    '${o['county'] ?? ''} · ${o['office'] ?? ''}',
                                    style:  TextStyle(
                                        color: _lzFg(ink),
                                        fontSize: 13,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                                if ((o['note'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty ||
                                    (o['fee'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty)
                                  Text(
                                      <String>[
                                        if ((o['fee'] ?? '')
                                            .toString()
                                            .isNotEmpty)
                                          'about \$${o['fee']}',
                                        if ((o['note'] ?? '')
                                            .toString()
                                            .isNotEmpty)
                                          (o['note'] ?? '').toString(),
                                      ].join(' · '),
                                      style:  TextStyle(
                                          fontSize: 11.5,
                                          color: _lzFg(muted),
                                          height: 1.35)),
                              ]),
                        ),
                         Icon(Icons.open_in_new_rounded,
                            size: 15, color: _lzFg(plum)),
                      ]),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
            _Press(
              onTap: () async {
                final Uri u = Uri.parse(siteUrl);
                if (await canLaunchUrl(u))
                  await launchUrl(u, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
              },
              child: Text('Everything about the $stateName license →',
                  style:  TextStyle(
                      color: _lzFg(plum),
                      fontSize: 12.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _licPill(String v, String k) {
    if (v.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 6),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: gold.withOpacity(.16),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
          border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.55))),

          style:  TextStyle(
              color: _lzFg(Color(0xFF8A6A2F)),
              fontSize: 11.5,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
    );
  }

  Widget _weatherCard(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    final dynamic ts = couple['weddingDate'];
    final String metro = (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString();
    if (ts is! Timestamp || metro.isEmpty || !kMetroLatLng.containsKey(metro)) {
      return _glass(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        radius: 22,
        child: Row(children: <Widget>[
          const Icon(Icons.wb_sunny_rounded, color: gold, size: 22),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Text('Wedding day weather', style: _serif(size: 22)),
                  Text(
                      ts is! Timestamp
                          ? 'Set your date and June will show what that day is usually like.'
                          : 'Tell June the city to see what that day is usually like there.',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 12, color: muted, height: 1.35)),
                ]),
          ),
        ]),
      );
    }
    final DateTime weddingDay = ts.toDate();
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> extra = _keyDates(couple);
    // Which day is on the card: the wedding, or one of their key dates.
    DateTime wedding = weddingDay;
    String title = 'Wedding day';
    Map<String, dynamic>? selKd;
    for (final Map<String, dynamic> kd in extra) {
      final DateTime d = (kd['date'] as Timestamp).toDate();
      if (_ymd(d) == _wxSel) {
        wedding = d;
        title = kd['label'].toString();
        selKd = kd;
      }
    }
    WidgetsBinding.instance
        .addPostFrameCallback((_) => _loadWeather(wedding, metro));
    final Map<String, dynamic>? w = _wxCache['${_ymd(wedding)}|$metro'];
    final String city = _metroLabel(metro);
    final Widget chips = SizedBox(
      height: 32,
      child: ListView(scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal, children: <Widget>[
        _wxChip('Wedding day', _shortDate(weddingDay), selKd == null,
            () => setState(() => _wxSel = '')),
        for (final Map<String, dynamic> kd in extra)
          _wxChip(
              kd['label'].toString(),
              _shortDate((kd['date'] as Timestamp).toDate()),
              selKd == kd,
              () => setState(
                  () => _wxSel = _ymd((kd['date'] as Timestamp).toDate()))),
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
          child: ActionChip(
            avatar: const Icon(Icons.add_rounded, size: 15, color: plum),
            label: const Text('Add a date',
                style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11.5, color: plum, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
            backgroundColor: ivory,
            side: const BorderSide(color: goldLine),
            onPressed: _h(() => _addKeyDate(couple)),
          ),
        ),
      ]),
    );
    Widget body;
    if (w == null) {
      body = Row(children: <Widget>[
        const SizedBox(
            width: 18,
            height: 18,
            child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: gold)),
        const SizedBox(width: 12),
        Text(_wxErr.isEmpty ? 'Reading the sky over $city\u2026' : _wxErr,
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: muted)),
      ]);
    } else {
      final bool fc = w['mode'] == 'forecast';
      final int code = w['code'] as int;
      final String sunset = _sunsetClock((w['sunset'] ?? '').toString());
      final String rainLine = fc
          ? '${w['rainPct']}% chance of rain'
          : (w['rainYears'] == 0
              ? 'Dry on this date every one of the last ${w['years']} years'
              : 'Rained ${w['rainYears']} of the last ${w['years']} years on this date');
      body = Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: <Widget>[
            Row(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Icon(_wmoIcon(code), color: gold, size: 44),
                  const SizedBox(width: 14),
                  // Expanded, because without it this column is handed
                  // unbounded width and asks for whatever the city line needs.
                  // 'Typically drizzle - Dallas-Fort Worth' is about 230px, and
                  // icon + gap + that + the pill is wider than the card. A
                  // short city name hid it; a hyphenated metro does not.
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          // Scales down rather than overflowing if the temps
                          // and a long pill ever fight over the same row.
                          FittedBox(
                            fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                            alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                            child: Row(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.baseline,
                                textBaseline: TextBaseline.alphabetic,
                                children: <Widget>[
                                  Text('${w['hi']}\u00b0',
                                      style: _serif(size: 38, height: 1)),
                                  const SizedBox(width: 6),
                                  Text('/ ${w['lo']}\u00b0',
                                      style: _serif(
                                          size: 20, color: muted, height: 1)),
                                ]),
                          ),

    return _glass(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),

  // ---------------- v106: SEND TO YOUR VENDORS ----------------
  // One sheet, many artifacts. Every "send" is a message in the booked
  // vendor's inquiry thread plus a printable HTML file in
  // inquiries/{id}/attachments (text-only fallback if Storage says no), and
  // a couples/{cid}/sends/{kind} doc so the source card can say who has it
  // and since when. The artifacts are small render functions below.

  static const String pageMusic = 'Music';

  void _openMusic() {
    try {
      context.pushNamed(pageMusic);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO music nav: ' + e.toString());
      _toast('Could not open Music - try again.');
    }
  }

  CollectionReference<Map<String, dynamic>> get _sendsRef =>
      _coupleRef.collection('sends');

  CollectionReference<Map<String, dynamic>> get _detailsRef =>
      _coupleRef.collection('details');

  static String _catTag(String cat) {
    final String c = cat.toLowerCase();
    if (c.contains('plann') || c.contains('coordinat')) return 'planner';
    if (c.contains('dj') || c.contains('band') || c.contains('music')) {
      return 'dj';
    }
    if (c.contains('cater')) return 'caterer';
    if (c.contains('venue')) return 'venue';
    if (c.contains('photo')) return 'photo';
    if (c.contains('video') || c.contains('film')) return 'video';
    if (c.contains('officiant')) return 'officiant';
    if (c.contains('flor')) return 'florist';
    if (c.contains('cake') || c.contains('bak')) return 'cake';
    return '';
  }

  static String _esc(String s) => s
      .replaceAll('&', '&amp;')
      .replaceAll('<', '&lt;')
      .replaceAll('>', '&gt;')
      .replaceAll('"', '&quot;');

  // Booked vendors, planner first, then by name. Booked = the thread says
  // booked or the contract is signed.
  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _bookedForSend() async {
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> out = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    try {
      QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? qs = _inqLatest();
      qs ??= await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
          .get();
      for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in qs.docs) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
        final bool booked = (m['status'] ?? '').toString() == 'booked' ||
            (m['contractStatus'] ?? '').toString() == 'signed';
        if (!booked) continue;
        final Map<String, dynamic> intent = m['structuredIntent'] is Map
            ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(m['structuredIntent'] as Map)
            : <String, dynamic>{};
        final String cat =
            (m['vendorCategory'] ?? m['category'] ?? intent['category'] ?? '')
                .toString();
        out.add(<String, dynamic>{
          'id': d.id,
          'name': (m['vendorName'] ?? 'Your vendor').toString(),
          'vendorId': (m['vendorId'] ?? '').toString(),
          'cat': cat,
          'label': _catLabel(cat),
          'tag': _catTag(cat),
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO booked for send: ' + e.toString());
    }
    out.sort((Map<String, dynamic> a, Map<String, dynamic> b) {
      final int pa = a['tag'] == 'planner' ? 0 : 1;
      final int pb = b['tag'] == 'planner' ? 0 : 1;
      if (pa != pb) return pa.compareTo(pb);
      return a['name'].toString().compareTo(b['name'].toString());
    });
    return out;
  }

  String _printShell(String title, String subtitle, String bodyHtml) {
    return '<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8">'
        '<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">'
        '<title>${_esc(title)}</title><style>'
        'body{font-family:Georgia,serif;color:#241E2B;margin:0;padding:32px;background:#fff}'
        'h1{font-weight:600;font-size:30px;margin:0 0 4px;color:#52284F}'
        '.sub{color:#6B5F72;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:22px}'
        'h2{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#52284F;margin:26px 0 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #E6D6B8;padding-bottom:4px}'
        'table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-family:Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px}'
        'td,th{text-align:left;padding:7px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #F0E8D8;vertical-align:top}'
        'th{font-size:11px;color:#6B5F72;font-weight:600}'
        'p,li{font-family:Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.5}'
        '.time{display:inline-block;min-width:68px;font-weight:700;color:#8A6A2F}'
        '.foot{margin-top:34px;color:#6B5F72;font-size:11px;font-family:Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif}'
        '.btn{position:fixed;top:14px;right:14px;background:#52284F;color:#fff;border:0;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:999px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer}'
        '@media print{.btn{display:none}body{padding:0}}'
        '</style></head><body>'
        '<button class="btn" onclick="window.print()">Print / Save as PDF</button>'
        '<h1>${_esc(title)}</h1><div class="sub">${_esc(subtitle)}</div>'
        '$bodyHtml'
        '<div class="foot">Planned on Lazo &middot; meetlazo.com</div>'
        '</body></html>';
  }

  String _coupleLabel(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    final String n = (couple['names'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (n.isNotEmpty) return n;
    return (couple['partnerName'] ?? '').toString().trim();
  }

  String _weddingDateLine(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    final dynamic ts = couple['weddingDate'];
    if (ts is Timestamp) return _longDate(ts.toDate());
    return '';
  }

  // The sheet. kind is the sends/{kind} key; tags pre-check vendors whose
  // category matches (empty list = everyone checked).
  Future<void> _sendToVendors({
    required String kind,
    required String title,
    required String fileName,
    required String page,
    required String text,
    required List<String> tags,
    String note = '',
    String preview = '',
    // JC-LAZO-COUPLE-0920-TL-001: a page and text built for one vendor
    // (their role's moments first). Null keeps one page for everyone.
    String Function(Map<String, dynamic> vendor)? pageFor,
    String Function(Map<String, dynamic> vendor)? textFor,
  }) async {
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> booked = await _bookedForSend();
    if (!mounted) return;
    final Set<String> picked = <String>{};
    for (final Map<String, dynamic> v in booked) {
      if (tags.isEmpty || tags.contains(v['tag'])) {
        picked.add(v['id'].toString());
      }
    }
    if (picked.isEmpty && booked.isNotEmpty) {
      picked.add(booked.first['id'].toString());
    }
    final TextEditingController noteC = TextEditingController(text: note);
    bool busy = false;
    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx, StateSetter setS) => Padding(
          padding:
              EdgeInsets.only(bottom: MediaQuery.of(ctx).viewInsets.bottom),
          child: Container(
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
            margin: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 18, 20, 20),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: _lzBg(cardBg),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
              border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(goldLine)),
            ),
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Row(children: <Widget>[
                    Expanded(
                        child: Text('Send $title', style: _serif(size: 26))),
                    IconButton(
                        onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.of(ctx).pop()),
                        icon:  Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                  ]),
                  if (preview.isNotEmpty)
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
                      child: Text(preview,
                          style:  TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted), height: 1.4)),
                    ),
                  if (booked.isEmpty)
                     Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                      child: Text(
                          'No booked vendors on Lazo yet. When a vendor is booked here, this lands straight in their thread. Until then, email it or copy the text below.',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 13, color: _lzFg(muted), height: 1.45)),
                    )
                  else ...<Widget>[
                     Text('WHO GETS IT',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 10.5,
                            letterSpacing: 2,
                            color: _lzFg(plum),
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    ...booked.map((Map<String, dynamic> v) {
                      final String id = v['id'].toString();
                      final bool on = picked.contains(id);
                      final String nm = v['name'].toString();
                      final String initials = nm
                          .split(' ')
                          .where((String w) => w.isNotEmpty)
                          .take(2)
                          .map((String w) => w[0].toUpperCase())
                          .join();
                      return _Press(
                        tick: _Tick.select,
                        onTap: () => setS(() {

                            picked.add(id);
                          }
                        }),
                        child: AnimatedContainer(
                          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 160),
                          margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(10, 9, 12, 9),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: _lzBg(on
                                ? Colors.white
                                : Colors.white.withOpacity(.55)),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                            border: Border.all(
                                color: _lzLine(on ? plum : goldLine),
                                width: on ? 1.6 : 1),
                          ),
                          child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                            Container(
                              width: 36,
                              height: 36,
                              alignment: Alignment.center,
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color: _lzBg(on ? plum : gold.withOpacity(.25)),
                                  shape: BoxShape.circle),
                              child: Text(initials.isEmpty ? '?' : initials,
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      color: _lzFg(on ? gold : plum),
                                      fontSize: 12.5,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 11),
                            Expanded(
                              child: Column(
                                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                  children: <Widget>[
                                    Text(nm,
                                        style:  TextStyle(
                                            color: _lzFg(ink),
                                            fontSize: 14,
                                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),

                                        style:  TextStyle(
                                            fontSize: 11.5, color: _lzFg(muted))),

                            ),

                                on

                                for (final Map<String, dynamic> v in booked) {

                      label:  Text('Print',

                  ]),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // Printable page in a new tab (web). Same trick the seating chart uses.
  void _openHtml(String page, [String text = '']) {
    if (!kIsWeb) {
      // Phones have no new tab to print from; the text version goes to the
      // clipboard for Notes or Messages, and Email it carries it as well.
      Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: text.isEmpty ? page : text));
      _toast('Copied - paste it into Notes, Messages or an email.');
      return;
    }
    try {
      final html.Blob blob = html.Blob(<String>[page], 'text/html');
      final String url = html.Url.createObjectUrlFromBlob(blob);
      html.window.open(url, '_blank');
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO print: ' + e.toString());
      _toast('Could not open the printable page.');
    }
  }

  Future<bool> _sendArtifact(String inquiryId, String fileName, String page,
      String note, String text, String title) async {
    final DocumentReference<Map<String, dynamic>> ref =
        FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('inquiries').doc(inquiryId);
    Map<String, dynamic>? att;
    try {
      final Uint8List bytes = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(page));
      final String safe = fileName.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^A-Za-z0-9._-]'), '_');
      final String path =
          'inquiries/$inquiryId/attachments/${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}_$safe';
      final Reference r = FirebaseStorage.instance.ref(path);
      await r.putData(bytes, SettableMetadata(contentType: 'text/html'));
      final String url = await r.getDownloadURL();
      att = <String, dynamic>{
        'url': url,
        'name': fileName,
        'type': 'text/html',
        'size': bytes.length,
        'path': path,
      };
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO send attach: ' + e.toString());
      att = null;
    }
    // Rules cap a message at 3,000 characters; the file has everything.
    String body = '${note.isEmpty ? 'Here\u2019s our $title.' : note}\n\n$text';
    if (body.length >= 2900) {
      body =
          body.substring(0, 2860) + '\u2026\n\n(The full $title is attached.)';
    }
    try {
      final Map<String, dynamic> msg = <String, dynamic>{
        'senderRole': 'couple',
        'text': body,
        'at': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      };
      if (att != null) msg['attachment'] = att;
      try {
        await ref.collection('messages').add(msg);
      } catch (e) {
        if (att == null) rethrow;
        msg.remove('attachment');
        await ref.collection('messages').add(msg);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Could not send: $e');
      return false;
    }
    try {
      await ref.set(<String, dynamic>{
        'lastMessageAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'lastMessageRole': 'couple',
        'lastMessagePreview': '${_tc(title)} from the couple',
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    } catch (_) {
      // onMessageWritten keeps the thread header honest if the rules say no.
    }
    return true;
  }

  // "Sent to Maria, Tony \u00b7 Sep 12" under a source card.
  Widget _sentLine(String kind) {
    return StreamBuilder<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _liveDoc('send:$kind:$_cid', () => _sendsRef.doc(kind)),
      initialData: _liveD['send:$kind:$_cid']?.latest,
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> d = s.data?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        final List<dynamic> to =
            d['to'] is List ? d['to'] as List : <dynamic>[];
        if (to.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
        final String names = to
            .map((dynamic e) => e is Map ? (e['vendorName'] ?? '') : '')
            .where((dynamic e) => e.toString().isNotEmpty)
            .join(', ');
        final String when = d['at'] is Timestamp
            ? _shortDate((d['at'] as Timestamp).toDate())
            : '';
        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
          child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
             Icon(Icons.check_circle_rounded, color: _lzFg(vGreen), size: 13),
            const SizedBox(width: 5),
            Flexible(
              child: Text(
                  'Sent to $names${when.isEmpty ? '' : ' \u00b7 $when'}',
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: _lzFg(muted))),
            ),
          ]),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  // ---- artifact 1: vendor team sheet ----
  Future<void> _sendTeamSheet(Map<String, dynamic> couple,
      Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan) async {
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> booked = await _bookedForSend();
    final List<Map<String, String>> rows = <Map<String, String>>[];
    final Set<String> seenCats = <String>{};
    for (final Map<String, dynamic> v in booked) {
      Map<String, dynamic> vd = <String, dynamic>{};
      final String vid = v['vendorId'].toString();
      if (vid.isNotEmpty) {
        try {
          final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> s =
              await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                  .collection('vendors')
                  .doc(vid)
                  .get();
          vd = s.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      final String cat = v['cat'].toString();
      seenCats.add(cat);
      rows.add(<String, String>{
        'role': v['label'].toString(),
        'name': v['name'].toString(),
        'contact': (vd['contactName'] ?? vd['ownerName'] ?? '').toString(),
        'email': (vd['email'] ?? vd['contactEmail'] ?? vd['publicEmail'] ?? '')
            .toString(),
        'phone': (vd['phone'] ?? '').toString(),
        'site': (vd['website'] ?? '').toString(),
        'contract':
            ((plan[cat] ?? const <String, dynamic>{})['contractUrl'] ?? '')
                    .toString()
                    .isNotEmpty
                ? 'On file'
                : 'Booked on Lazo',
      });
    }
    // Vendors booked off Lazo (typed into the plan) still belong on the sheet.
    for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
      final String slug = c['slug']!;
      final Map<String, dynamic> p = plan[slug] ?? const <String, dynamic>{};
      if ((p['status'] ?? '') != 'booked' || seenCats.contains(slug)) continue;
      final String vn = (p['vendorName'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      rows.add(<String, String>{
        'role': c['label']!,
        'name': vn.isEmpty ? 'Booked' : vn,
        'contact': '',
        'email': '',
        'phone': '',
        'site': '',
        'contract': (p['contractUrl'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty
            ? 'On file'
            : 'Booked elsewhere',
      });
    }
    if (rows.isEmpty) {
      _toast('Book a vendor or two first - the sheet lists your booked team.');
      return;
    }
    final String who = _coupleLabel(couple);
    final String when = _weddingDateLine(couple);
    final StringBuffer t = StringBuffer();
    t.writeln(
        'VENDOR TEAM${who.isEmpty ? '' : ' - $who'}${when.isEmpty ? '' : ' - $when'}');
    t.writeln('');
    final StringBuffer h = StringBuffer();
    h.write(
        '<table><tr><th>Role</th><th>Vendor</th><th>Contact</th><th>Status</th></tr>');
    for (final Map<String, String> r in rows) {
      final List<String> bits = <String>[
        if (r['contact']!.isNotEmpty) r['contact']!,
        if (r['email']!.isNotEmpty) r['email']!,
        if (r['phone']!.isNotEmpty) r['phone']!,
        if (r['site']!.isNotEmpty) r['site']!,
      ];
      t.writeln(
          '${r['role']}: ${r['name']}${bits.isEmpty ? '' : ' - ${bits.join(' \u00b7 ')}'}');
      h.write(
          '<tr><td>${_esc(r['role']!)}</td><td><b>${_esc(r['name']!)}</b></td>'
          '<td>${bits.map(_esc).join('<br>')}</td><td>${_esc(r['contract']!)}</td></tr>');
    }
    h.write('</table>');
    await _sendToVendors(
      kind: 'team',
      title: 'vendor team sheet',
      fileName: 'Vendor team.html',
      page: _printShell(
          'Vendor team',
          <String>[if (who.isNotEmpty) who, if (when.isNotEmpty) when]
              .join(' \u00b7 '),
          h.toString()),
      text: t.toString(),
      tags: <String>['planner', 'venue'],
      note:
          'Here\u2019s everyone we\u2019ve booked so far, with contact details, so you know who to expect that day.',
      preview:
          '${rows.length} vendor${rows.length == 1 ? '' : 's'} with roles, contact details and contract status.',
    );
  }

  // ---- artifact 2: day-of timeline ----
  Future<void> _sendTimeline(
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> evs,
      List<List<String>> team,
      Map<String, dynamic> couple) async {
    if (evs.isEmpty) {
      _toast('Add a moment or two first.');
      return;
    }
    final String who = _coupleLabel(couple);
    final String when = _weddingDateLine(couple);
    final StringBuffer t = StringBuffer();
    t.writeln('DAY-OF TIMELINE${when.isEmpty ? '' : ' - $when'}');
    t.writeln('');
    final StringBuffer h = StringBuffer('<table>');
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in evs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> ev = d.data();
      final String clock = _tlRange(ev);
      final String label = (ev['label'] ?? '').toString();
      final String note = (ev['note'] ?? '').toString();
      t.writeln('$clock  $label${note.isEmpty ? '' : ' - $note'}');
      h.write(
          '<tr><td class="time">${_esc(clock)}</td><td><b>${_esc(label)}</b>'
          '${note.isEmpty ? '' : '<br><span style="color:#6B5F72">${_esc(note)}</span>'}</td></tr>');
    }
    h.write('</table>');
    if (team.isNotEmpty) {
      t.writeln('');
      t.writeln('THE TEAM');
      h.write('<h2>The team</h2><table>');
      for (final List<String> x in team) {
        t.writeln('${x[0]}: ${x[1].isEmpty ? 'Booked' : x[1]}');
        h.write(
            '<tr><td>${_esc(x[0])}</td><td><b>${_esc(x[1].isEmpty ? 'Booked' : x[1])}</b></td></tr>');
      }
      h.write('</table>');
    }
    await _sendToVendors(
      kind: 'timeline',
      title: 'day-of timeline',
      fileName: 'Day-of timeline.html',
      page: _printShell(
          'Day-of timeline',
          <String>[if (who.isNotEmpty) who, if (when.isNotEmpty) when]
              .join(' \u00b7 '),
          h.toString()),
      text: t.toString(),
      tags: <String>[],
      // JC-LAZO-COUPLE-0920-TL-001: each vendor's page opens with their moments.
      pageFor: (Map<String, dynamic> v) => _tlVendorHtml(
          evs, team, couple, (v['tag'] ?? '').toString(), v['name'].toString()),
      textFor: (Map<String, dynamic> v) =>
          _tlVendorText(evs, couple, (v['tag'] ?? '').toString()),
      note:
          'Here\u2019s our day-of timeline as it stands - your moments are at the top. Tell us if any of your times need to shift.',
      preview:
          '${evs.length} moment${evs.length == 1 ? '' : 's'} from ${_fmtClock((evs.first.data()['time'] ?? '').toString())} to ${_fmtClock((evs.last.data()['time'] ?? '').toString())}. Goes to every booked vendor by default.',
    );
  }

  // ---- artifact 3: guest list + meals (the caterer sheet) ----
  Future<void> _sendGuestSheet(
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs,
      Map<String, dynamic> couple) async {
    if (docs.isEmpty) {
      _toast('Add guests first.');
      return;
    }
    final String text = _guestListText(docs);
    int heads = 0;
    int yes = 0;
    int pend = 0;
    final Map<String, int> meals = <String, int>{};
    final List<List<String>> people = <List<String>>[];
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> g = d.data();
      final String r = (g['rsvp'] ?? 'pending').toString();
      if (r == 'no') continue;
      final int plus = ((g['plusOnes'] ?? 0) as num).toInt();
      heads += 1 + plus;
      if (r == 'yes') {
        yes += 1 + plus;
      } else {
        pend += 1 + plus;
      }
      final String m = (g['meal'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      if (m.isNotEmpty) meals[m] = (meals[m] ?? 0) + 1;
      people.add(<String>[
        (g['name'] ?? '').toString(),
        r == 'yes' ? 'Attending' : 'Pending',
        plus > 0 ? '+$plus' : '',
        m,
        (g['allergies'] ?? '').toString(),
        (g['tableName'] ?? '').toString(),
      ]);
    }
    people.sort((List<String> a, List<String> b) =>
        a[0].toLowerCase().compareTo(b[0].toLowerCase()));
    final StringBuffer h = StringBuffer();
    h.write(
        '<p><b>Headcount: $heads</b> &middot; $yes confirmed &middot; $pend pending</p>');
    if (meals.isNotEmpty) {
      h.write('<h2>Meals</h2><table>');
      meals.forEach((String m, int n) =>
          h.write('<tr><td>${_esc(m)}</td><td><b>$n</b></td></tr>'));
      h.write('</table>');
    }
    h.write(
        '<h2>Guests</h2><table><tr><th>Name</th><th>RSVP</th><th>+1s</th><th>Meal</th><th>Allergies / dietary</th><th>Table</th></tr>');
    for (final List<String> p in people) {
      h.write('<tr>${p.map((String x) => '<td>${_esc(x)}</td>').join()}</tr>');
    }
    h.write('</table>');
    final String who = _coupleLabel(couple);
    final String when = _weddingDateLine(couple);
    await _sendToVendors(
      kind: 'guests',
      title: 'guest list & meals',
      fileName: 'Guest list.html',
      page: _printShell(
          'Guest list & meals',
          <String>[if (who.isNotEmpty) who, if (when.isNotEmpty) when]
              .join(' \u00b7 '),
          h.toString()),
      text: text,
      tags: <String>['caterer', 'venue', 'planner'],
      note:
          'Here\u2019s our guest list with meal choices and dietary notes. Counts will move a little until RSVPs close.',
      preview:
          'Headcount $heads ($yes confirmed, $pend pending), meal counts, allergies, and table assignments where set.',
    );
  }
