  Future<void> _editDetails(String kind) async {
    Map<String, dynamic> cur = <String, dynamic>{};
    try {
      cur = (await _detailsRef.doc(kind).get()).data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    } catch (_) {}
    final List<List<String>> fields = _detailFields[kind]!;
    final Map<String, List<String>> items = <String, List<String>>{
      for (final List<String> f in fields)
        f[0]: (cur[f[0]] ?? '')
            .toString()
            .split('\n')
            .map((String l) => l.trim())
            .where((String l) => l.isNotEmpty)
            .toList(),
    };
    final Map<String, TextEditingController> adders =
        <String, TextEditingController>{
      for (final List<String> f in fields) f[0]: TextEditingController(),
    };
    final Map<String, List<String>> starters =
        _detailStarters[kind] ?? <String, List<String>>{};
    final String title =
        kind == 'photos' ? 'Photo groups & shot list' : 'Ceremony order';
    final String blurb = kind == 'photos'
        ? 'Your photographer plans the day around this. Names help - "Aunt May" beats "an aunt".'
        : 'Your officiant, planner and DJ all read this one. Order matters - drag is coming; for now add in order.';
    if (!mounted) return;
    bool saving = false;
    Future<void> save() async {
      await _detailsRef.doc(kind).set(<String, dynamic>{
        for (final List<String> f in fields) f[0]: items[f[0]]!.join('\n'),
        'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    }

    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 640),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) =>
          StatefulBuilder(builder: (BuildContext sc, StateSetter setSheet) {
        int total = 0;
        for (final List<String> l in items.values) total += l.length;
        Widget section(List<String> f) {
          final String key = f[0];
          final List<String> list = items[key]!;
          final bool multiline = key == 'notes' || key == 'readings';
          return Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 12, 14, 12),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: _lzBg(Colors.white.withOpacity(.8)),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(goldLine))),
            child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Row(children: <Widget>[
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(f[1].toUpperCase(),
                          style:  TextStyle(
                              color: _lzFg(plum),
                              fontSize: 10.5,
                              letterSpacing: 1.6,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    ),
                    if (list.isEmpty &&
                        (starters[key] ?? const <String>[]).isNotEmpty)
                      _Press(
                        tick: _Tick.select,
                        onTap: () =>
                            setSheet(() => list.addAll(starters[key]!)),
                        child: Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 9, vertical: 4),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: gold.withOpacity(.18),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                              border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.6))),
                          child:  Text('Use a typical list',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  color: _lzFg(plumDeep),
                                  fontSize: 10.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        ),
                      ),
                  ]),
                  if (list.isEmpty)
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8, bottom: 4),
                      child: Text(f[2].replaceAll('\n', ' \u00b7 '),
                          style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 12,
                              color: _lzFg(ink.withOpacity(.4)),
                              height: 1.4)),
                    ),
                  ...list.asMap().entries.map((MapEntry<int, String> e) =>
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 6),
                        child: Row(
                            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                            children: <Widget>[
                              Container(
                                  width: 22,
                                  height: 22,
                                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 1),
                                  alignment: Alignment.center,
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                      color: gold.withOpacity(.2),
                                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999)),
                                  child: Text('${e.key + 1}',
                                      style:  TextStyle(
                                          color: _lzFg(plum),
                                          fontSize: 11,
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800))),
                              const SizedBox(width: 9),
                              Expanded(
                                child: _Press(
                                  tick: _Tick.select,
                                  onTap: () async {
                                    final TextEditingController ec =
                                        TextEditingController(text: e.value);
                                    final String? v = await showDialog<String>(
                                      context: sc,
                                      builder: (BuildContext dctx) =>
                                          AlertDialog(
                                        backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
                                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                            borderRadius:
                                                BorderRadius.circular(18)),
                                        title: Text(f[1],
                                            style:  TextStyle(
                                                color: _lzFg(plum),
                                                fontSize: 16,
                                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                                        content: TextField(
                                            controller: ec,
                                            autofocus: true,
                                            maxLines: multiline ? 4 : 2,
                                            style:  TextStyle(
                                                color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14.5),
                                            decoration: _lightDeco('Item')),
                                        actions: <Widget>[
                                          TextButton(
                                              onPressed:
                                                  _h(() => Navigator.pop(dctx)),
                                              child:  Text('Cancel',
                                                  style:
                                                      TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted)))),
                                          FilledButton(
                                              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                                                  backgroundColor: plum),
                                              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(
                                                  dctx, ec.text.trim())),
                                              child: const Text('Save',
                                                  style: TextStyle(
                                                      color: Colors.white))),
                                        ],
                                      ),
                                    );
                                    if (v != null)
                                      setSheet(() {
                                        if (v.isEmpty)
                                          list.removeAt(e.key);
                                        else
                                          list[e.key] = v;
                                      });
                                  },
                                  child: Text(e.value,
                                      style:  TextStyle(
                                          color: _lzFg(ink),
                                          fontSize: 14,
                                          height: 1.35)),
                                ),
                              ),
                              if (e.key > 0)
                                _Press(
                                  tick: _Tick.select,
                                  onTap: () => setSheet(() {
                                    final String x = list.removeAt(e.key);
                                    list.insert(e.key - 1, x);
                                  }),
                                  child:  Padding(
                                      padding: EdgeInsets.all(3),
                                      child: Icon(Icons.arrow_upward_rounded,
                                          size: 15, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                                ),
                              _Press(
                                tick: _Tick.select,
                                onTap: () =>
                                    setSheet(() => list.removeAt(e.key)),
                                child:  Padding(
                                    padding: EdgeInsets.all(3),
                                    child: Icon(Icons.close_rounded,
                                        size: 15, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                              ),
                            ]),
                      )),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Row(children: <Widget>[
                    Expanded(
                      child: TextField(
                        controller: adders[key],
                        textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
                        onSubmitted: (String v) {
                          if (v.trim().isEmpty) return;
                          setSheet(() {
                            list.add(v.trim());
                            adders[key]!.clear();
                          });
                        },
                        style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 13.5),
                        decoration:
                            _lightDeco(multiline ? 'Add a note' : 'Add one'),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    IconButton(
                      onPressed: _h(() {
                        final String v = adders[key]!.text.trim();
                        if (v.isEmpty) return;
                        setSheet(() {
                          list.add(v);
                          adders[key]!.clear();
                        });
                      }),
                      icon:  Icon(Icons.add_circle_rounded,
                          color: _lzFg(plum), size: 26),
                    ),
                  ]),
                ]),
          );
        }

        return SafeArea(
          child: SizedBox(
            height: MediaQuery.of(ctx).size.height * .88,
            child: Column(children: <Widget>[
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 18, 14, 8),
                child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          Text(title, style: _serif(size: 26)),
                          Text(blurb,
                              style:  TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted), height: 1.4)),
                        ]),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                      onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx)),
                      icon:  Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                ]),
              ),
              Divider(height: 1, color: gold.withOpacity(.35)),
              Expanded(
                child: ListView(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                      18, 14, 18, 14 + MediaQuery.of(ctx).viewInsets.bottom),
                  children: <Widget>[
                    for (final List<String> f in fields) section(f)
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              Divider(height: 1, color: gold.withOpacity(.35)),
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 12, 18, 14),
                child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                  Text('$total item${total == 1 ? '' : 's'}',
                      style:  TextStyle(
                          color: _lzFg(muted),
                          fontSize: 12.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  const Spacer(),
                  OutlinedButton(
                    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                        foregroundColor: _lzFg(plum),
                        side: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.8)),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 14, vertical: 12)),
                    onPressed: _h(saving
                        ? null
                        : () async {
                            setSheet(() => saving = true);
                            try {
                              await save();
                              if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                              _toast('Saved.');
                            } catch (e) {
                              setSheet(() => saving = false);
                              _toast('Could not save: $e');
                            }
                          }),
                    child: const Text('Save',
                        style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  FilledButton.icon(
                    style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: plum,
                        foregroundColor: ivory,
                        elevation: 0,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 16, vertical: 12)),
                    onPressed: _h(
                        saving || total == 0
                            ? null
                            : () async {
                                setSheet(() => saving = true);
                                try {
                                  await save();
                                  if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                                  final Map<String, dynamic> couple =
                                      _liveD['couple:$_cid']?.latest?.data() ??
                                          <String, dynamic>{};
                                  await _sendDetails(kind, couple);
                                } catch (e) {
                                  setSheet(() => saving = false);
                                  _toast('Could not save: $e');
                                }
                              },
                        _Tick.medium),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.send_rounded, size: 16),
                    label: const Text('Save & send',
                        style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  ),
                ]),
              ),
            ]),
          ),
        );
      }),
    );
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  Future<void> _sendDetails(String kind, Map<String, dynamic> couple) async {
    Map<String, dynamic> d = <String, dynamic>{};
    try {
      d = (await _detailsRef.doc(kind).get()).data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    } catch (_) {}
    final List<List<String>> fields = _detailFields[kind]!;
    final bool empty = fields
        .every((List<String> f) => (d[f[0]] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty);
    if (empty) {
      await _editDetails(kind);
      try {
        d = (await _detailsRef.doc(kind).get()).data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
      } catch (_) {}
      if (fields
          .every((List<String> f) => (d[f[0]] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty))
        return;
    }
    final String title =
        kind == 'photos' ? 'photo groups & shot list' : 'ceremony order';
    final StringBuffer t = StringBuffer();
    final StringBuffer h = StringBuffer();
    for (final List<String> f in fields) {
      final String v = (d[f[0]] ?? '').toString().trim();
      if (v.isEmpty) continue;
      final List<String> lines = v
          .split('\n')
          .map((String s) => s.trim())
          .where((String s) => s.isNotEmpty)
          .toList();
      t.writeln(f[1].toUpperCase());
      lines.forEach(t.writeln);
      t.writeln('');
      h.write(
          '<h2>${_esc(f[1])}</h2>${f[0] == 'notes' ? '<p>${lines.map(_esc).join('<br>')}</p>' : '<ol>${lines.map((String l) => '<li>${_esc(l)}</li>').join()}</ol>'}');
    }
    final String who = _coupleLabel(couple);
    final String when = _weddingDateLine(couple);
    await _sendToVendors(
      kind: kind,
      title: title,
      fileName: '${_tc(title)}.html',
      page: _printShell(
          _tc(title),
          <String>[if (who.isNotEmpty) who, if (when.isNotEmpty) when]
              .join(' \u00b7 '),
          h.toString()),
      text: t.toString(),
      tags: kind == 'photos'
          ? <String>['photo', 'video', 'planner']
          : <String>['officiant', 'planner', 'dj', 'video', 'photo'],
      note: kind == 'photos'
          ? 'Here are our photo groups and the shots that matter most to us.'
          : 'Here\u2019s the ceremony order so everyone is on the same page.',
    );
  }

  // ---- artifact 6: website + registry link (no file) ----
  Future<void> _sendSiteLinks(Map<String, dynamic> couple) async {
    String slug = '';
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> q = await FirebaseFirestore
          .instance
          .collection('weddingSites')
          .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
          .limit(1)
          .get();
      if (q.docs.isNotEmpty) slug = q.docs.first.id;
    } catch (_) {}
    if (slug.isEmpty) {
      _toast('Make your wedding website first.');
      return;
    }
    final String site = 'https://meetlazo.com/w/$slug/';
    final String text = 'Our wedding website: $site\nRegistry: $site#registry';
    await _sendToVendors(
      kind: 'site',
      title: 'website link',
      fileName: 'Wedding website.html',
      page: _printShell('Our wedding website', _coupleLabel(couple),
          '<p><a href="$site">$site</a></p><p>Registry: <a href="$site#registry">$site#registry</a></p>'),
      text: text,
      tags: <String>['planner'],
      note:
          'Our website has the schedule, travel details and registry - handy if guests ask you.',
    );
  }

    final int bookedCount = plan.values
        .where((Map<String, dynamic> p) => (p['status'] ?? '') == 'booked')

                  : _ShareState('$bookedCount booked', true),

                    sn.data?.docs ??

                return _shareRow(

                  state: gs.isEmpty
                      ? const _ShareState('No guests yet', false)
                      : _ShareState(
                          '${gs.length} guest${gs.length == 1 ? '' : 's'}',

                      ? () => setState(() => _view = _View.guests)
                      : () => _sendGuestSheet(gs, couple),

                  onEdit: gs.isEmpty
                      ? null

            _shareRow(
              kind: 'music',
              icon: Icons.music_note_rounded,
              title: 'Music',
              sub: 'Must-plays, do-not-plays, the first dance',
              state: const _ShareState('Sent from the Music page', true),
              onPrimary: _openMusic,
              primary: 'Open',
            ),
            for (final List<dynamic> k in <List<dynamic>>[
              <dynamic>[
                'photos',
                Icons.photo_camera_rounded,
                'Photo groups & shot list',
                'Wedding party, family groupings, must-haves'
              ],

                'ceremony',

                'Processional, readings, recessional'

                        ? () => _editDetails(k[0] as String)
                        : () => _sendDetails(k[0] as String, couple),
                    primary: items == 0 ? 'Fill in' : 'Send',

                        items == 0 ? null : () => _editDetails(k[0] as String),

              stream: _liveQuery(

                      .limit(1)),

                      ? () => _sendSiteLinks(couple)
                      : () => setState(() => _view = _View.website),
                  primary: has ? 'Send' : 'Build your site',
                );
              },
            ),
          ]),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _seedClassicDay(BuildContext ctx) async {
    // JC-LAZO-COUPLE-0920-TL-001: start from the website's ceremony time.
    final TimeOfDay? cer = await showTimePicker(
        context: ctx,
        initialTime: _tlSiteCeremony() ?? const TimeOfDay(hour: 16, minute: 0),
        helpText: 'WHAT TIME IS THE CEREMONY?');
    if (cer == null) return;
    final int base = cer.hour * 60 + cer.minute;
    String hm(int m) {
      final int x = ((m % 1440) + 1440) % 1440;
      return '${(x ~/ 60).toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${(x % 60).toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
    }

    // offset from the ceremony, label, note, duration, owners
    final List<List<dynamic>> classic = <List<dynamic>>[
      <dynamic>[
        -240,
        'Hair & makeup',
        'Getting-ready photos start about an hour before you\u2019re dressed',
        120,
        <String>['party']
      ],
      <dynamic>[
        -120,
        'Getting dressed',
        'Details: rings, invitation suite, shoes, perfume',
        30,
        <String>['photo', 'video', 'party']
      ],
      <dynamic>[
        -90,
        'First look',
        'Private moment, then wedding-party photos',
        45,
        <String>['photo', 'video']
      ],
      <dynamic>[
        -30,
        'Guests arrive',
        'Ceremony music starts; wedding party tucked away',
        30,
        <String>['venue', 'dj', 'planner']
      ],
      <dynamic>[
        0,
        'Ceremony',
        '',
        30,

  Future<void> _logOut() async {
    await FirebaseAuth.instance.signOut();
    if (!mounted) return;
    context.goNamed(pageWelcome);
  }

  Future<void> _deleteAccount() async {
    final u = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
    if (u == null) return;
    final sure = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
        title:  Text('Delete account?',
            style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(plum), fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
        content:  Text(
          'This permanently deletes your account and wedding plan. This can\u2019t be undone.',
          style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
              onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, false)),
              child:
                   Text('Keep my account', style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink)))),
          FilledButton(
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFB3413A),
                foregroundColor: ivory),
            onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, true)),
            child: const Text('Delete forever'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (sure != true) return;

    // Deletion runs server-side now. The old code here deleted couples/{cid} and
    // its 'plan' subcollection, swallowed every error, then deleted the login
    // regardless - leaving the wedding website, every message thread, the other
    // seven subcollections and all uploaded photos behind, and unreachable once
    // the login was gone. deleteMyAccount removes all of it and deletes the
    // login LAST, so a partial failure is retryable rather than permanent.
    // See functions-dashboard/deleteAccount.js.
    try {
      await FirebaseFunctions.instance
          .httpsCallable('deleteMyAccount')
          .call(<String, dynamic>{});
      await FirebaseAuth.instance.signOut();
      if (!mounted) return;
      context.goNamed(pageWelcome);
      return;
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      _toast(e.message ?? 'We could not delete your account just now.');
      return;
    } on FirebaseAuthException catch (e) {
      if (e.code == 'requires-recent-login') {
        final email = u.email ?? '';
        final passC = TextEditingController();
        final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
          context: context,
          builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
            backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
            shape:
                RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
            title:  Text('Confirm it\u2019s you',
                style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(plum), fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            content: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                 Text(
                    'For security, enter your password to delete your account.',
                    style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 13.5)),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextField(
                  controller: passC,
                  obscureText: true,
                  style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                  decoration: _lightDeco('Password'),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                  onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, false)),
                  child:  Text('Cancel', style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink)))),
              FilledButton(
                style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFB3413A),
                    foregroundColor: ivory),
                onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx, true)),
                child: const Text('Delete'),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
        if (ok != true) return;
        try {
          await u.reauthenticateWithCredential(
              EmailAuthProvider.credential(email: email, password: passC.text));
          await FirebaseFunctions.instance
              .httpsCallable('deleteMyAccount')
              .call(<String, dynamic>{});
          await FirebaseAuth.instance.signOut();
          if (!mounted) return;
          context.goNamed(pageWelcome);
        } catch (_) {
          if (!mounted) return;
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
              backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
              behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
              content:  Text(
                  'Password didn\u2019t match \u2014 account not deleted.',
                  style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontWeight: FontWeight.w600))));
        }
      }
    }
  }

    }
    return _frame(
      StreamBuilder<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
        stream: _liveDoc('couple:$_cid', () => _coupleRef),
        initialData: _liveD['couple:$_cid']?.latest,
        builder: (context, coupleSnap) {
          final couple = coupleSnap.data?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
          return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
            stream: _liveQuery('plan:$_cid', () => _planRef),
            initialData: _liveQ['plan:$_cid']?.latest,
            builder: (context, planSnap) {
              final plan = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{
                for (final d in planSnap.data?.docs ??
                    <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[])
                  d.id: d.data()
              };
              _syncBookedFromInquiries(plan);
              return _withPreviewBar(_shell(couple, plan));
            },
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  // v145: hand the signed-in couple to the June hub with a one-hour custom token
  // JC-LAZO-JUNE-EMBED-1008-001: the hub URL, signed in through the juneToken callable (one hour), plain URL as the fallback
  Future<String> _juneUrl({bool embed = false}) async {
    String url = kJuneHubUrl + (embed ? '?embed=1' : '');
    try {
      final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable(
          'juneToken',
          options: HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: const Duration(seconds: 15)));
      final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> r =
          await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{});
      final String t = ((r.data as Map)['token'] ?? '').toString();
      if (t.isNotEmpty) {
        url = '$kJuneHubUrl?${embed ? 'embed=1&' : ''}t=${Uri.encodeComponent(t)}';
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO juneToken: ' + e.toString());
    }
    return url;
  }

  Future<void> _talkToJune() async {
    final String url = await _juneUrl();
    try {
      await launchUrl(Uri.parse(url),
          mode: kIsWeb ? LaunchMode.externalApplication : LaunchMode.inAppWebView);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO june hub: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  void _askJune(String q) {
    final String t = q.trim();
    _askC.clear();
    setState(() => _view = _View.june);
    if (t.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }
    _juneC.text = t;
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (mounted) {
        _juneSend();
      }
    });
  }

  Widget _activeScreen(
      Map<String, dynamic> couple, Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan) {
    if (_view == _View.vendors) return _vendorScreen(couple, plan);
    if (_view == _View.registry) return _registryScreen(couple);
    if (_view == _View.shopping) return _shoppingScreen(couple);
    if (_view == _View.board) return _boardScreen(couple);
    if (_view == _View.guests) return _guestScreen();
    if (_view == _View.website) return _websiteScreen(couple);
    if (_view == _View.june) return _juneScreen();
    if (_view == _View.messages) return _messagesScreen();
    if (_view == _View.dayof) return _dayOfScreen(couple, plan);
    if (_view == _View.browse) return _browseScreen();
    if (_view == _View.account) return _accountScreen(couple);
    return _hub(couple, plan);
  }

  String _railMoney(double v) {
    final String s = v.round().toString();
    final StringBuffer b = StringBuffer();
    for (int i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
      if (i > 0 && (s.length - i) % 3 == 0) {
        b.write(',');
      }
      b.write(s[i]);
    }
    return '\u0024' + b.toString();
  }

  // v108: the brand, tinted for the dark canvas. Same file the site uses.
  static const String kWordmark = 'https://meetlazo.com/assets/brand.png';

  Widget _lazoMark({double height = 22, Color color = ivory}) {
    return _Press(
      onTap: () => setState(() => _view = _View.hub),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4, vertical: 4),
        child: Image.network(
          kWordmark,
          height: height,
          color: _lzFg(color),
          colorBlendMode: BlendMode.srcIn,
          filterQuality: FilterQuality.medium,
          errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => Text('LAZO',
              style: _serif(
                      size: height * 1.15,
                      color: _lzFg(color),
                      weight: FontWeight.w600)

        ),
      ),

  }

  // ---------------- HUB ----------------  // ---------------- HUB ----------------

  Widget _hub(
      Map<String, dynamic> couple, Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _inqStream(),
      initialData: _inqLatest(),
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> inqs =
            _inqList(s);
        DateTime? weddingDate;
        final dynamic ts = couple['weddingDate'];
        if (ts is Timestamp) weddingDate = ts.toDate();
        final int? daysOut = weddingDate == null
            ? null
            : DateTime(weddingDate.year, weddingDate.month, weddingDate.day)
                .difference(DateTime(DateTime.now().year, DateTime.now().month,
                    DateTime.now().day))
                .inDays;
        final String firstName =
            (FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.displayName ?? '')
                .split(' ')
                .first;
        final String? photoUrl = (couple['photoUrl'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty
            ? null
            : couple['photoUrl'].toString();
        final bool needsSetup = weddingDate == null ||
            (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty ||
            (couple['names'] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty;
        final List<List<dynamic>> steps =
            _juneSteps(couple, plan, inqs, weddingDate, daysOut);
        _syncFolds(couple);
        _maybeStartCoupleTour(couple, needsSetup);
        return LayoutBuilder(builder: (BuildContext lc, BoxConstraints cons) {
          final bool twoUp = cons.maxWidth >= 720;
          return ListView(
            cacheExtent: 4000,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 16, 18, 96),
            children: <Widget>[
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
                child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                    child: !_hasRail
                        ? Align(
                            alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                            child: _lazoMark(height: 22, color: gold))
                        : Text(
                            firstName.isEmpty
                                ? 'Your wedding'
                                : 'Hi, $firstName',
                            style: _serif(
                                size: 30,
                                weight: FontWeight.w500,
                                color: ivory)),
                  ),
                  // JC-LAZO-VIEWSWITCH-0917-002: labelled so a store reviewer
                  // can find it without guessing, and shown only to the review
                  // account. Pure navigation - role is untouched; _markViewSwitch()
                  // is what stops VendorHome's own role guard from bouncing a
                  // couple-role account straight back here.
                  if (FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.email ==
                      'demo@meetlazo.com') ...<Widget>[
                    _Press(
                      scale: .96,
                      onTap: () async {
                        await _markViewSwitch();
                        if (mounted) {
                          context.goNamed('VendorHome');
                        }
                      },
                      child: Container(
                        height: 44,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: gold,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                        ),
                        child: Row(
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: <Widget>[
                            const Icon(Icons.storefront_rounded,
                                color: plumDeep, size: 17),
                            const SizedBox(width: 7),
                            Text('Vendor view',
                                style: GoogleFonts.inter(
                                    fontSize: 13.5,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                    color: plumDeep)),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  ],
                  _roundBtn(Icons.ios_share_rounded, () => _shareLazo()),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  _msgHeaderButton(),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  _Press(
                    onTap: () => setState(() => _view = _View.account),
                    child: Container(
                      width: 44,
                      height: 44,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                        color: _lzBg(ivory.withOpacity(.14)),
                        border:
                            Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.8), width: 1.4),
                        image: photoUrl != null
                            ? DecorationImage(
                                image: NetworkImage(photoUrl),
                                fit: BoxFit.cover,
                                alignment: _photoAlign(couple))
                            : null,
                      ),
                      child: photoUrl == null
                          ? const Icon(Icons.person_rounded,
                              color: gold, size: 22)
                          : null,
                    ),
                  ),
                ]),
              ),
              if (needsSetup)
                KeyedSubtree(key: _kTourSetup, child: _setupCard(couple)),
              if (!needsSetup) _importCard(couple),
              KeyedSubtree(
                  key: _kTourHero,
                  child: _heroToday(
                      couple, plan, inqs, weddingDate, daysOut, steps)),
              if (daysOut == 0) _weddingDayBanner(couple),
              _linkBookingBanner(couple, inqs),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              // v131: the two big cards fold to a line.
              _fold('weather', 'Weather', _weatherFoldSummary(couple),
                  _weatherHubWidget(couple)),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              KeyedSubtree(
                  key: _kTourWeek,
                  child: _fold(
                      'week',
                      'This week',
                      steps.isEmpty
                          ? 'Nothing is waiting on you'
                          : '${steps.length > 3 ? 3 : steps.length} thing${steps.length == 1 ? '' : 's'} from June, in order',
                      _juneWeekCard(steps, inqs))),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              // v120: the desk - one tile per screen, one line of truth each.
              _deskTiles(couple, plan, inqs, weddingDate, daysOut, twoUp),
            ],
          );
        });
      },
    );
  }

  // ---------------- v91: JUNE'S READ + THREE STEPS ----------------
  // Rule-based until her function lands: what is actually waiting on them,
  // in order. [title, why, cta, action]
  List<List<dynamic>> _juneSteps(
      Map<String, dynamic> couple,
      Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan,
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> inqs,
      DateTime? wedding,
      int? daysOut) {
    final List<List<dynamic>> out = <List<dynamic>>[];
    // v139: after the wedding, June stops saying "talk to three venues"
    if (daysOut != null && daysOut < 0) {
      out.add(<dynamic>[
        'Send the thank-you notes',
        'Tick each one off on the guest list as it goes out - the count at the top keeps you honest.',
        'Open guests',
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.guests),
      ]);
      out.add(<dynamic>[
        'Add a chapter to your site',
        'The honeymoon, the first anniversary, the news - your site keeps telling the story after the day.',
        'Open website',
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.website),
      ]);
      out.add(<dynamic>[
        'Gather the photos',
        'Approve what guests shared, download the wall, and link the photographer\u2019s gallery when it lands.',
        'Open website',
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.website),
      ]);
      return out;
    }
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in inqs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
      final String vn = (m['vendorName'] ?? 'your vendor').toString();
      if ((m['contractStatus'] ?? '') == 'sent') {
        out.add(<dynamic>[
          'Sign $vn\u2019s contract',
          'It\u2019s in your thread. Signing is what locks your date - everything else hangs on it.',
          'Open thread',
          () => _openCoupleThread(d.id, m),
        ]);
      }
    }
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in inqs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
      final String isx = (m['invoiceStatus'] ?? '').toString();
      if (isx == 'sent' || isx == 'due') {
        final String vn = (m['vendorName'] ?? 'your vendor').toString();
        out.add(<dynamic>[
          'Settle $vn\u2019s invoice',
          'Paying it keeps the booking real on their side. Card or your own way - it\u2019s in the thread.',
          'Open thread',
          () => _openCoupleThread(d.id, m),
        ]);
      }
    }
    if (wedding == null) {
      out.add(<dynamic>[
        'Pick your date',
        'Even a month is enough. Every vendor conversation starts with it, and June plans backwards from it.',
        'Set the date',
        () => _setWeddingDate(null),
      ]);
    }
    if ((couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty) {
      out.add(<dynamic>[
        'Tell June where',
        'The city sets who she can show you, what things cost there, and when vendors book out.',
        'Set the place',
        () => _setupSheet(couple),
      ]);
    }
    // next vendor by booking lead
    final List<List<dynamic>> due = <List<dynamic>>[];
    final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
    for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
      final String slug = c['slug'] ?? '';
      final Map<String, dynamic> p = plan[slug] ?? <String, dynamic>{};
      final String st = (p['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
      if (st == 'booked' || st == 'skipped') continue;
      final DateTime? by = _dueFor(slug, wedding);
      due.add(<dynamic>[by ?? DateTime(now.year + 5), slug, st]);
    }
    due.sort((List<dynamic> a, List<dynamic> b) =>
        (a[0] as DateTime).compareTo(b[0] as DateTime));
    if (due.isNotEmpty) {
      final String slug = due.first[1] as String;
      final DateTime by = due.first[0] as DateTime;
      final String label = _catLabel(slug).toLowerCase();
      final bool late =
          wedding != null && by.isBefore(DateTime(now.year, now.month, 1));
      final String metro = (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString();
      out.add(<dynamic>[
        'Talk to three ${label.endsWith('s') ? label : (label.contains('&') ? '$label pros' : '${label}s')}',
        wedding == null
            ? 'Once your date is set, June can tell you when this one usually needs booking.'
            : late
                ? 'Couples usually have this one booked by ${_kMoLong[by.month - 1]} for a ${_kMoLong[wedding.month - 1]} wedding - so it\u2019s the one to start today.'
                : 'Couples usually book this by ${_kMoLong[by.month - 1]} ${by.year} for your date. Three conversations is enough to know.',
        'See verified ${label}s',
        () => _openBrowse(
            metro: metro.isEmpty ? _browseMetro : metro, category: slug),
      ]);
    }
    final num budgetTotal =
        couple['budgetTotal'] is num ? couple['budgetTotal'] as num : 0;
    double planned = 0;
    for (final Map<String, dynamic> p in plan.values) {
      planned += ((p['budgetPlanned'] ?? 0) as num).toDouble();
    }
    if (budgetTotal <= 0) {
      out.add(<dynamic>[
        'Set a budget - even a rough one',
        'June uses it to say what\u2019s realistic here, and to flag when a proposal is out of range before you fall for it.',
        'Set the budget',
        () => _setBudgetSheet(null),
      ]);
    }
    // v110: while the gold setup banner is showing, the steps don't repeat
    // it line by line - one step opens the same sheet, the rest are real
    // next moves.
    final bool bannerUp = wedding == null ||
        (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty ||
        (couple['names'] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty;
    if (bannerUp) {
      out.removeWhere((List<dynamic> st) =>
          st[0] == 'Pick your date' ||
          st[0] == 'Tell June where' ||
          st[0] == 'Set a budget - even a rough one');
      out.insert(0, <dynamic>[
        'Finish the one-minute setup',
        'Still missing: ${_setupMissing(couple).join(', ')}. Everything June says about cost and timing gets sharper once these are in.',
        'Finish setup',
        () => _setupSheet(couple),
      ]);
    }
    if (budgetTotal > 0 && planned <= 0) {
      out.add(<dynamic>[
        'Split the ${_railMoney(budgetTotal.toDouble())} into what it\u2019s for',
        'Right now it\u2019s one number. Give it a few lines and June can tell you what\u2019s realistic for each.',
        'Split the budget',
        () => _budgetSheet(couple, plan),
      ]);
    }
    return out;
  }

  String _juneRead(int? daysOut, int booked, int active, DateTime? wedding,
      [List<String> late = const <String>[]]) {
    if (daysOut == null) {
      return 'Pick a date and June plans backwards from it - what to book when, and what\u2019s realistic where you are.';
    }
    if (daysOut < 0)
      return 'Congratulations. Your day is behind you - the memories aren\u2019t.';
    if (daysOut == 0) return 'It\u2019s today. Put the phone down.';
    final int months = (daysOut / 30.4).round();
    final String monthsOut = months < 1 ? 'under a month' : '$months months';
    if (booked == 0) {
      return months >= 10
          ? 'You have room. Most couples at $monthsOut out haven\u2019t booked anyone yet either - the venue and photographer are the two to start with.'
          : months >= 6
              ? 'You\u2019re not behind - but the venue and photographer book out first, so those two are this month\u2019s job.'
              : 'Short runway, which is fine - it just means fewer conversations and faster decisions. June will keep the list short.';
    }
    final bool ahead =
        booked >= (active * (1 - (months / 14).clamp(0, 1))).round();
    if (late.isEmpty) {
      return ahead
          ? 'You\u2019re ahead of most couples at $monthsOut out - $booked of $active booked. Nothing is overdue.'
          : '$booked of $active booked at $monthsOut out. Nothing is overdue yet - the next one to book is below.';
    }
    final String who = late.length == 1
        ? late.first
        : late.length == 2
            ? '${late[0]} and ${late[1]}'
            : '${late.take(late.length - 1).join(', ')} and ${late.last}';
    final String verb = late.length == 1 ? 'is' : 'are';
    return '$booked of $active booked at $monthsOut out. $who $verb usually booked by now - ${late.length == 1 ? 'it\u2019s' : 'they\u2019re'} first on the list below.';
  }

  // ---------------- v91: HERO - their photo, their names, the day ----------------
  Widget _heroToday(
      Map<String, dynamic> couple,
      Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan,
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> inqs,
      DateTime? wedding,
      int? daysOut,
      List<List<dynamic>> steps) {
    int booked = 0, skipped = 0;
    String nextSlug = '';
    DateTime? nextBy;
    for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
      final String slug = c['slug'] ?? '';
      final String st = (plan[slug]?['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
      if (st == 'booked') booked++;
      if (st == 'skipped') skipped++;
      if (st != 'booked' && st != 'skipped') {
        final DateTime? by = _dueFor(slug, wedding);
        if (nextSlug.isEmpty ||
            (by != null && (nextBy == null || by.isBefore(nextBy)))) {
          nextSlug = slug;
          nextBy = by;
        }
      }
    }
    final int active = kCategories.length - skipped;
    int waiting = 0;
    String waitingWho = '';
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in inqs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
      final bool fromVendor = (m['lastMessageRole'] ?? '') == 'vendor';
      final dynamic last = m['lastMessageAt'];
      final dynamic read = m['coupleLastReadAt'];
      final bool unread = fromVendor &&
          last is Timestamp &&
          (read is! Timestamp || last.compareTo(read) > 0);
      final bool contract = (m['contractStatus'] ?? '') == 'sent';
      if (unread || contract) {
        waiting++;
        if (waitingWho.isEmpty) {
          waitingWho = contract
              ? '${m['vendorName'] ?? 'A vendor'} sent the contract'
              : '${m['vendorName'] ?? 'A vendor'} replied';
        }
      }
    }
    final num budgetTotal =
        couple['budgetTotal'] is num ? couple['budgetTotal'] as num : 0;
    double committed = 0;
    for (final Map<String, dynamic> p in plan.values) {
      if ((p['status'] ?? '') == 'booked')
        committed += _spentOf(p).toDouble(); // v140
    }
    // v110: which categories are past their usual booking month?
    final DateTime monthStart =
        DateTime(DateTime.now().year, DateTime.now().month, 1);
    final List<String> late = <String>[];
    for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
      final String slug = c['slug'] ?? '';
      final String st = (plan[slug]?['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
      if (st == 'booked' || st == 'skipped') continue;
      final DateTime? by = _dueFor(slug, wedding);
      if (by != null && by.isBefore(monthStart)) late.add(c['label']!);
    }
    final bool nextLate = nextBy != null && nextBy.isBefore(monthStart);
    final String names = (couple['names'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    final String metro = _metroLabel((couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString());
    final String greetFirst =
        (FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.displayName ?? '').split(' ').first;
    // v128: each segment is glued with no-break spaces and a non-breaking
    // hyphen, so a wrap can only happen at a dot - never "DALLAS-FORT /
    // WORTH".
    String glue(String t) => t
        .toUpperCase()
        .replaceAll(' ', '\u00a0')
        .replaceAll('-', '\u2011')
        .replaceAll('\u2013', '\u2011');
    final String eyebrow = <String>[
      if (names.isNotEmpty) glue(names),
      if (names.isEmpty && !_hasRail && greetFirst.isNotEmpty)
        glue('HI, $greetFirst'),
      if (wedding != null) glue(_longDate(wedding)),
      if (metro.isNotEmpty) glue(metro),
    ].join(' \u00b7 ');
    final String photo = (couple['photoUrl'] ?? '').toString();
    final String nextLabel = nextSlug.isEmpty ? '' : _catLabel(nextSlug);

    final List<Widget> tiles = <Widget>[
      _heroTile(
          'Vendor team',
          '$booked',
          'of $active',
          booked == 0
              ? 'Nobody booked yet - that\u2019s normal'
              : _bookedLine(plan)),
      _heroTile(
          'Next up',
          nextLabel.isEmpty ? '\u2014' : nextLabel,
          '',
          nextLabel.isEmpty
              ? 'Your list is complete'
              : (nextBy == null
                  ? 'Set a date to see when'
                  : nextLate
                      ? 'Usually booked by now - start this week'
                      : 'Usually booked by ${_kMo[nextBy.month - 1]} ${nextBy.year}'),
          small: nextLabel.isNotEmpty,
          accent: nextLate ? const Color(0xFFF2B8B8) : null),
      _heroTile(
          'Budget',
          budgetTotal <= 0 ? '\u2014' : _railMoney(budgetTotal.toDouble()),
          budgetTotal <= 0 ? '' : 'set',
          budgetTotal <= 0
              ? 'Not set yet'
              : (committed <= 0
                  ? 'Nothing committed yet'
                  : '${_railMoney(committed)} committed')),
      _heroTile(
          'Vendor replies',
          '$waiting',
          waiting == 0 ? '' : 'to read',
          waiting == 0 ? 'Inbox is clear' : waitingWho),
    ];
    final Widget nameBlock = Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: <Widget>[
        if (eyebrow.isNotEmpty)
          // v126: tap the eyebrow to edit names / date / city.
          _Press(
            onTap: () => _setupSheet(couple),
            child: Padding(
              // v128: right inset keeps the text out from under the camera pill
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8, right: 52),
              // v125: ivory, not gold - gold vanished into the cover photo at
              // the top of the hero where the scrim is lightest; a soft dark
              // shadow keeps it legible over a bright photo too.
              child: Text(eyebrow,
                  maxLines: 2,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      color: ivory,
                      fontSize: 11.5,
                      letterSpacing: 2,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      shadows: <Shadow>[
                        Shadow(
                            color: Color(0x99000000),
                            blurRadius: 6,
                            offset: Offset(0, 1)),
                      ])),
            ),
          ),
        Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.baseline,
            textBaseline: TextBaseline.alphabetic,
            children: <Widget>[
              Text(
                  daysOut == null
                      ? 'Set your date'
                      : (daysOut == 0
                          ? 'Today'
                          : (daysOut < 0
                              ? '${-daysOut} day${-daysOut == 1 ? '' : 's'}'
                              : '$daysOut day${daysOut == 1 ? '' : 's'}')),
                  style: _serif(
                      size: 44,
                      weight: FontWeight.w500,
                      color: ivory,
                      height: 1)),
              if (daysOut != null && daysOut != 0) ...<Widget>[
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Text(daysOut < 0 ? 'since' : 'to go',
                    style: _serif(
                        size: 22,
                        weight: FontWeight.w500,
                        color: gold,
                        height: 1)),
              ],
            ]),
        const SizedBox(height: 10),
        Text(_juneRead(daysOut, booked, active, wedding, late),
            style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 14, height: 1.45, color: ivory.withOpacity(.9))),
        if (steps.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          _Press(
            onTap: steps.first[3] as VoidCallback,
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 11),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: gold, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
              child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
                Flexible(
                  child: Text(
                      'This week: ${(steps.first[0] as String)[0].toLowerCase()}${(steps.first[0] as String).substring(1)}',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          color: plumDeep,
                          fontSize: 14,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                const Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_rounded,
                    color: plumDeep, size: 16),
              ]),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ],
    );
    return LayoutBuilder(builder: (BuildContext lc, BoxConstraints cons) {
      final bool wide = cons.maxWidth >= 760;
      final Widget grid = wide
          ? IntrinsicHeight(
              child: Row(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    for (int i = 0; i < tiles.length; i += 2)
                      Padding(
                        padding: EdgeInsets.only(left: i == 0 ? 0 : 10),
                        child: SizedBox(
                          width: 168,
                          child: Column(children: <Widget>[
                            Expanded(child: tiles[i]),
                            const SizedBox(height: 10),
                            Expanded(
                                child: i + 1 < tiles.length
                                    ? tiles[i + 1]
                                    : const SizedBox.shrink()),
                          ]),
                        ),
                      ),
                  ]),
            )
          : _twoUp(tiles);
      return Container(
        // v117: gradient + photo are clipped by the rounded shape; the gold
        // border is painted on top as a foreground so the corners stay clean.
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(22)), color: plum),
        foregroundDecoration: BoxDecoration(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
            border: Border.all(color: gold)),
        clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
        child: Stack(children: <Widget>[

  String _bookedLine(Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan) {
    for (final Map<String, dynamic> p in plan.values) {
      if ((p['status'] ?? '') == 'booked' &&
          (p['vendorName'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty) {
        return '${p['vendorName']} booked';
      }
    }
    return 'Off to a start';
  }

  Widget _heroTile(String label, String value, String unit, String sub,
      {bool small = false, Color? accent}) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 11, 14, 12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: _lzBg(ivory.withOpacity(.10)),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(ivory.withOpacity(.22))),
      ),
      child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: <Widget>[
            Text(label,
                maxLines: 1,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: ivory.withOpacity(.72))),
            const SizedBox(height: 3),
            Row(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.baseline,
                textBaseline: TextBaseline.alphabetic,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Flexible(
                      child: Text(value,
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: _serif(
                              size: small ? 20 : 28, color: ivory, height: 1))),
                  if (unit.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                    const SizedBox(width: 6),
                    Text(unit,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 12,
                            color: gold,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                  ],
                ]),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(sub,
                maxLines: 2,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12,
                    height: 1.3,
                    fontWeight:
                        accent == null ? FontWeight.w400 : FontWeight.w700,
                    color: _lzFg(accent ?? ivory.withOpacity(.78)))),
          ]),
    );
  }

  Widget _twoUp(List<Widget> tiles) {
    final List<Widget> rows = <Widget>[];
    for (int i = 0; i < tiles.length; i += 2) {
      rows.add(IntrinsicHeight(
        child: Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: <Widget>[
              Expanded(child: tiles[i]),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              Expanded(
                  child: i + 1 < tiles.length
                      ? tiles[i + 1]
                      : const SizedBox.shrink()),
            ]),
      ));
      if (i + 2 < tiles.length) rows.add(const SizedBox(height: 10));
    }
    return Column(children: rows);
  }

  // The "confirmed your booking" moment: a vendor marked them booked and it
  // isn't on their list yet. One tap links it. Kept from v90, restyled.
  Widget _linkBookingBanner(Map<String, dynamic> couple,
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> inqs) {
    final List<String> linked = List<String>.from(
        (couple['linkedInquiries'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[]);
    QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? fresh;
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in inqs) {
      if ((d.data()['status'] ?? '') == 'booked' && !linked.contains(d.id)) {
        fresh = d;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (fresh == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d = fresh;
    final String vn = (d.data()['vendorName'] ?? 'A vendor').toString();
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 14),
      child: _Press(
        scale: .985,
        dim: .92,
        onTap: () => _linkBooking(d.data(), d.id),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            gradient: LinearGradient(colors: <Color>[
              vGreen.withOpacity(.95),
              const Color(0xFF3AA37E)
            ]),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
            border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
          ),
          child: Row(children: <Widget>[
            const Text('\uD83C\uDF89', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 24)),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Text('$vn confirmed your booking',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            color: ivory,
                            fontSize: 15,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    const Text('Tap to add them to your vendor team',
                        style: TextStyle(color: ivory, fontSize: 12)),
                  ]),
            ),
            const Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded, color: ivory),
          ]),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ---------------- v91: THIS WEEK, WITH JUNE ----------------
  Widget _juneWeekCard(List<List<dynamic>> steps,

      final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();

      final dynamic b = m['bookedAt'];

          DateTime.now().difference(b.toDate()).inDays <= 14) {
        if (newest == null || b.compareTo(newest) > 0) {
          newest = b;
          lastWeek =
              'You booked ${m['vendorName'] ?? 'a vendor'} ${_ago(b) == 'now' ? 'just now' : '${_ago(b)} ago'}. That was the right move.';
        }
