  // ---------------- v91: VENDOR TEAM - their list, and the road to the date ----------------
  Widget _teamCard(
      Map<String, dynamic> couple,
      Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan,
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> inqs,
      DateTime? wedding) {
    final List<Map<String, String>> mine = <Map<String, String>>[];
    for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
      final String st = (plan[c['slug']]?['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
      if (st != 'skipped') mine.add(c);
    }
    // conversations per category, from the inquiries themselves
    final Map<String, int> talking = <String, int>{};
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in inqs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
      final String st = (m['status'] ?? '').toString();
      if (st == 'booked' || st == 'lost' || st == 'closed') continue;
      final dynamic cat = m['vendorCategory'] ??
          m['category'] ??
          (m['structuredIntent'] is Map
              ? (m['structuredIntent'] as Map)['category']
              : null);
      if (cat != null)
        talking[cat.toString()] = (talking[cat.toString()] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
    String nextSlug = '';
    DateTime? nextBy;
    for (final Map<String, String> c in mine) {
      final String slug = c['slug'] ?? '';
      final String st = (plan[slug]?['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
      if (st == 'booked') continue;
      final DateTime? by = _dueFor(slug, wedding);
      if (nextSlug.isEmpty ||
          (by != null && (nextBy == null || by.isBefore(nextBy)))) {
        nextSlug = slug;
        nextBy = by;
      }
    }
    final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
    return _glass(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 18, 22, 16),
      child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: <Widget>[
            Row(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          Text('Your vendor team', style: _serif(size: 24)),
                          const SizedBox(height: 2),
                          Text(
                              'The ${mine.length} you said you need. Not our ${kCategories.length} - yours.',
                              style:
                                   TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                        ]),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  OutlinedButton(
                    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                        foregroundColor: _lzFg(plum),
                        side: const BorderSide(color: gold),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10))),
                    onPressed: _h(() => _editWantedSheet(plan)),
                    child: const Text('Edit the list',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  ),
                ]),
            if (wedding != null) ...<Widget>[
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              _roadStrip(mine, plan, wedding, nextSlug),
            ],
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            LayoutBuilder(builder: (BuildContext lc, BoxConstraints cons) {
              final int cols =
                  cons.maxWidth >= 860 ? 6 : (cons.maxWidth >= 560 ? 3 : 2);
              final double w = (cons.maxWidth - (cols - 1) * 8) / cols;
              // v117: phones fold the list - booked and next-up first, then
              // the rest behind "Show all".
              final bool phone = cols == 2;
              final List<Map<String, String>> ordered =
                  List<Map<String, String>>.from(mine);
              if (phone && !_teamExpanded) {
                int rank(Map<String, String> c) {
                  final String st =
                      (plan[c['slug']]?['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
                  if (c['slug'] == nextSlug) return 0;
                  if (st == 'booked') return 1;
                  if ((talking[c['slug']] ?? 0) > 0) return 2;
                  return 3;
                }

                ordered.sort((Map<String, String> a, Map<String, String> b) =>
                    rank(a).compareTo(rank(b)));
              }
              final List<Map<String, String>> shown =
                  phone && !_teamExpanded ? ordered.take(4).toList() : ordered;
              return Column(children: <Widget>[
                Wrap(
                  spacing: 8,
                  runSpacing: 8,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    for (final Map<String, String> c in shown)
                      SizedBox(
                          width: w,
                          child: _teamTile(
                              c,
                              plan[c['slug']] ?? <String, dynamic>{},
                              talking[c['slug']] ?? 0,
                              c['slug'] == nextSlug,
                              wedding,
                              couple)),
                  ],
                ),
                if (phone && mine.length > 4)
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
                    child: SizedBox(
                      width: double.infinity,
                      child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                            foregroundColor: _lzFg(plum),
                            side:  BorderSide(color: _lzLine(goldLine)),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 11)),
                        onPressed: _h(() =>
                            setState(() => _teamExpanded = !_teamExpanded)),
                        icon: Icon(
                            _teamExpanded
                                ? Icons.expand_less_rounded
                                : Icons.expand_more_rounded,
                            size: 18),
                        label: Text(
                            _teamExpanded
                                ? 'Show fewer'
                                : 'Show all ${mine.length}',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
              ]);
            }),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Row(children: <Widget>[
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                    wedding == null
                        ? 'Set your date and each one shows when couples here usually book it.'
                        : 'Grey months are when couples usually book each one - nothing here is late unless it says so.',
                    style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted))),
              ),
              TextButton(
                onPressed: _h(() => _openBrowse(
                    metro: (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty
                        ? _browseMetro
                        : couple['metroId'].toString())),
                child:  Text('Browse verified vendors \u2192',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: _lzFg(plum),
                        fontSize: 13,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
              ),
            ]),
          ]),
    );
  }

  Widget _teamTile(Map<String, String> c, Map<String, dynamic> p, int talking,
      bool isNext, DateTime? wedding, Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    final String slug = c['slug'] ?? '';
    final String st = (p['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
    final bool booked = st == 'booked';
    final String vn = (p['vendorName'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    final DateTime? by = _dueFor(slug, wedding);
    final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
    final bool late =
        !booked && by != null && by.isBefore(DateTime(now.year, now.month, 1));
    String sub;
    Widget pill;
    if (booked) {
      sub = vn.isEmpty ? 'Booked' : vn;
      pill = (p['contractUrl'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty
          ? Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
              _pill('Booked', vGreen),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              _Press(
                  scale: .985,
                  dim: .92,
                  onTap: () => _openLink(p['contractUrl'].toString()),
                  child: _pill('Contract', plum)),
            ])
          : _pill('Booked', vGreen);
    } else if (talking > 0) {
      sub = '$talking in conversation';
      pill = _pill(isNext ? 'Next up' : 'Talking', isNext ? gold : plum);
    } else if (_recFor(slug) != null) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> r = _recFor(slug)!;
      sub = '${r['fromVendorName']} recommends ${r['name']}';
      pill = _pill('Recommended', plum);
    } else if (isNext) {
      sub = 'Start here';
      pill = _pill('Next up', gold);
    } else {
      sub = 'Not started';
      pill = by == null
          ? _pill('Anytime', muted)
          : _pill(late ? 'Running late' : 'From ${_kMo[by.month - 1]}',
              late ? const Color(0xFFB04343) : muted);
    }
    return _Press(
      scale: .985,
      dim: .92,
      onTap: () {
        if (booked) {
          setState(() => _view = _View.vendors);
        } else if (talking == 0 && _recFor(slug) != null) {
          _checkDateWithRec(_recFor(slug)!);
        } else {
          _openBrowse(
              metro: (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty
                  ? _browseMetro
                  : couple['metroId'].toString(),
              category: slug);
        }
      },
      child: Container(
        constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 100),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 11, 12, 10),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: _lzBg(booked
              ? const Color(0xFFF1F8F4)
              : (isNext ? const Color(0xFFFBF4E4) : ivory)),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          border:
              Border.all(color: _lzLine(booked ? vGreen : (isNext ? gold : goldLine))),
        ),
        child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              Text(c['label'] ?? '',
                  style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: _lzFg(muted))),
              const SizedBox(height: 3),
              Text(sub,
                  maxLines: 2,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style:  TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 13.5,
                      color: _lzFg(ink),
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      height: 1.25)),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              pill,
            ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  // The road: one strip from this month to the wedding, each vendor placed
  // on the month couples usually book it. Their whole plan, in a glance.
  Widget _roadStrip(
      List<Map<String, String>> mine,
      Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan,
      DateTime wedding,
      String nextSlug) {
    final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
    final DateTime start = DateTime(now.year, now.month, 1);
    final DateTime end = DateTime(wedding.year, wedding.month, 1);
    int months = (end.year - start.year) * 12 + (end.month - start.month) + 1;
    if (months < 1) months = 1;
    if (months > 16) months = 16;
    final DateTime first =
        months == 16 ? DateTime(end.year, end.month - 15, 1) : start;
    final Map<String, List<Map<String, String>>> byMonth =
        <String, List<Map<String, String>>>{};
    final List<Map<String, String>> earlier = <Map<String, String>>[];
    for (final Map<String, String> c in mine) {
      final DateTime? by = _dueFor(c['slug'] ?? '', wedding);
      if (by == null) continue;
      if (by.isBefore(first)) {
        earlier.add(c);
        continue;
      }
      final String k = '${by.year}-${by.month}';
      byMonth.putIfAbsent(k, () => <Map<String, String>>[]).add(c);
    }
    Color dotColor(Map<String, String> c) {
      final String st = (plan[c['slug']]?['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
      if (st == 'booked') return vGreen;
      if (c['slug'] == nextSlug) return gold;
      return muted.withOpacity(.45);
    }

    return SizedBox(
      height: 92,
      child: ListView(
        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
        children: <Widget>[
          if (earlier.isNotEmpty)
            _roadCol('Overdue', earlier, (Map<String, String> c) {
              final String st =
                  (plan[c['slug']]?['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
              return st == 'booked' ? vGreen : const Color(0xFFB04343);
            }, false, false, overdue: true),
          for (int i = 0; i < months; i++)
            Builder(builder: (BuildContext bc) {
              final DateTime m = DateTime(first.year, first.month + i, 1);
              final bool isNow = m.year == now.year && m.month == now.month;
              final bool isWedding = m.year == end.year && m.month == end.month;
              return _roadCol(
                  '${_kMo[m.month - 1]}${m.month == 1 || i == 0 ? ' ${m.year.toString().substring(2)}' : ''}',
                  byMonth['${m.year}-${m.month}'] ??
                      const <Map<String, String>>[],
                  dotColor,
                  isNow,
                  isWedding);
            }),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  static const Map<String, String> _kShortLabel = <String, String>{
    'Photographer': 'Photo',
    'Videographer': 'Video',
    'Cake & Desserts': 'Cake',
    'Hair & Makeup': 'Hair & makeup',
    'Transportation': 'Transport',
    'Live Band': 'Band',
    'Invitations': 'Invites',
    'Day-Of Coordinator': 'Day-of coord.',
  };

  Widget _roadCol(String label, List<Map<String, String>> cats,
      Color Function(Map<String, String>) colorOf, bool isNow, bool isWedding,
      {bool overdue = false}) {
    return Container(
      width: 92,
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 4),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(7, 6, 6, 6),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: _lzBg(isWedding
            ? plum
            : overdue
                ? const Color(0xFFFBECEC)
                : (isNow ? gold.withOpacity(.14) : Colors.transparent)),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
        border: Border.all(
            color: _lzLine(isWedding
                ? plum
                : overdue
                    ? const Color(0xFFE8B4B4)
                    : (isNow ? gold : const Color(0xFFF0E8DD)))),
      ),
      child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: <Widget>[
            Text(isWedding ? 'I do' : label,
                style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 10.5,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    color: _lzFg(isWedding
                        ? ivory
                        : overdue
                            ? const Color(0xFFB04343)
                            : (isNow ? const Color(0xFF8A6A2F) : muted)))),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            for (final Map<String, String> c in cats.take(4))
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 2),
                child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                  Container(
                      width: 7,
                      height: 7,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: _lzBg(colorOf(c)), shape: BoxShape.circle)),
                  const SizedBox(width: 4),
                  Expanded(
                      child: Text(_kShortLabel[c['label']] ?? c['label'] ?? '',
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 10, color: _lzFg(isWedding ? ivory : ink)))),
                ]),
              ),
            if (cats.length > 4)
              Text('+${cats.length - 4}',
                  style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 9.5, color: _lzFg(muted))),
          ]),
    );
  }

  // Which vendors do they actually need? Their list, saved as plan status.
  Future<void> _editWantedSheet(Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan) async {
    final Set<String> wanted = <String>{
      for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories)
        if ((plan[c['slug']]?['status'] ?? 'needed').toString() != 'skipped')
          c['slug'] ?? ''
    };
    if (!mounted) return;
    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 620),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) => SafeArea(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 18, 22, 22),
            child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Row(children: <Widget>[
                    Expanded(
                        child: Text('Which vendors do you need?',
                            style: _serif(size: 24))),
                    IconButton(
                        icon:  Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: _lzFg(muted)),
                        onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx))),
                  ]),
                   Text(
                      'Tap to add or remove. A booked vendor stays either way. You can change this any time.',
                      style:
                          TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted), height: 1.4)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Wrap(
                    spacing: 8,
                    runSpacing: 8,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories)
                        Builder(builder: (BuildContext bc) {
                          final String slug = c['slug'] ?? '';
                          final bool booked =
                              (plan[slug]?['status'] ?? '') == 'booked';
                          final bool on = wanted.contains(slug) || booked;
                          return FilterChip(
                            label: Text(c['label'] ?? '',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 12.5,
                                    color: _lzFg(on ? ivory : plum),
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                            selected: on,
                            selectedColor: plum,
                            checkmarkColor: gold,
                            backgroundColor: _lzBg(Colors.white),
                            side: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
                            onSelected: _hb(booked
                                ? null
                                : (bool v) => setD(() {
                                      if (v) {
                                        wanted.add(slug);
                                      } else {
                                        wanted.remove(slug);
                                      }
                                    })),
                          );
                        }),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  SizedBox(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    child: FilledButton(
                      style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                          backgroundColor: gold,
                          foregroundColor: plumDeep,
                          elevation: 0,
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 13)),
                      onPressed: _h(() async {
                        final WriteBatch b = FirebaseFirestore.instance.batch();
                        for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
                          final String slug = c['slug'] ?? '';
                          final String cur =
                              (plan[slug]?['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
                          if (cur == 'booked') continue;
                          final String next = wanted.contains(slug)
                              ? (cur == 'skipped' ? 'needed' : cur)
                              : 'skipped';
                          if (next != cur) {
                            b.set(
                                _planRef.doc(slug),
                                <String, dynamic>{
                                  'status': next,
                                  'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
                                },
                                SetOptions(merge: true));
                          }
                        }
                        await b.commit();
                        if (ctx2.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx2);
                      }),
                      child: Text(
                          'Save my ${wanted.length} vendor${wanted.length == 1 ? '' : 's'}',
                          style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    ),
                  ),
                ]),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ---------------- v91: WEBSITE + BUDGET, AT A GLANCE ----------------
  Widget _websiteMini(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _liveQuery(
          'site:$_cid',
          () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
              .collection('weddingSites')
              .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
              .limit(1)),
      initialData: _liveQ['site:$_cid']?.latest,
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? doc =
            (s.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[])
                    .isEmpty
                ? null
                : s.data!.docs.first;
        final Map<String, dynamic> w = doc?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        final List<String> fields = <String>[
          'names',
          'story',
          'venueName',
          'receptionTime',
          'travelNotes',
          'siteGallery',
          'template'
        ];
        int done = 0;
        for (final String f in fields) {
          final dynamic v = w[f];
          if (v is List ? v.isNotEmpty : (v ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty)
            done++;
        }
        final int pct =
            doc == null ? 0 : ((done / fields.length) * 100).round();
        final String slug = doc?.id ?? '';
        return _Press(
          scale: .985,
          dim: .92,
          onTap: () => setState(() => _view = _View.website),
          child: _glass(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 16, 20, 16),
            child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Text('Your website', style: _serif(size: 22)),
                  Text(
                      slug.isEmpty
                          ? 'Free, live in minutes, no ads'
                          : 'meetlazo.com/w/$slug',
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  ClipRRect(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                    child: SizedBox(
                        height: 8,
                        child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                            value: pct / 100,
                            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFEFE6D8),
                            valueColor:
                                const AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(gold))),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Row(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.baseline,
                      textBaseline: TextBaseline.alphabetic,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        Text('$pct%', style: _serif(size: 22, height: 1)),
                        const SizedBox(width: 6),
                         Text('complete',
                            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                        if (doc != null) ...<Widget>[
                          const SizedBox(width: 16),
                          StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
                            stream: _liveQuery(
                                'rsvp:$slug',
                                () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
                                    .collection('weddingSites')
                                    .doc(slug)
                                    .collection('rsvps')),
                            initialData: _liveQ['rsvp:$slug']?.latest,
                            builder: (BuildContext c2,
                                AsyncSnapshot<
                                        QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>
                                    r) {
                              final int n = r.data?.docs.length ?? 0;
                              return Row(
                                  crossAxisAlignment:
                                      CrossAxisAlignment.baseline,
                                  textBaseline: TextBaseline.alphabetic,
                                  children: <Widget>[
                                    Text('$n',
                                        style: _serif(size: 22, height: 1)),
                                    const SizedBox(width: 6),
                                    Text('RSVP${n == 1 ? '' : 's'} in',
                                        style:  TextStyle(
                                            fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                                  ]);
                            },
                          ),
                        ],
                      ]),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(
                      doc == null
                          ? 'Type your names and watch it come alive. Guests RSVP right on it.'
                          : pct >= 100
                              ? 'Done. Share it, and every RSVP lands here.'
                              : 'Add your story and where to stay, then share it.',
                      style:  TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted), height: 1.4)),
                ]),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  // Budget as a plan: each vendor line against what it really costs in
  // their metro (metroStats.priceFrom, written nightly from Lazo listings).
  Widget _budgetLine(
      Map<String, String> c, Map<String, dynamic> p, String metro) {
    final String slug = c['slug'] ?? '';
    final num plannedN =
        p['budgetPlanned'] is num ? p['budgetPlanned'] as num : 0;
    final num actualN = p['budgetActual'] is num ? p['budgetActual'] as num : 0;
    final bool booked = (p['status'] ?? '') == 'booked';
    final String key = '${metro}__$slug';
    return StreamBuilder<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: metro.isEmpty
          ? const Stream<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>.empty()
          : _liveDoc(
              'ms:$key',
              () =>
                  FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('metroStats').doc(key)),
      initialData: metro.isEmpty ? null : _liveD['ms:$key']?.latest,
      builder: (BuildContext c2,
          AsyncSnapshot<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> ms = s.data?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        final Map<String, dynamic> pf = ms['priceFrom'] is Map
            ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(ms['priceFrom'] as Map)
            : <String, dynamic>{};
        String range = '';
        if (pf['p25'] is num && pf['p75'] is num) {
          range =
              'here: from ${_railMoney((pf['p25'] as num).toDouble())}\u2013${_railMoney((pf['p75'] as num).toDouble())}';
        }
        return Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 7),
          decoration:  BoxDecoration(
              border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: _lzLine(Color(0xFFF0E8DD))))),
          child: Row(children: <Widget>[
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Text(c['label'] ?? '',
                        style:  TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 13.5,
                            color: _lzFg(ink),
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                    if (range.isNotEmpty)
                      Text(range,
                          style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                  ]),
            ),
            Text(
                booked && actualN > 0
                    ? _railMoney(actualN.toDouble())
                    : (plannedN > 0
                        ? _railMoney(plannedN.toDouble())
                        : '\u2014'),
                style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 13.5,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    color: _lzFg(booked ? vGreen : plum))),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Text(booked ? 'paid' : (plannedN > 0 ? 'planned' : ''),
                style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: _lzFg(muted))),
          ]),
        );
      },
    );
  }

      Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan) async {
    if (!mounted) return;
    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 720),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => SafeArea(
        child: SizedBox(
          height: MediaQuery.of(ctx).size.height * .84,
          child: Column(children: <Widget>[
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 16, 12, 0),

                Expanded(child: Text('Budget', style: _serif(size: 24))),
                IconButton(

                    onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx))),
              ]),
            ),
            Expanded(
              child: StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
                stream: _liveQuery('plan:$_cid', () => _planRef),
                initialData: _liveQ['plan:$_cid']?.latest,

                    AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> ps) {
                  final Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> livePlan =
                      <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{
                    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d
                        in ps.data?.docs ??

                      d.id: d.data()
                  };
                  return ListView(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 8, 18, 24),
                      children: <Widget>[_budgetCard(couple, livePlan)]);
                },
              ),
            ),
          ]),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ---------------- v91: SETUP, THE WAY JUNE WOULD ASK ----------------
  // v110: the pieces of setup still empty, in the order the sheet asks.
  List<String> _setupMissing(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    return <String>[
      if ((couple['names'] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty) 'your names',
      if (couple['weddingDate'] is! Timestamp) 'the date',
      if ((couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty) 'the city',
      if (!(couple['budgetTotal'] is num && (couple['budgetTotal'] as num) > 0))
        'a rough budget',
    ];
  }

  Widget _setupCard(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
      child: _Press(
        scale: .985,
        dim: .92,
        onTap: () => _setupSheet(couple),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: gold,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
          ),
          child: Row(children: <Widget>[
            const Icon(Icons.auto_awesome_rounded, color: plumDeep, size: 22),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Text(
                        _setupMissing(couple).length >= 3
                            ? 'June: let\u2019s set up your wedding. One minute.'
                            : 'June: ${_setupMissing(couple).length == 1 ? 'one detail' : 'two details'} to finish setup.',
                        style: _serif(size: 20, color: plumDeep)),
                    Text(
                        _setupMissing(couple).length >= 3
                            ? 'Your names, the date, the city, a rough budget, and which vendors you actually need. Everything else builds from that.'
                            : 'Still missing: ${_setupMissing(couple).join(' and ')}. June uses ${_setupMissing(couple).length == 1 ? 'it' : 'them'} to say what\u2019s realistic and who to talk to.',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            color: plumDeep, fontSize: 12.5, height: 1.4)),
                  ]),
            ),
            const Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded, color: plumDeep),
          ]),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _setupSheet(Map<String, dynamic> couple) async {
    final TextEditingController namesC =
        TextEditingController(text: (couple['names'] ?? '').toString());
    final TextEditingController budgetC = TextEditingController(
        text: couple['budgetTotal'] is num && (couple['budgetTotal'] as num) > 0
            ? (couple['budgetTotal'] as num).round().toString()
            : '');
    String metro = (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString();
    DateTime? date = couple['weddingDate'] is Timestamp
        ? (couple['weddingDate'] as Timestamp).toDate()
        : null;
    final Set<String> wanted = <String>{
      'wedding-venues',
      'wedding-photographers',
      'wedding-djs',
      'wedding-florists',
      'hair-and-makeup',
      'day-of-coordination'
    };
    int step = 0;
    bool saving = false;
    if (!mounted) return;
    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 620),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) {
          const List<String> asks = <String>[
            'First - who\u2019s getting married?',
            'When\u2019s the day? A month is enough for now.',
            'Where? The city sets who I can show you and what things cost.',
            'A rough budget. I use it to keep proposals honest, not to judge.',
            'Which vendors do you actually need? Tap to add or remove.',
          ];
          Widget body;
          if (step == 0) {
            body = TextField(
                controller: namesC,
                autofocus: true,
                style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 16),
                decoration: _lightDeco('Your names', hint: 'Mindy and John'));
          } else if (step == 1) {
            body = OutlinedButton.icon(
              style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                  foregroundColor: _lzFg(plum),
                  side: const BorderSide(color: gold),
                  padding:
                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14, horizontal: 16)),
              onPressed: _h(() async {
                final DateTime? picked = await showDatePicker(
                    context: ctx2,
                    initialDate:
                        date ?? DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 300)),
                    firstDate: (date != null && date!.isBefore(DateTime.now()))
                        ? date!
                        : DateTime.now(),
                    lastDate:
                        DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 365 * 4)));
                if (picked != null) setD(() => date = picked);
              }),
              icon: const Icon(Icons.event_rounded, size: 18),
              label: Text(date == null ? 'Pick the date' : _longDate(date!),
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            );
          } else if (step == 2) {
            body = DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
              value: metro.isEmpty ? null : metro,
              dropdownColor: _lzBg(ivory),
              style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 15),
              decoration: _lightDeco('City'),
              items: <DropdownMenuItem<String>>[
                for (final Map<String, String> m in kMetros)
                  DropdownMenuItem<String>(
                      value: m['id'], child: Text(m['label'] ?? ''))
              ],
              onChanged: (String? v) => setD(() => metro = v ?? ''),
            );
          } else if (step == 3) {
            body = TextField(
                controller: budgetC,
                keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 16),
                decoration: _lightDeco('Total budget',
                    hint: '25000', prefix: '\u0024 '));
          } else {
            body = Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: <Widget>[
              for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories)
                FilterChip(
                  label: Text(c['label'] ?? '',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 12.5,
                          color: _lzFg(wanted.contains(c['slug']) ? ivory : plum),
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                  selected: wanted.contains(c['slug']),
                  selectedColor: plum,
                  checkmarkColor: gold,
                  backgroundColor: _lzBg(Colors.white),
                  side: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
                  onSelected: _hb((bool v) => setD(() {
                        if (v) {
                          wanted.add(c['slug'] ?? '');
                        } else {
                          wanted.remove(c['slug']);
                        }
                      })),
                ),
            ]);
          }
          return Padding(
            padding:
                EdgeInsets.only(bottom: MediaQuery.of(ctx2).viewInsets.bottom),
            child: SafeArea(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 18, 22, 22),
                child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      Row(children: <Widget>[
                         Icon(Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
                            color: _lzFg(Color(0xFF8A6A2F)), size: 16),
                        const SizedBox(width: 6),
                        Text('June  \u00b7  ${step + 1} of ${asks.length}',
                            style:  TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 12,
                                color: _lzFg(muted),
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                        const Spacer(),
                        IconButton(
                            icon:  Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: _lzFg(muted)),
                            onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx2))),
                      ]),
                      Text(asks[step], style: _serif(size: 24)),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      body,
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      Row(children: <Widget>[
                        if (step > 0)
                          TextButton(
                              onPressed: _h(() => setD(() => step--)),
                              child:  Text('Back',
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      color: _lzFg(muted),
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700))),
                        const Spacer(),
                        FilledButton(
                          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                              backgroundColor: gold,
                              foregroundColor: plumDeep,
                              elevation: 0,
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                  horizontal: 22, vertical: 12)),
                          onPressed: _h(saving
                              ? null
                              : () async {
                                  if (step < asks.length - 1) {
                                    setD(() => step++);
                                    return;
                                  }
                                  setD(() => saving = true);
                                  try {
                                    final double? b = double.tryParse(budgetC
                                        .text
                                        .trim()
                                        .replaceAll(',', ''));
                                    await _coupleRef.set(<String, dynamic>{
                                      if (namesC.text.trim().isNotEmpty)
                                        'names': namesC.text.trim(),
                                      if (metro.isNotEmpty) 'metroId': metro,
                                      if (date != null)
                                        'weddingDate':
                                            Timestamp.fromDate(date!),
                                      if (b != null && b > 0) 'budgetTotal': b,
                                      'setupDoneAt':
                                          FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                                      'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                                    }, SetOptions(merge: true));
                                    // v139: only categories with no plan
                                    // doc yet - reopening setup used to flip
                                    // a booked vendor back to "needed"
                                    final Set<String> hasPlan = <String>{};
                                    try {
                                      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>
                                          pq = await _planRef.get();
                                      for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<
                                              Map<String, dynamic>> pd
                                          in pq.docs) {
                                        if ((pd.data()['status'] ?? '')
                                            .toString()
                                            .isNotEmpty) {
                                          hasPlan.add(pd.id);
                                        }
                                      }
                                    } catch (_) {}
                                    final WriteBatch wb =
                                        FirebaseFirestore.instance.batch();
                                    for (final Map<String, String> c
                                        in kCategories) {
                                      final String slug = c['slug'] ?? '';
                                      if (hasPlan.contains(slug)) {
                                        continue;
                                      }
                                      wb.set(
                                          _planRef.doc(slug),
                                          <String, dynamic>{
                                            'status': wanted.contains(slug)
                                                ? 'needed'
                                                : 'skipped'
                                          },
                                          SetOptions(merge: true));
                                    }
                                    await wb.commit();
                                    if (ctx2.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx2);
                                  } catch (e) {
                                    setD(() => saving = false);
                                    _toast('Could not save: $e');
                                  }
                                }),
                          child: Text(
                              step < asks.length - 1
                                  ? 'Next'
                                  : (saving ? 'Saving\u2026' : 'Done'),
                              style:
                                  const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        ),
                      ]),
                    ]),
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

                        Expanded(

                              controller: codeC,

                              style:  TextStyle(

                                  fontSize: 16,
                                  letterSpacing: 3,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),

                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 10),

                              side: const BorderSide(color: gold),
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(

                            final String code = codeC.text
                                .trim()
                                .toUpperCase()
                                .replaceAll(' ', '');
                            if (code.length < 4) return;
                            try {
                              final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions
                                  .instance
                                  .httpsCallable('redeemCoupleInvite',
                                      options: HttpsCallableOptions(
                                          timeout:
                                              const Duration(seconds: 30)));
                              final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> out = await fn
                                  .call(<String, dynamic>{'code': code});
                              final Map<String, dynamic> r =
                                  Map<String, dynamic>.from(out.data as Map);
                              final String cu =
                                  (r['coupleUid'] ?? '').toString();

                              _toast(e.message ?? 'That code did not work.');

                              _toast('That code did not work.');
                            }

                              style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        ),
                      ]),
                    ]),
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  String _randomCode(int n) {
    const String alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789';
    final math.Random r = math.Random.secure();
    final StringBuffer b = StringBuffer();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      b.write(alphabet[r.nextInt(alphabet.length)]);
    }
    return b.toString();
  }

  bool _planComplete(Map<String, dynamic> couple,
      Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan, int booked) {
    bool bookedCat(String slug) =>
        ((plan[slug] ?? const <String, dynamic>{})['status'] ?? '') == 'booked';
    final bool hasDate = couple['weddingDate'] is Timestamp;
    final bool hasPhoto =
        couple['photoUrl'] != null && couple['photoUrl'].toString().isNotEmpty;
    final bool hasBudget = plan.values.any((Map<String, dynamic> p) =>
        p['budgetPlanned'] != null && ((p['budgetPlanned'] ?? 0) as num) > 0);
    final bool hasRegistry = couple['registryLinks'] is List &&
        (couple['registryLinks'] as List).isNotEmpty;
    return hasDate &&
        hasPhoto &&
        hasBudget &&
        hasRegistry &&
        bookedCat('wedding-venues') &&
        bookedCat('wedding-photographers') &&
        bookedCat('wedding-videographers') &&
        booked >= 5;
  }

  // Hellos: one writer for the switch and the row alike. Firestore's local
  // write lands before the round trip, so the switch slides the moment it is
  // tapped and the couple doc stays the single source of truth.
  Future<void> _setHellos(bool on) async {
    await _coupleRef
        .set(<String, dynamic>{'hellosOk': on}, SetOptions(merge: true));
    _toastC(on
        ? 'Hellos are on.'
        : 'Hellos are off - vendors only reply when you write first.');
  }

  // Every on/off control in this widget. Green track when on, grey when off -
  // the one thing that reads as 'on' from across the room. Defined once so the
  // four switches cannot drift into three different looks again.
  Widget _lazoSwitch({
    required bool value,
    required ValueChanged<bool>? onChanged,
  }) {
    return Switch(
      value: value,
      activeColor: Colors.white,
      activeTrackColor: vGreen,
      inactiveThumbColor: Colors.white,
      inactiveTrackColor: muted.withOpacity(.4),
      onChanged: onChanged,
    );
  }

  // One row inside a group. No card of its own any more - the group is the
  // card. Title leads (14 bold plum); the detail line sits under it, smaller
  // and quieter, which is the hierarchy the old row had upside down.

  // JC-LAZO-THEME-1009-001: light / dark / auto, remembered on this device
  void _lzLoadTheme() {
    SharedPreferences.getInstance().then((SharedPreferences p) {
      final String? v = p.getString('lazo_theme');
      if (v != null && v != _lzThemePref && mounted) {
        setState(() => _lzThemePref = v);
      }
    }).catchError((_) {});
  }

  void _lzSetTheme(String v) {
    if (v == _lzThemePref) return;
    HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
    setState(() => _lzThemePref = v);
    SharedPreferences.getInstance()
        .then((SharedPreferences p) => p.setString('lazo_theme', v))
        .catchError((_) => true);
  }

  // v140: the top of the ranking for the current metro + category, fetched
  // once per pair and merged into the unordered page so the best vendors
  // are never the ones the 60-limit dropped. Needs the composite index
  // vendors(metroId, categories contains, score desc); without it the
  // query fails quietly and Browse behaves as before.
  final Map<String, List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>>
      _topScored = <String, List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>>{};
  final Set<String> _topScoredBusy = <String>{};

  void _ensureTopScored(String metro, String cat) {
    final String key = '$metro|$cat';
    if (metro.isEmpty ||
        cat.isEmpty ||
        _topScored.containsKey(key) ||
        _topScoredBusy.contains(key)) {
      return;
    }
    _topScoredBusy.add(key);
    FirebaseFirestore.instance
        .collection('vendors')
        .where('metroId', isEqualTo: metro)
        .where('categories', arrayContains: cat)
        .orderBy('score', descending: true)
        .limit(24)
        .get()
        .then((QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> q) {
      _topScored[key] = q.docs;
      _topScoredBusy.remove(key);
      if (mounted) setState(() {});
    }).catchError((Object e) {
      _topScored[key] = <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
      _topScoredBusy.remove(key);
      debugPrint('LAZO top-scored: ' + e.toString());
    });
  }

  StreamSubscription<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>? _inqSub;
  List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _inqDocs =
      <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
  Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> _lastPlanForSync =
      <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};

  void _ensureInquiryListener() {
    if (_inqSub != null || _uid == null) {
      return;
    }
    _inqSub = FirebaseFirestore.instance
        .collection('inquiries')
        .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
        .snapshots()
        .listen((QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> snap) {
      _inqDocs = snap.docs;
      _maybeCelebrateBooking(snap.docs);
      _runBookedSync(_lastPlanForSync);
    });
  }

  // ---------------- v60: NEW BOOKING CELEBRATION ----------------

  Future<void> _maybeCelebrateBooking(
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs) async {
    if (_uid == null || _bookingCelebrateBusy) {
      return;
    }
    int booked = 0;
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> inq = d.data();
      final bool isBooked = (inq['status'] ?? '') == 'booked' ||
          inq['bookedAt'] != null ||
          (inq['contractStatus'] ?? '') == 'signed';
      if (isBooked) {
        booked = booked + 1;
      }
    }
    _bookingCelebrateBusy = true;
    try {
      final DocumentReference<Map<String, dynamic>> cRef =
          FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('couples').doc(_uid);
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> cSnap = await cRef.get();
      final dynamic raw = cSnap.data()?['celebratedBookings'];
      if (raw == null) {
        // First run ever: baseline silently - no confetti for history.
        await cRef.set(<String, dynamic>{'celebratedBookings': booked},
            SetOptions(merge: true));
        return;
      }
      final int celebrated = (raw as num).toInt();
      if (booked > celebrated) {
        await cRef.set(<String, dynamic>{'celebratedBookings': booked},
            SetOptions(merge: true));
        if (mounted) {
          _fireBookingCelebration();
        }
      } else if (booked < celebrated) {
        // Un-booked / purged test data: quietly re-baseline down.
        await cRef.set(<String, dynamic>{'celebratedBookings': booked},
            SetOptions(merge: true));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO booking celebrate: ' + e.toString());
    } finally {
      _bookingCelebrateBusy = false;
    }
  }

  void _fireBookingCelebration() {
    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }
    setState(() => _bookingBannerUp = true);
    _celebrate();
    _bookingBannerT?.cancel();
    _bookingBannerT = Timer(const Duration(seconds: 7), () {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _bookingBannerUp = false);
      }
    });
  }

  Widget _bookingBannerOverlay() {
    return Positioned(
      top: 20,
      left: 18,
      right: 18,
      child: IgnorePointer(
        ignoring: !_bookingBannerUp,
        child: Center(
          child: ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
            // v130: overshoot on arrival only; ease in on the way out.
            child: AnimatedSlide(
              duration: Duration(milliseconds: _bookingBannerUp ? 480 : 300),
              curve: _bookingBannerUp ? Curves.easeOutBack : Curves.easeInCubic,
              offset: (_bookingBannerUp || _reducedMotion(context))
                  ? Offset.zero
                  : const Offset(0, -0.6),
              child: AnimatedOpacity(
                duration: Duration(milliseconds: _bookingBannerUp ? 220 : 300),
                curve: _bookingBannerUp ? Curves.easeOut : Curves.easeIn,
                opacity: _bookingBannerUp ? 1 : 0,
                child: Container(
                  padding:
                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18, vertical: 14),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    gradient:
                        const LinearGradient(colors: <Color>[plumDeep, plum]),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                    border: Border.all(color: gold, width: 1.2),
                    boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[
                      BoxShadow(
                          color: gold.withOpacity(.35),
                          blurRadius: 22,
                          spreadRadius: 1),
                      BoxShadow(
                          color: Colors.black.withOpacity(.35),
                          blurRadius: 30,
                          offset: const Offset(0, 12)),
                    ],
                  ),
                  child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                    const Text('\u{1F389}', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 26)),
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,

                                  color: ivory,
                                  fontSize: 15.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),

                          Text('Another piece of your day is locked in.',

                                  color: Color(0xFFCDB9CE), fontSize: 12)),

            ),
          ),

  }

  void _syncBookedFromInquiries(Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan) {
    _lastPlanForSync = plan;
    _ensureInquiryListener();
    _runBookedSync(plan);
  }

  void _runBookedSync(Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan) {
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in _inqDocs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> inq = d.data();
      final bool isBooked = (inq['status'] ?? '') == 'booked' ||
          inq['bookedAt'] != null ||
          (inq['contractStatus'] ?? '') == 'signed';
      if (!isBooked) {
        continue;
      }
      final Map<String, dynamic> intent = inq['structuredIntent'] is Map
          ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(inq['structuredIntent'] as Map)
          : <String, dynamic>{};
      final String slug = (intent['category'] ?? '').toString();
      if (slug.isEmpty) {
        continue;
      }
      final String planStatus =
          ((plan[slug] ?? const <String, dynamic>{})['status'] ?? '')
              .toString();
      if (planStatus == 'booked' || _autoSyncInFlight.contains(slug)) {
        continue;
      }
      final String vn = (inq['vendorName'] ?? '').toString();
      _autoSyncInFlight.add(slug);
      _planRef.doc(slug).set(<String, dynamic>{
        'status': 'booked',
        'vendorName': vn,
        'vendorId': inq['vendorId'],
        'autoBookedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true)).then((_) {
        _autoSyncInFlight.remove(slug);
        String label = slug;
        for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
          if (c['slug'] == slug) {
            label = c['label']!;
          }
        }
        _bookedShareSnack('$vn is booked \u2713',
            'Just booked our $label \u2014 $vn! \u{1F389}');
      }).catchError((Object e) {
        _autoSyncInFlight.remove(slug);
      });
    }
  }

  Widget _vendorScreen(
      Map<String, dynamic> couple, Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan) {
    final metroId = (couple['metroId'] as String?) ?? _browseMetro;
    // v140: the v91 team card (road to the date, booking-lead months,
    // recommendations) finally heads the screen, on the live inquiries
    final DateTime? teamWedding = couple['weddingDate'] is Timestamp
        ? (couple['weddingDate'] as Timestamp).toDate()
        : null;
    return ListView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 8, 18, 32),
      children: [
        _subHeader('Vendor team'),
        _teamCard(couple, plan, _inqDocs, teamWedding),
        const SizedBox(height: 14),
         Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.only(left: 6, bottom: 8),
          child: Text('Every category',
              style: TextStyle(
                  color: _lzFg(plum), fontSize: 15.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
        ),
        ...kCategories.map((c) {
          final p = plan[c['slug']] ?? <String, dynamic>{};
          return _categoryRow(
            slug: c['slug']!,
            label: c['label']!,
            data: p,
            metroId: metroId,
          );
        }),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _categoryRow({
    required String slug,
    required String label,
    required Map<String, dynamic> data,
    required String metroId,
  }) {
    final status = (data['status'] as String?) ?? 'needed';
    final vendorName = (data['vendorName'] as String?) ?? '';
    final planned = data['budgetPlanned'] as num?;
    final Map<String, List<dynamic>> chip = {
      'needed': [const Color(0xFFEDE4EE), plum, 'Needed'],
      'researching': [
        gold.withOpacity(.25),
        const Color(0xFF8A6A2F),
        'Researching'
      ],
      'booked': [vGreen.withOpacity(.15), vGreen, 'Booked \u2713'],
      'skipped': [const Color(0xFFE8E4EA), const Color(0xFF8A7D90), 'Skipped'],
    };
    final c = chip[status] ?? chip['needed']!;
    final isBooked = status == 'booked';
    final isSkipped = status == 'skipped';

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 13),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: _lzBg(const Color(0xFFFAF6F0).withOpacity(isSkipped ? .55 : .93)),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        border: Border.all(
            color: _lzLine(isBooked ? vGreen.withOpacity(.5) : gold.withOpacity(.5))),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Expanded(
            child: _Press(
              tick: _Tick.select,
              onTap: () => _editVendor(slug, label, data),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(label,
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: _lzFg(isSkipped ? const Color(0xFF8A7D90) : plum),
                          fontSize: 15.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                          decoration:
                              isSkipped ? TextDecoration.lineThrough : null)),
                  if (vendorName.isNotEmpty || planned != null)
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 2),
                      child: Text(
                        [
                          if (vendorName.isNotEmpty) vendorName,
                          if (planned != null)
                            '\$${planned.toStringAsFixed(0)}',
                        ].join(' \u00b7 '),
                        style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted)),
                      ),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          if (!isBooked && !isSkipped)
            TextButton(
              onPressed: _h(() => _openBrowse(category: slug, metro: metroId)),
              child:  Text('Find one \u2192',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      color: _lzFg(plum),
                      fontSize: 12.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            ),
          const SizedBox(width: 4),
          _Press(
            tick: _Tick.select,
            onTap: () => _cycleStatus(slug, status),
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 7),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: _lzBg(c[0] as Color),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
              ),
              child: Text(c[2] as String,
                  style: TextStyle(
                      color: _lzFg(c[1] as Color),
                      fontSize: 12,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ---------------- IN-APP BROWSE ----------------

  // v132: the whole page scrolls.
  //
  // This was a Column ending in Expanded(child: ListView), so the filters were
  // fixed furniture and only the results moved. Twelve category chips plus
  // seven refine chips is six or seven rows on a phone, which left the vendor
  // list a sliver at the bottom behind the June bar - and nothing above it
  // could be scrolled out of the way. The page reads as frozen because the one
  // part that can scroll has no room to.
  Widget _browseScreen() {
    return ListView(
      // Clears the Ask June bar and the desk button, both of which float over
      // this screen.
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 104),
      children: <Widget>[
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 8, 18, 0),

        ),

          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18),
          child: _browseField(
            child: DropdownButtonHideUnderline(
              child: DropdownButton<String>(
                value: _browseMetro,

                dropdownColor: _lzBg(ivory),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.expand_more_rounded, color: gold),
                selectedItemBuilder: (BuildContext c) => kMetros
                    .map((m) => Align(
                        alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                        child: Text(m['label']!,
                            style: const TextStyle(

                items: kMetros
                    .map((m) => DropdownMenuItem(
                        value: m['id'], child: Text(m['label']!)))
                    .toList(),
                onChanged: (v) =>
                    setState(() => _browseMetro = v ?? _browseMetro),
              ),
            ),

            cursorColor: _lzFg(plum),
            onChanged: (s) {
              _bDebounce?.cancel();
              _bDebounce = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 350), () {
                _runBrowseSearch();
              });
            },
            style: TextStyle(color: ivory.withOpacity(.95), fontSize: 14.5),
            decoration: InputDecoration(
              hintText:
                  'Search by name \u2014 find anyone, even someone you\u2019ve hired',
              hintStyle: TextStyle(color: ivory.withOpacity(.55), fontSize: 13),
              prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.search_rounded,
                  color: ivory.withOpacity(.8), size: 20),
              suffixIcon: _bQuery.isEmpty
                  ? null
                  : IconButton(
                      icon: Icon(Icons.close_rounded,
                          color: ivory.withOpacity(.8), size: 18),
                      onPressed: _h(() {

                        _vSearchC.clear();
                        setState(() {
                          _bQuery = '';

                          _bSearching = false;

                      }),

                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                borderSide: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.5)),
              ),
              enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                borderSide: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.5)),
              ),
              focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                borderSide: const BorderSide(color: plum, width: 1.3),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),

        // Was twelve category chips over five rows.
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18),
          child: _browseField(
            child: DropdownButtonHideUnderline(
              child: DropdownButton<String>(
                value: _browseCat,
                isExpanded: true,

                icon: const Icon(Icons.expand_more_rounded, color: gold),
                selectedItemBuilder: (BuildContext c) => kCategories
                    .map((Map<String, String> m) => Align(

                        child: Text(m['label']!,

                                fontSize: 15,

                style:  TextStyle(
