                items: kCategories
                    .map((Map<String, String> m) => DropdownMenuItem<String>(
                        value: m['slug'], child: Text(m['label']!)))
                    .toList(),
                onChanged: (String? v) =>
                    setState(() => _browseCat = v ?? _browseCat),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 10),
        // Was seven refine chips over three rows. Not a DropdownButton,
        // because four of these are independent toggles and a dropdown cannot
        // show a multiple selection honestly - so the field opens a sheet and
        // reads back whatever is on.
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18),
          child: _refineField(),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        Builder(
          builder: (BuildContext _) => _bQuery.length >= 2
              ? _browseSearchResults()
              : StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
                  stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance
                      .collection('vendors')
                      .where('metroId', isEqualTo: _browseMetro)
                      .where('categories', arrayContains: _browseCat)
                      .limit(60)
                      .snapshots(),
                  builder: (context, snap) {
                    if (snap.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {
                      return const Center(
                          child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: gold));
                    }
                    if (snap.hasError) {
                      return  Center(
                        child: Padding(
                          padding: EdgeInsets.all(24),
                          child: Text(
                              'Could not load vendors - try again shortly.',
                              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                              style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 13)),
                        ),
                      );
                    }
                    _ensureTopScored(_browseMetro, _browseCat);
                    final Set<String> seenIds = <String>{};
                    final docs = <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[
                      for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d
                          in <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[
                        ...(_topScored['$_browseMetro|$_browseCat'] ??
                            <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[]),
                        ...(snap.data?.docs ??
                            <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[]),
                      ])
                        if (seenIds.add(d.id)) d
                    ];
                    docs.sort((a, b) {
                      final sa = ((a.data()['score'] ?? 0) as num).toDouble();
                      final sb = ((b.data()['score'] ?? 0) as num).toDouble();
                      return sb.compareTo(sa);
                    });
                    final String priceLine = _priceTransparency(docs);
                    final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>
                        shown = docs
                            .where((d) => _passesBrowseFilters(d.data()))
                            .toList();
                    if (shown.isEmpty) {
                      return Center(
                        child: Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                          child: Text(
                              docs.isEmpty
                                  ? 'No vendors here yet \u2014 more metros soon.'
                                  : 'No matches for those filters \u2014 loosen one and more appear.',
                              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  color: Color(0xFFD9C7D6), fontSize: 13.5)),
                        ),
                      );
                    }
                    return Column(children: <Widget>[
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 8, 18, 0),
                        child: Text(_browseHeadline(shown.length),
                            style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 12,
                                color: ivory.withOpacity(.72),
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                      ),
                      if (priceLine.isNotEmpty)
                        Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 6, 18, 2),
                          child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                            const Icon(Icons.payments_rounded,
                                color: gold, size: 13),
                            const SizedBox(width: 5),
                            Expanded(
                              child: Text(priceLine,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 11.5,
                                      color: gold,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                            ),
                          ]),
                        ),
                      // Plain children, not a nested ListView: this whole
                      // screen is the scrollable now, and a scroll view inside
                      // a scroll view is what stops either one working.
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 8, 18, 0),
                        child: Column(
                            children: shown
                                .map(
                                    (QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>
                                            d) =>
                                        _vendorBrowseCard(d.data()))
                                .toList()),
                      ),
                    ]);
                  },
                ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  // The metro dropdown's shell, lifted out so the category and refine fields
  // are the same object and the three line up down the screen.
  Widget _browseField({required Widget child}) => Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 4),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: const Color(0xFF2E1530).withOpacity(.55),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.45)),
        ),
        child: child,
      );

  // What the refine field says when it is shut. Naming the one or two active
  // filters beats a count - 'Under $2k - Deals' tells you what you did, '2
  // filters' makes you open it to find out.
  List<String> get _activeRefinements => <String>[
        if (_fPrice == 1) 'Under \u00242k',
        if (_fPrice == 2) '\u00242\u20135k',
        if (_fPrice == 3) '\u00245k+',
        if (_fWoman) 'Woman-led',
        if (_fLgbtq) 'LGBTQ+ owned',
        if (_fDeals) 'Deals',
        if (_fTop) 'Top rated',
      ];

  Widget _refineField() {
    final List<String> on = _activeRefinements;
    final String label = on.isEmpty
        ? 'All vendors'
        : (on.length <= 2 ? on.join('  \u00b7  ') : '${on.length} filters');
    return _Press(
      scale: .985,
      dim: 1,
      tick: _Tick.select,
      tickOnDown: true,
      onTap: _refineSheet,
      child: _browseField(
        child: SizedBox(
          height: 48,
          child: Row(children: <Widget>[
            Icon(Icons.tune_rounded,
                color: _lzFg(on.isEmpty ? ivory.withOpacity(.75) : gold), size: 18),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            Expanded(
              child: Text(label,
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: TextStyle(
                      color: _lzFg(on.isEmpty ? ivory : gold),
                      fontSize: 15,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
            ),
            if (on.isNotEmpty)
              _Press(
                scale: .85,
                onTap: () => setState(() {
                  _fPrice = 0;
                  _fWoman = false;
                  _fLgbtq = false;
                  _fDeals = false;
                  _fTop = false;
                }),
                child: const Padding(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6),
                  child: Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: gold, size: 18),
                ),
              ),
            const Icon(Icons.expand_more_rounded, color: gold),
          ]),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // Budget is one-of-four, so chips. The other four are independent, so the
  // same green switches used everywhere else in the app.
  Future<void> _refineSheet() async {
    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) {
          void set(VoidCallback f) {
            setD(f);
            setState(() {});
          }

          Widget toggle(
                  String label, String why, bool v, ValueChanged<bool> f) =>
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 2),
                child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          Text(label,
                              style:  TextStyle(
                                  color: _lzFg(ink),
                                  fontSize: 14,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                          Text(why,
                              style:  TextStyle(
                                  color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 11.5)),
                        ]),
                  ),
                  _lazoSwitch(
                      value: v, onChanged: _hb((bool b) => set(() => f(b)))),
                ]),
              );

          return SafeArea(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 18, 22, 22),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Row(children: <Widget>[
                    Expanded(
                        child: Text('Narrow it down', style: _serif(size: 24))),
                    if (_activeRefinements.isNotEmpty)
                      TextButton(
                        onPressed: _h(() => set(() {
                              _fPrice = 0;
                              _fWoman = false;
                              _fLgbtq = false;
                              _fDeals = false;
                              _fTop = false;
                            })),
                        child:  Text('Clear',
                            style: TextStyle(
                                color: _lzFg(plum), fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                      ),
                    IconButton(
                        icon:  Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: _lzFg(muted)),
                        onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx2))),
                  ]),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text('BUDGET',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: _lzFg(plum.withOpacity(.7)),
                          fontSize: 10,
                          letterSpacing: 2,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: <Widget>[
                    for (final List<dynamic> o in <List<dynamic>>[
                      <dynamic>[0, 'Any budget'],
                      <dynamic>[1, 'Under \u00242k'],
                      <dynamic>[2, '\u00242\u20135k'],
                      <dynamic>[3, '\u00245k+'],
                    ])
                      ChoiceChip(
                        label: Text(o[1] as String,
                            style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 12.5,
                                color: _lzFg(_fPrice == o[0] ? ivory : plum),
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                        selected: _fPrice == o[0],
                        showCheckmark: false,

                        backgroundColor: _lzBg(Colors.white),
                        side: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
                        onSelected:
                            _hb((_) => set(() => _fPrice = o[0] as int)),
                      ),
                  ]),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  Text('THE BUSINESS',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: _lzFg(plum.withOpacity(.7)),
                          fontSize: 10,
                          letterSpacing: 2,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  toggle('Woman-led', 'Owned or led by a woman', _fWoman,

                  toggle('LGBTQ+ owned', 'Owned by an LGBTQ+ person', _fLgbtq,

                  toggle('Deals', 'Has an offer on right now', _fDeals,

                  toggle('Top rated', 'Strongest verified reviews', _fTop,

                    width: double.infinity,
                    child: FilledButton(
                      style: FilledButton.styleFrom(

                          elevation: 0,
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 13)),

                          style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    ),

                ],
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _monogram(String name,
      {required bool claimed, required bool verified}) {
    final List<String> words = name
        .trim()
        .split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
        .where((String w) => w.isNotEmpty)
        .toList();
    String initials = '';
    for (final String w in words) {
      final String ch = w[0].toUpperCase();
      if (RegExp(r'[A-Z0-9]').hasMatch(ch)) {
        initials += ch;
      }
      if (initials.length == 2) {
        break;
      }
    }
    if (initials.isEmpty) {
      initials = 'L';
    }
    // gentle per-vendor hue shift so the list breathes
    final int seed = name.codeUnits.fold(0, (int a, int b) => a + b);
    final List<List<Color>> pool = <List<Color>>[
      <Color>[const Color(0xFF3D1C3B), const Color(0xFF5C2A58)],
      <Color>[const Color(0xFF2E1530), const Color(0xFF6A3A66)],
      <Color>[const Color(0xFF4A2147), const Color(0xFF7D4577)],
      <Color>[const Color(0xFF35183A), const Color(0xFF59315E)],
    ];
    final List<Color> g = pool[seed % pool.length];
    return Stack(children: <Widget>[
      Container(
        width: 46,
        height: 46,
        alignment: Alignment.center,
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          shape: BoxShape.circle,
          gradient: LinearGradient(
              begin: Alignment.topLeft, end: Alignment.bottomRight, colors: g),
          border: Border.all(
              color: _lzLine(gold.withOpacity(claimed ? .85 : .45)),
              width: claimed ? 1.5 : 1),
        ),
        child: Text(initials,
            style: const TextStyle(
                color: Color(0xFFE8CFA0),
                fontSize: 15,
                letterSpacing: 1,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
      ),
      if (verified)
        Positioned(
          right: 0,
          bottom: 0,
          child: Container(
            width: 15,
            height: 15,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: vGreen,
              shape: BoxShape.circle,
              border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(ivory), width: 1.4),
            ),
            child:
                const Icon(Icons.check_rounded, color: Colors.white, size: 9),
          ),
        ),
    ]);
  }

  num? _startingPriceOf(Map<String, dynamic> v) {
    final String raw = (v['startingPrice'] ?? '').toString();
    final RegExpMatch? m = RegExp(r'([0-9][0-9,]{2,})').firstMatch(raw);
    if (m == null) {
      return null;
    }
    return num.tryParse(m.group(1)!.replaceAll(',', ''));
  }

  bool _passesBrowseFilters(Map<String, dynamic> v) {
    if (_fPrice != 0) {
      final num? p = _startingPriceOf(v);
      if (p == null) {
        return false;
      }
      if (_fPrice == 1 && p >= 2000) {
        return false;
      }
      if (_fPrice == 2 && (p < 2000 || p > 5000)) {
        return false;
      }
      if (_fPrice == 3 && p < 5000) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    if (_fWoman && (v['leadGender'] ?? '') != 'female') {
      return false;
    }
    if (_fLgbtq && v['lgbtqOwned'] != true) {
      return false;
    }
    if (_fTop && (((v['rating'] ?? 0) as num) < 4.7)) {
      return false;
    }
    if (_fDeals && !_hasDeal(v)) {
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  bool _hasDeal(Map<String, dynamic> v) {
    final Map<String, dynamic> ann = v['announcement'] is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(v['announcement'] as Map)
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    return (ann['title'] ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty;
  }

  String _priceTransparency(
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs) {
    final List<num> prices = <num>[];
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
      final num? p = _startingPriceOf(d.data());
      if (p != null && p > 100) {
        prices.add(p);
      }
    }
    if (prices.length < 5) {
      return '';
    }
    prices.sort();
    final num lo = prices[(prices.length * 0.25).floor()];
    final num hi =
        prices[(prices.length * 0.75).floor().clamp(0, prices.length - 1)];
    String metroLabel = _browseMetro;
    for (final Map<String, String> m in kMetros) {
      if (m['id'] == _browseMetro) {
        metroLabel = m['label']!.split(',').first;
      }
    }
    String catLabel = _browseCat.replaceAll('wedding-', '');
    for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
      if (c['slug'] == _browseCat) {
        catLabel = c['label']!.toLowerCase();
      }
    }
    String fmt(num v) =>
        '\$${v.round().toString().replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r'(\d)(?=(\d{3})+$)'), (Match m) => '${m[1]},')}';
    return '$metroLabel ${catLabel}s typically start ${fmt(lo)}\u2013${fmt(hi)} \u00b7 real listed prices, not ads';
  }

  Future<void> _runBrowseSearch() async {
    final String raw = _vSearchC.text.trim();
    if (raw.length < 2) {
      setState(() {
        _bQuery = '';
        _bSearching = false;
        _bResults = [];
      });
      return;
    }
    final int token = _bToken + 1;
    _bToken = token;
    final String q = _tc(raw);
    setState(() {
      _bQuery = raw;
      _bSearching = true;
    });
    try {
      final snap = await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('vendors')
          .orderBy('name')
          .startAt([q])
          .endAt(['$q\uf8ff'])
          .limit(60)
          .get();
      if (!mounted || token != _bToken) return;
      final List<Map<String, dynamic>> inMetro = [];
      for (final d in snap.docs) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> v = d.data();
        if (v['metroId'] == _browseMetro) inMetro.add(v);
      }
      setState(() {
        _bResults = inMetro;
        _bSearching = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted || token != _bToken) return;
      setState(() {
        _bSearching = false;
        _bResults = [];
      });
      debugPrint('LAZO browse search error: $e');
    }
  }

  Widget _browseSearchResults() {
    if (_bSearching) {
      return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: gold));
    }
    if (_bResults.isEmpty) {
      return Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
          child: Text(
            'No vendors named \u201c$_bQuery\u201d in this metro.\nCheck spelling or switch metros above.',
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 13),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
    // shrinkWrap + NeverScrollable: _browseScreen is the scrollable now, and
    // a ListView inside a ListView has no height to lay out against.
    return ListView.builder(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 8, 18, 24),
      shrinkWrap: true,
      physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
      itemCount: _bResults.length,
      itemBuilder: (context, i) => _vendorBrowseCard(_bResults[i]),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _markHired(Map<String, dynamic> v) async {
    final String vendorName = (v['name'] as String?) ?? 'This vendor';
    final cats = List<String>.from((v['categories'] as List?) ?? const []);
    String slug = _browseCat;
    for (final c in kCategories) {
      if (cats.contains(c['slug'])) {
        slug = c['slug']!;
        break;
      }
    }
    String label = slug;
    for (final c in kCategories) {
      if (c['slug'] == slug) label = c['label']!;
    }
    await _planRef.doc(slug).set({
      'status': 'booked',
      'vendorName': vendorName,
      'vendorId': (v['placeId'] as String?),
      'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    _celebrate();
    _bookedShareSnack('$vendorName is booked \u{1F389}',
        'Just booked our $label \u2014 $vendorName! \u{1F389}');
  }

  // ---------------- v132: BROWSE CARDS - the work first ----------------
  // A photo tile (the cover, else the first gallery shot, else the logo on an
  // ivory plate; a monogram only when there is nothing), the name in the
  // serif, category and town, the Lazo Score with its review count or an
  // honest "New to Lazo", the real starting price, earned badges, and two
  // lines of the vendor in their own words. Save is one tap, on the card.

  String _localityOf(String address) {
    final List<String> parts = address
        .replaceAll(', USA', '')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r' \d{5}(-\d{4})?'), '')
        .split(',')
        .map((String s) => s.trim())
        .where((String s) => s.isNotEmpty)
        .toList();
    if (parts.isEmpty) return '';
    if (parts.length == 1) return parts.first;
    return '${parts[parts.length - 2]}, ${parts.last}';
  }

  String _browseHeadline(int n) {
    String metroLabel = _browseMetro;
    for (final Map<String, String> m in kMetros) {
      if (m['id'] == _browseMetro) metroLabel = m['label']!.split(',').first;
    }
    String catLabel = _browseCat.replaceAll('wedding-', '');
    for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
      if (c['slug'] == _browseCat) catLabel = c['label']!.toLowerCase();
    }
    final String plural = n == 1 ? catLabel : '${catLabel}s';
    return '$n $plural in $metroLabel \u00b7 ranked by verified reviews, never by who paid';
  }

  Widget _vendorThumb(Map<String, dynamic> v, double size,
      {required bool claimed, required bool verified}) {
    final String name = (v['name'] as String?) ?? 'Vendor';
    String url = (v['coverUrl'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (url.isEmpty &&
        v['gallery'] is List &&
        (v['gallery'] as List).isNotEmpty) {
      url = (v['gallery'] as List).first.toString().trim();
    }
    final bool isLogo = url.isEmpty;
    if (url.isEmpty) url = (v['logoUrl'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    Widget fallback() => Container(
          width: size,
          height: size,
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
            gradient: const LinearGradient(
                begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                colors: <Color>[Color(0xFF3D1C3B), Color(0xFF52284F)]),
          ),
          child: _monogram(name, claimed: claimed, verified: verified),
        );
    if (!url.startsWith('http')) return fallback();
    final int px = (size * 2.5).round();
    final String small =
        'https://wsrv.nl/?url=${Uri.encodeComponent(url)}&w=$px&h=$px&fit=${isLogo ? 'contain' : 'cover'}&output=webp&q=78';
    Widget img(String src, Widget Function() onErr) => Image.network(
          src,
          width: size,
          height: size,
          fit: isLogo ? BoxFit.contain : BoxFit.cover,
          errorBuilder: (BuildContext c, Object e, StackTrace? s) => onErr(),
          frameBuilder: (BuildContext c, Widget child, int? frame, bool sync) =>
              AnimatedOpacity(
                  opacity: frame == null ? 0 : 1,
                  duration: Duration(
                      milliseconds: sync || _reducedMotion(context) ? 0 : 280),
                  curve: Curves.easeOut,
                  child: child),
        );
    return ClipRRect(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
      child: Container(
        width: size,
        height: size,
        color: _lzBg(isLogo ? ivory : plumDeep),
        padding: isLogo ? const EdgeInsets.all(8) : EdgeInsets.zero,
        child: img(small, () => img(url, fallback)),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _browsePill(String text, {bool gilded = false, IconData? icon}) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3.5),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: _lzBg(gilded ? gold : Colors.transparent),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
        border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(gilded ? gold : gold.withOpacity(.6))),
      ),
      child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
        if (icon != null) ...<Widget>[
          Icon(icon, size: 11, color: _lzFg(gilded ? plumDeep : plum)),
          const SizedBox(width: 3),
        ],
        Text(text,
            style: TextStyle(
                color: _lzFg(gilded ? plumDeep : plum),
                fontSize: 10.5,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                letterSpacing: .2)),
      ]),
    );
  }

  Widget _vendorBrowseCard(Map<String, dynamic> v) {
    final String name = (v['name'] as String?) ?? 'Vendor';
    final String address = (v['address'] as String?) ?? '';
    final int reviewCount = ((v['reviewCount'] ?? 0) as num).toInt();
    final int score = ((v['score'] ?? 0) as num).toInt();
    final bool verified = (v['verified'] as bool?) ?? false;
    final bool claimed = ((v['claimedBy'] ?? '') as String? ?? '').isNotEmpty;
    final double rating = ((v['rating'] ?? 0) as num).toDouble();
    final num? fromPrice = _startingPriceOf(v);
    final String locality = _localityOf(address);
    final List<String> cats =
        List<String>.from((v['categories'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[]);
    String catLabel = '';
    for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
      if (cats.contains(c['slug'])) {
        catLabel = c['label']!;
        break;
      }
    }
    final String bio =
        ((v['bio'] ?? v['intro'] ?? '') as Object).toString().trim();
    final List<String> badges = <String>[
      for (final dynamic b in (v['badges'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[])
        b.toString()
    ];
    final bool wide = MediaQuery.of(context).size.width >= 700;
    final double thumb = wide ? 112 : 86;
    final String pid = (v['placeId'] ?? '').toString();

    final List<Widget> sub = <Widget>[];
    if (catLabel.isNotEmpty) sub.add(Text(catLabel));
    if (locality.isNotEmpty) sub.add(Text(locality));

    Widget scoreRow() {
      if (reviewCount > 0) {
        return Row(children: <Widget>[
          const Icon(Icons.star_rounded, color: Color(0xFFC9A45C), size: 15),
          const SizedBox(width: 3),
          Text('$score',
              style:  TextStyle(
                  color: _lzFg(plum), fontSize: 13.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
          const SizedBox(width: 5),
          Flexible(
            child: Text(
                'Lazo Score \u00b7 $reviewCount verified review${reviewCount == 1 ? '' : 's'}',
                maxLines: 1,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 12)),
          ),
        ]);
      }
      if (rating > 0) {
        return Row(children: <Widget>[
          const Icon(Icons.star_rounded, color: Color(0xFFC9A45C), size: 15),
          const SizedBox(width: 3),
          Text(rating.toStringAsFixed(1),
              style:  TextStyle(
                  color: _lzFg(Color(0xFF8A6A2F)),
                  fontSize: 13,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
          const SizedBox(width: 6),
           Text('\u00b7 New to Lazo',
              style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 12)),
        ]);
      }
      return  Text('New to Lazo',
          style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 12));
    }

    final List<Widget> tags = <Widget>[];
    if (fromPrice != null) {
      tags.add(Text('From ${_money(fromPrice)}',
          style:  TextStyle(
              color: _lzFg(Color(0xFF8A6A2F)),
              fontSize: 13,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)));
    }
    if (verified) {
      tags.add(_browsePill('Lazo verified',
          gilded: true, icon: Icons.check_rounded));
    }
    if (_hasDeal(v)) tags.add(_browsePill('Offer', gilded: true));
    if (badges.contains('quick_responder')) {
      tags.add(_browsePill('Quick responder', icon: Icons.bolt_rounded));
    }
    if (badges.contains('popular')) tags.add(_browsePill('Popular this week'));

    return _Press(
      scale: .985,
      dim: .92,
      onTap: () => _vendorSheet(v),
      child: Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
        padding: EdgeInsets.all(wide ? 14 : 12),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: _lzBg(cardBg),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
          border: Border.all(
              color: _lzLine(gold.withOpacity(claimed ? .8 : .5)),
              width: claimed ? 1.3 : 1),
          boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[
            BoxShadow(
                color: Colors.black.withOpacity(.06),
                blurRadius: 2,
                offset: const Offset(0, 1)),
            BoxShadow(
                color: Colors.black.withOpacity(.22),
                blurRadius: 26,
                offset: const Offset(0, 12)),
          ],
        ),
        child: Row(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: <Widget>[
            _vendorThumb(v, thumb, claimed: claimed, verified: verified),
            const SizedBox(width: 14),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Text(name,
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: _serif(
                          size: wide ? 22 : 20,
                          color: _lzFg(plumDeep),
                          weight: FontWeight.w600,
                          height: 1.1)),
                  if (sub.isNotEmpty)
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 2),
                      child: DefaultTextStyle(
                        style:  TextStyle(
                            color: _lzFg(muted),
                            fontSize: 12.5,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
                        child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                          for (int i = 0; i < sub.length; i++) ...<Widget>[
                            if (i > 0)
                              const Padding(
                                padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 5),
                                child: Text('\u00b7'),

                        ]),

                  Padding(

                  if (tags.isNotEmpty)

                          child: const Text('Edit'),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 10),
                      OutlinedButton(

                            foregroundColor: _lzFg(plum),
                            side: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.8)),
                            padding:
                                const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12)),
                        onPressed: _h(() => _siteLiveShareSheet(
                            (w['names'] ?? '') as String, slug)),
                        child: const Icon(Icons.ios_share_rounded, size: 17),
                      ),
                    ]),
                    const SizedBox(height: 10),
                    SizedBox(
                      width: double.infinity,
                      child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                            foregroundColor: _lzFg(plum),
                            side: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.8))),
                        onPressed: _h(() => _chaptersSheet(slug)),
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.auto_stories_rounded, size: 16),
                        label: const Text(
                            'Chapters \u2014 honeymoon, news, milestones'),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              _guestPhotosCard(slug, w),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              _liveLinksCard(slug, w),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
               Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.only(left: 6, bottom: 8),
                child: Text('RSVPs waiting to import',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: _lzFg(plum),
                        fontSize: 15.5,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
              ),
              StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
                stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance
                    .collection('weddingSites')
                    .doc(slug)
                    .collection('rsvps')
                    .snapshots(),
                builder: (BuildContext c2,
                    AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> rs) {
                  final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
                      rs.data?.docs ??
                          <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
                  if (docs.isEmpty) {
                    return _glass(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                      radius: 18,
                      tint: .55,
                      borderColor: gold.withOpacity(.4),
                      child:  Text(
                          'No new RSVPs - when guests respond on your site, they land here for one-tap import into your guest list.',
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                    );
                  }
                  final List<String> _songs = docs
                      .map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
                          (d.data()['song'] ?? '').toString().trim())
                      .where((String s) => s.isNotEmpty)
                      .toList();
                  return Column(
                    children: <Widget>[
                      if (_songs.isNotEmpty)
                        Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                          child: _glass(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
                            radius: 16,
                            tint: .6,
                            borderColor: gold.withOpacity(.5),
                            child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                               Icon(Icons.queue_music_rounded,
                                  color: _lzFg(plum), size: 18),
                              const SizedBox(width: 8),
                              Expanded(
                                child: Text(
                                    '${_songs.length} song request${_songs.length == 1 ? '' : 's'} from your guests',
                                    style:  TextStyle(
                                        color: _lzFg(plum),
                                        fontSize: 12.5,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                              ),
                              TextButton(
                                onPressed: _h(() async {
                                  await Clipboard.setData(
                                      ClipboardData(text: _songs.join('\n')));
                                  _toastC(
                                      'Playlist copied \u2014 paste it to your DJ \u2713');
                                }),
                                child:  Text('Copy playlist',
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                        color: _lzFg(plum),
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                        fontSize: 12)),
                              ),
                            ]),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ...docs
                          .map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
                        final Map<String, dynamic> r = d.data();
                        final bool yes = (r['attending'] ?? 'yes') == 'yes';
                        return Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                          child: _glass(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
                            radius: 16,
                            tint: .6,
                            borderColor: _lzLine((yes ? vGreen : muted).withOpacity(.5)),
                            child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                              Icon(
                                  yes
                                      ? Icons.favorite_rounded
                                      : Icons.sentiment_dissatisfied_rounded,
                                  color: _lzFg(yes ? vGreen : muted),
                                  size: 20),
                              const SizedBox(width: 10),
                              Expanded(
                                child: Column(
                                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                  children: <Widget>[
                                    Text((r['name'] ?? '') as String,
                                        style:  TextStyle(
                                            color: _lzFg(plum),
                                            fontSize: 14,
                                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                                    Text(
                                        <String>[
                                          yes ? 'Attending' : 'Declined',
                                          if ((r['song'] ?? '')
                                              .toString()
                                              .isNotEmpty)
                                            '\u266B ${r['song']}',
                                          if (((r['plusOnes'] ?? 0) as num)
                                                  .toInt() >
                                              0)
                                            '+${r['plusOnes']}',
                                          if ((r['meal'] ?? '')
                                              .toString()
                                              .isNotEmpty)
                                            (r['meal'] as String),
                                        ].join(' \u00b7 '),
                                        style:  TextStyle(
                                            fontSize: 11.5, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ),
                              TextButton(
                                onPressed: _h(() => _importRsvp(slug, d.id, r)),
                                child:  Text('Import',
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                        color: _lzFg(plum),
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                        fontSize: 12.5)),
                              ),
                            ]),
                          ),
                        );
                      }).toList(),
                    ],
                  );
                },
              ),
            ],
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> _editWebsite(Map<String, dynamic> couple,
      QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? doc, String defNames) async {
    // v98: an imported site (Switching from another planning site) lands as
    // couple.siteDraft until the couple saves it here for the first time.
    final Map<String, dynamic> w = doc?.data() ??
        (couple['siteDraft'] is Map
            ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(couple['siteDraft'] as Map)
            : <String, dynamic>{});
    final String _joined = ((w['names'] ?? defNames) as String).trim();
    final List<String> _parts =
        _joined.split(RegExp(r'\s*(?:&|\+|and)\s*', caseSensitive: false));
    final TextEditingController name1C =
        TextEditingController(text: _parts.isNotEmpty ? _parts[0].trim() : '');
    final TextEditingController name2C = TextEditingController(
        text: _parts.length > 1 ? _parts.sublist(1).join(' & ').trim() : '');
    String joinedNames() {
      final String a = name1C.text.trim();
      final String b = name2C.text.trim();
      if (a.isEmpty) {
        return b;
      }
      if (b.isEmpty) {
        return a;
      }
      return '$a & $b';
    }

    final TextEditingController storyC =
        TextEditingController(text: (w['story'] ?? '') as String);
    // v134: things to do around the venue. The site finds them from the venue
    // address; these are the couple's own, and they show first.
    final TextEditingController nearbyNoteC =
        TextEditingController(text: (w['nearbyNote'] ?? '') as String);
    bool nearbyOn = w['nearbyOn'] != false;
    final List<TextEditingController> pickN = <TextEditingController>[];
    final List<TextEditingController> pickW = <TextEditingController>[];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      final List<dynamic> raw =
          (w['nearbyPicks'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[];
      final Map<String, dynamic> pk = (i < raw.length && raw[i] is Map)
          ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw[i] as Map)
          : <String, dynamic>{};
      pickN.add(TextEditingController(text: (pk['name'] ?? '').toString()));
      pickW.add(TextEditingController(text: (pk['note'] ?? '').toString()));
    }
    final TextEditingController venueC =
        TextEditingController(text: (w['venueName'] ?? '') as String);
    final TextEditingController addrC =
        TextEditingController(text: (w['venueAddress'] ?? '') as String);
    final TextEditingController cerC =
        TextEditingController(text: (w['ceremonyTime'] ?? '') as String);
    final TextEditingController recC =
        TextEditingController(text: (w['receptionTime'] ?? '') as String);
    final TextEditingController dressC =
        TextEditingController(text: (w['dressCode'] ?? '') as String);
    final TextEditingController hotelC =
        TextEditingController(text: (w['hotelBlock'] ?? '') as String);
    final TextEditingController transC =
        TextEditingController(text: (w['transport'] ?? '') as String);
    final TextEditingController parkC =
        TextEditingController(text: (w['parking'] ?? '') as String);
    final TextEditingController notesC =
        TextEditingController(text: (w['travelNotes'] ?? '') as String);
    final TextEditingController passC =
        TextEditingController(text: (w['passcode'] ?? '') as String);
    final TextEditingController cockC =
        TextEditingController(text: (w['cocktailTime'] ?? '') as String);
    final TextEditingController sendC =
        TextEditingController(text: (w['sendOffTime'] ?? '') as String);
    _siteGal = List<String>.from(
        (w['siteGallery'] as List?)?.map((dynamic e) => e.toString()) ??
            const <String>[]);
    // v136: where the couple put their photos, and the guests' wall
    _siteHero = _slotFrom(w['heroPhoto']);
    _siteStory = _slotFrom(w['storyPhoto']);
    _siteGalFocus = <Map<String, dynamic>>[
      for (final dynamic f in (w['siteGalleryFocus'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[])
        _slotFrom(f) ?? <String, dynamic>{'x': .5, 'y': .5, 'zoom': 1.0}
    ];
    bool guestOn = w['guestPhotosOn'] != false;
    final TextEditingController guestNoteC =
        TextEditingController(text: (w['guestPhotosNote'] ?? '').toString());
    // v137: the site, live
    bool timelineOn = w['timelineOn'] != false;
    bool seatingOn = w['seatingOn'] == true;
    bool translateOn = w['translateOn'] != false;
    final TextEditingController mealsC = TextEditingController(
        text: ((w['mealOptions'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[])
            .map((dynamic e) => e.toString())
            .join(', '));
    final TextEditingController galleryC =
        TextEditingController(text: (w['galleryUrl'] ?? '').toString());
    // v138: the hold, the hotel, the weekend
    bool guestHold = w['guestPhotosHold'] == true;
    final TextEditingController hotelAddrC =
        TextEditingController(text: (w['hotelAddress'] ?? '').toString());
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> events = <Map<String, dynamic>>[
      for (final dynamic e in (w['events'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[])
        if (e is Map) Map<String, dynamic>.from(e)
    ];
    // ---- SMART PREFILL: never ask what Lazo already knows ----
    if (venueC.text.trim().isEmpty) {
      try {
        final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> planSnap =
            await _coupleRef.collection('plan').doc('wedding-venues').get();
        if (planSnap.exists) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> plan = planSnap.data()!;
          final String vn = (plan['vendorName'] ?? '').toString().trim();
          if (vn.isNotEmpty) {
            venueC.text = vn;
            final String vid = (plan['vendorId'] ?? '').toString();
            if (vid.isNotEmpty && addrC.text.trim().isEmpty) {
              final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> ven =
                  await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                      .collection('vendors')
                      .doc(vid)
                      .get();
              final String va =
                  (ven.data()?['address'] ?? '').toString().trim();
              if (ven.exists && va.isNotEmpty) {
                addrC.text = va;
              }
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    if (cerC.text.trim().isEmpty ||
        cockC.text.trim().isEmpty ||
        recC.text.trim().isEmpty ||
        sendC.text.trim().isEmpty) {
      try {
        final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> evs =
            await _dayofRef.orderBy('time').get();
        String pretty(String hhmm) {
          final List<String> p = hhmm.split(':');
          if (p.length != 2) {
            return hhmm;
          }
          int h = int.tryParse(p[0]) ?? 0;
          final String ap = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
          h = h % 12 == 0 ? 12 : h % 12;
          return '$h:${p[1]} $ap';
        }

        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in evs.docs) {
          final String label =
              (d.data()['label'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
          final String tm = (d.data()['time'] ?? '').toString();
          if (tm.isEmpty) {
            continue;
          }
          if (cerC.text.trim().isEmpty && label.contains('ceremony')) {
            cerC.text = pretty(tm);
          } else if (cockC.text.trim().isEmpty && label.contains('cocktail')) {
            cockC.text = pretty(tm);
          } else if (recC.text.trim().isEmpty &&
              (label.contains('reception') || label.contains('dinner'))) {
            recC.text = pretty(tm);
          } else if (sendC.text.trim().isEmpty &&
              (label.contains('send') || label.contains('exit'))) {
            sendC.text = pretty(tm);
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    // v133: the couple's song - their first dance, picked on the Music page,
    // can play softly when guests open the site.
    Map<String, dynamic>? fd;
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> md =
          await _coupleRef.collection('music').doc('main').get();
      final dynamic mm = md.data()?['moments'];
      if (mm is Map && mm['firstDance'] is Map) {
        fd = Map<String, dynamic>.from(mm['firstDance'] as Map);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    bool songOn = w.containsKey('song')
        ? (w['song'] is Map && (w['song'] as Map)['autoplay'] != false)
        : true;
    String template = (w['template'] ??
        (_pendingTemplate.isNotEmpty ? _pendingTemplate : 'peony')) as String; // v142
    _pendingTemplate = '';
    const Map<String, String> legacyTpl = <String, String>{
      'classic': 'fete',
      'evening': 'noir',
      'garden': 'sage',
      'editorial': 'noir',
      'midnight': 'noir',
      'desert': 'dune',
    };
    template = legacyTpl[template] ?? template;
    if (!<String>[
      'sage',
      'noir',
      'dune',
      'fete',
      'tide',
      'flora',
      'atelier',
      'verona',
      'shore',
      'summit',
      'ranch',
      'starlit',
      'frost',
      'harvest',
      'aquarelle',
      'prism',
      'meadow',
      'gilded',
      'marigold',
      'papel',
      'peony'
    ].contains(template)) {
      template = 'peony'; // v142
    }
    const Map<String, List<List<dynamic>>> tplPals =
        <String, List<List<dynamic>>>{
      'noir': <List<dynamic>>[
        <dynamic>['midnight', 0xFFC9A45C, 0xFF0C0B09],
        <dynamic>['champagne', 0xFFE3C888, 0xFF14100B],
        <dynamic>['bordeaux', 0xFFC96F6F, 0xFF150A0D],
        <dynamic>['emerald', 0xFF7FB59A, 0xFF0A100D],
      ],
      'sage': <List<dynamic>>[
        <dynamic>['garden', 0xFF5B7553, 0xFFF6F8F2],
        <dynamic>['eucalyptus', 0xFF4E8073, 0xFFF3F7F6],
        <dynamic>['terracotta', 0xFFB0623C, 0xFFFAF5EF],
        <dynamic>['lavender', 0xFF7C6FA8, 0xFFF7F5FA],
      ],
      'dune': <List<dynamic>>[
        <dynamic>['golden', 0xFFC7622F, 0xFFF7EEE2],
        <dynamic>['dusk', 0xFF8A5FA0, 0xFFF4EFE9],
        <dynamic>['clay', 0xFFA6402C, 0xFFF6EAE2],
        <dynamic>['sandsky', 0xFF33739C, 0xFFF5F3EE],
      ],
      'fete': <List<dynamic>>[
        <dynamic>['navy', 0xFF8A6A2F, 0xFFFAF6F0],
        <dynamic>['blush', 0xFFA85D68, 0xFFFBF5F3],
        <dynamic>['forest', 0xFF4B6E52, 0xFFF7F8F4],
        <dynamic>['blacktie', 0xFF1C1C1E, 0xFFF6F5F3],
      ],
      'tide': <List<dynamic>>[
        <dynamic>['seaglass', 0xFF2E7C8F, 0xFFF7FAFB],
        <dynamic>['harbor', 0xFF1F5673, 0xFFF4F7F8],
        <dynamic>['coral', 0xFFD06A4F, 0xFFFBF6F3],
        <dynamic>['storm', 0xFF5B6B8C, 0xFFF3F4F6],
      ],
      'flora': <List<dynamic>>[
        <dynamic>['rose', 0xFFB4586B, 0xFFFBF6F4],
        <dynamic>['peony', 0xFFC4577E, 0xFFFCF4F6],

                                actions: <Widget>[

                                  FilledButton(
                                      style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                                          backgroundColor: rose,
                                          foregroundColor: ivory),
                                      onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dc, true),
                                      child: const Text('Discard')),

                            if (sure == true && ctx2.mounted) {
                              Navigator.pop(ctx2, false);

                          }),
                          child:  Text('Cancel',
                              style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink)))),
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      FilledButton(
                        style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: gold, foregroundColor: plum),
                        onPressed:
                            _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx2, true), _Tick.medium),
                        child: const Text('Publish'),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
    if (ok != true || joinedNames().isEmpty) {
      return;
    }
    setState(() => _webBusy = true);
    try {
      // v139: a new site takes the first free slug - two "Sarah & Mike"s
      // used to write over each other's page
      String slug = doc?.id ?? '';
      if (slug.isEmpty) {
        final String base = _slugFor(joinedNames());
        slug = base;
        for (int n = 2; n < 50; n++) {
          final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> ex =
              await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                  .collection('weddingSites')
                  .doc(slug)
                  .get();
          if (!ex.exists || ex.data()?['coupleUid'] == _cid) {
            break;
          }
          slug = '$base-$n';
        }
      }
      final Timestamp? ts = couple['weddingDate'] is Timestamp
          ? couple['weddingDate'] as Timestamp
          : null;
      final DateTime? wd = ts?.toDate();
      const List<String> months = <String>[
        'January',
        'February',
        'March',
        'April',
        'May',
        'June',
        'July',
        'August',
        'September',
        'October',
        'November',
        'December'
      ];
      final List<Map<String, dynamic>> regLinks =
          List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
              (couple['registryLinks'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[]);
      const Map<String, String> catLabels = <String, String>{
        'wedding-venues': 'Venue',
        'wedding-photographers': 'Photography',
        'wedding-videographers': 'Videography',
        'wedding-florists': 'Florals',
        'wedding-djs': 'Music',
        'wedding-bands': 'Music',
        'wedding-planners': 'Planning',
        'wedding-caterers': 'Catering',
        'wedding-bakeries': 'Cake',
        'wedding-hair-makeup': 'Hair & Makeup',
        'wedding-officiants': 'Officiant',
      };
      final List<Map<String, dynamic>> vendorTeam = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      try {
        final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> planQ =
            await _coupleRef.collection('plan').get();
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> p
            in planQ.docs) {
          final String vn = (p.data()['vendorName'] ?? '').toString().trim();
          if (vn.isEmpty) {
            continue;
          }
          String label = catLabels[p.id] ??
              p.id.replaceFirst('wedding-', '').replaceAll('-', ' ').trim();
          if (label.isNotEmpty) {
            label = label[0].toUpperCase() + label.substring(1);
          }
          // v137: the credit links to the vendor's Lazo page and carries the
          // id for a "Check your date" lead link
          final Map<String, dynamic> credit = <String, dynamic>{
            'category': label,
            'name': vn
          };
          final String vid = (p.data()['vendorId'] ?? '').toString();
          if (vid.isNotEmpty) {
            credit['vendorId'] = vid;
            try {
              final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> ven =
                  await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                      .collection('vendors')
                      .doc(vid)
                      .get();
              final String metro = (ven.data()?['metroId'] ?? '').toString();
              final String vslug = (ven.data()?['slug'] ?? '').toString();
              if (metro.isNotEmpty && vslug.isNotEmpty) {
                credit['url'] = 'https://meetlazo.com/$metro/${p.id}/$vslug/';
              }
            } catch (_) {}
          }
          vendorTeam.add(credit);
        }
      } catch (_) {}
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('weddingSites')
          .doc(slug)
          .set(<String, dynamic>{
        'coupleUid': _cid,
        'names': joinedNames(),
        'template': template,
        'palette': palette,
        'story': storyC.text.trim(),
        'venueName': venueC.text.trim(),
        'venueAddress': addrC.text.trim(),
        'ceremonyTime': cerC.text.trim(),
        'receptionTime': recC.text.trim(),
        'dressCode': dressC.text.trim(),
        'hotelBlock': hotelC.text.trim(),
        'transport': transC.text.trim(),
        'parking': parkC.text.trim(),
        'travelNotes': notesC.text.trim(),
        'cocktailTime': cockC.text.trim(),
        'sendOffTime': sendC.text.trim(),
        'siteGallery': _siteGal,
        'passcode': passC.text.trim(),
        'rsvpOpen': rsvpOpen,
        'coverUrl': (couple['photoUrl'] ?? '') as String,
        // v136: where the photos sit, and the guests' wall
        'coverFocus': _slotFrom(couple['photoFocus']) ?? FieldValue.delete(),
        'heroPhoto': _siteHero ?? FieldValue.delete(),
        'storyPhoto': _siteStory ?? FieldValue.delete(),
        'siteGalleryFocus': <Map<String, dynamic>>[
          for (int i = 0; i < _siteGal.length; i++)
            i < _siteGalFocus.length
                ? _siteGalFocus[i]
                : <String, dynamic>{'x': .5, 'y': .5, 'zoom': 1.0}
        ],
        'guestPhotosOn': guestOn,
        'guestPhotosNote': guestNoteC.text.trim(),
        'guestPhotosHold': guestHold,
        'hotelAddress': hotelAddrC.text.trim(),
        'events': events,
        // v137: the site, live
        'timelineOn': timelineOn,
        'timeline': await _guestTimeline(),
        'seatingOn': seatingOn,
        'translateOn': translateOn,
        'mealOptions': mealsC.text
            .split(',')
            .map((String e) => e.trim())
            .where((String e) => e.isNotEmpty)
            .take(8)
            .toList(),
        'galleryUrl': galleryC.text.trim().startsWith('https://')
            ? galleryC.text.trim()
            : '',
        'dateIso': wd == null
            ? ''
            : '${wd.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-${wd.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${wd.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}',
        'dateDisplay':
            wd == null ? '' : '${months[wd.month - 1]} ${wd.day}, ${wd.year}',
        'registryLinks': regLinks,
        'registryNote': (couple['registryNote'] ?? '').toString(),
        'vendorTeam': vendorTeam,
        'nearbyOn': nearbyOn,
        'nearbyNote': nearbyNoteC.text.trim(),
        'nearbyPicks': <Map<String, String>>[
          for (int i = 0; i < pickN.length; i++)
            if (pickN[i].text.trim().isNotEmpty)
              <String, String>{
                'name': pickN[i].text.trim(),
                'note': pickW[i].text.trim(),
              }
        ],
        'song':
            (songOn && fd != null && (fd['title'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty)
                ? <String, dynamic>{
                    'title': (fd['title'] ?? '').toString(),
                    'artist': (fd['artist'] ?? '').toString(),
                    'art': (fd['art'] ?? '').toString(),
                    'trackId': (fd['id'] ?? '').toString(),
                    'preview': (fd['preview'] ?? '').toString(),
                    'autoplay': true,
                  }
                : FieldValue.delete(),
        'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      // v137: the seating lookup and the DJ page read mirrored copies
      await _mirrorSeating(slug, seatingOn);
      await _mirrorPlaylist(slug);
      if (mounted) {
        _siteLiveShareSheet(joinedNames(), slug);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // v139: a rules rejection used to vanish behind try/finally
      _toastC('Couldn\u2019t publish \u2014 ${e.toString().length > 90 ? e.toString().substring(0, 90) : e}');
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _webBusy = false);
      }
    }
  }

  Widget _messagesScreen() {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
          .snapshots(),
      builder: (BuildContext context,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> snap) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
            <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[
          ...(snap.data?.docs ??
              <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[])
        ];
        docs.sort((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> a,
            QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> b) {
          // v139: latest activity first, not the day the inquiry was sent
          final Map<String, dynamic> ma = a.data(), mb = b.data();
          final dynamic ta =
              ma['lastMessageAt'] ?? ma['updatedAt'] ?? ma['createdAt'];
          final dynamic tb =
              mb['lastMessageAt'] ?? mb['updatedAt'] ?? mb['createdAt'];
          if (ta is Timestamp && tb is Timestamp) {
            return tb.compareTo(ta);
          }
          return 0;
        });
        // A blocked vendor leaves the inbox but the thread is never deleted -
        // it is the evidence if the couple later reports. It reappears in its
        // own collapsed section at the bottom, where blocking can be undone.
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> blockedDocs =
            docs
                .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
                    (d.data()['blockedByCouple'] ?? false) == true)
                .toList();
        docs.removeWhere((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
            (d.data()['blockedByCouple'] ?? false) == true);
        return ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 8, 18, 32),
          children: <Widget>[
            _subHeader('Messages'),
            if (docs.isEmpty)
              _glass(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                radius: 20,
                tint: .6,
                borderColor: gold.withOpacity(.5),
                child:  Column(children: <Widget>[
                  Icon(Icons.forum_rounded, color: _lzFg(plum), size: 30),
                  SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text('No conversations yet',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: _lzFg(plum),
                          fontSize: 15,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(
                      'When you inquire with a vendor, the conversation lives here - replies, questions, and booking updates in one place.',
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                ]),
              )
            else
              ...docs.map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
                final Map<String, dynamic> inq = d.data();
                final String vn = (inq['vendorName'] ?? 'Vendor') as String;
                final String st = (inq['status'] ?? 'new') as String;
                final bool replied = st == 'responded';
                final bool booked = st == 'booked';
                final bool lost = st == 'lost'; // v139
                final bool hello =
                    inq['hello'] == true && !booked && !lost && !replied;
                final Color sc = booked
                    ? vGreen
                    : lost
                        ? const Color(0xFF8A7D90)
                        : replied
                            ? plum
                            : const Color(0xFF8A6A2F);
                return Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
                  child: _Press(
                    scale: .985,
                    dim: .92,
                    onTap: () => _openCoupleThread(d.id, inq),
                    child: _glass(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(15),
                      radius: 18,
                      tint: .62,
                      borderColor: _lzLine((booked ? vGreen : gold).withOpacity(.55)),
                      child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                        Container(
                          width: 40,
                          height: 40,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            gradient: const LinearGradient(
                                colors: <Color>[plumDeep, plum]),
                            shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.7)),
                          ),
                          child: const Icon(Icons.storefront_rounded,
                              color: gold, size: 18),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 12),
                        Expanded(
                          child: Column(
                            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                            children: <Widget>[
                              Text(vn,
                                  maxLines: 1,
                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                  style:  TextStyle(
                                      color: _lzFg(plum),
                                      fontSize: 14.5,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                              Text(
                                  booked
                                      ? 'Booked \u00b7 tap to chat'
                                      : lost
                                          ? 'Went another direction'
                                          : hello
                                              ? 'Said hello \u00b7 tap to read'
                                              : replied
                                                  ? 'Replied - tap to read'
                                                  : 'Waiting on reply',
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 11.5,
                                      color: _lzFg(sc),
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                         Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded, color: _lzFg(muted)),
                      ]),
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              }),
            if (blockedDocs.isNotEmpty) _blockedSection(blockedDocs),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _contractReadyBanner(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    if (_uid == null) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }
    final List<dynamic> bannerDismissed =
        (couple['dismissedSignedBanners'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[];
    final List<dynamic> readyDismissed =
        (couple['dismissedReadyBanners'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[];
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
          .snapshots(),
      builder: (BuildContext context,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> snap) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> all =
            snap.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> ready = all
            .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
                (d.data()['contractStatus'] ?? '') == 'sent' &&
                !readyDismissed.contains(d.id))
            .toList();
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> qWaiting = all
            .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
                (d.data()['questionnaireStatus'] ?? '') == 'sent')
            .toList();
        QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? justSigned;
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in all) {
          if ((d.data()['contractStatus'] ?? '') != 'signed') {
            continue;
          }
          if (d.data()['signedBannerDismissed'] == true) {
            continue;
          }
          if (bannerDismissed.contains(d.id)) {
            continue;
          }
          final dynamic t = d.data()['contractUpdatedAt'];
          if (t is Timestamp &&
              DateTime.now().difference(t.toDate()).inHours < 48) {
            justSigned = d;
            break;
          }
        }
        if (ready.isEmpty && qWaiting.isEmpty && justSigned == null) {
          return const SizedBox.shrink();
        }
        if (ready.isEmpty && justSigned != null && qWaiting.isEmpty) {
          final String svn =
              (justSigned.data()['vendorName'] ?? 'Your vendor') as String;
          final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> js = justSigned;
          return GestureDetector(
            onTap: () => _openCoupleThread(js.id, js.data()),
            child: Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                gradient: const LinearGradient(
                    colors: <Color>[Color(0xFF2E8B6B), Color(0xFF3AA37E)]),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.75)),
              ),
              child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                const Icon(Icons.verified_rounded, color: gold, size: 30),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      const Text('Contract signed \u{1F389}',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: ivory,
                              fontSize: 15,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      Text('$svn is officially booked for your day.',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: ivory.withOpacity(.9), fontSize: 12)),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                _Press(
                  scale: .985,
                  dim: .92,
                  onTap: () {
                    _coupleRef.set(<String, dynamic>{
                      'dismissedSignedBanners':
                          FieldValue.arrayUnion(<String>[js.id]),
                    }, SetOptions(merge: true)).catchError((Object e) {
                      debugPrint('LAZO banner dismiss: ' + e.toString());
                      _toastC('Could not dismiss - try again.');
                    });
                  },
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(6),
                    child: Icon(Icons.close_rounded,
                        color: ivory.withOpacity(.85), size: 18),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 2),
                const Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded, color: ivory),
              ]),
            ),
          );
        }
        if (ready.isEmpty && qWaiting.isNotEmpty) {
          final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> qd = qWaiting.first;
          final String qvn =
              (qd.data()['vendorName'] ?? 'Your vendor') as String;
          return GestureDetector(
            onTap: () => _openCoupleThread(qd.id, qd.data()),
            child: Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                gradient: const LinearGradient(colors: <Color>[plumDeep, plum]),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.75)),
              ),
              child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                const Icon(Icons.fact_check_outlined, color: gold, size: 28),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      const Text('A questionnaire is waiting',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: ivory,
                              fontSize: 15,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      Text('$qvn wants details to plan your day perfectly.',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: ivory.withOpacity(.9), fontSize: 12)),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                const Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded, color: ivory),
              ]),
            ),
          );
        }
        final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> first = ready.first;
        final String vn =
            (first.data()['vendorName'] ?? 'Your vendor') as String;
        return GestureDetector(
          onTap: () => _openCoupleThread(first.id, first.data()),
          child: Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              gradient: const LinearGradient(
                  begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                  end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                  colors: <Color>[Color(0xFFD9B77C), Color(0xFFC9A45C)]),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
              border: Border.all(color: plum.withOpacity(.35)),
              boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[
                BoxShadow(
                    color: gold.withOpacity(.28),
                    blurRadius: 16,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 5)),
              ],
            ),
            child: Row(
              children: <Widget>[
                Container(
                  width: 42,
                  height: 42,
                  decoration:
                      const BoxDecoration(color: plum, shape: BoxShape.circle),
                  child: const Icon(Icons.draw_rounded, color: gold, size: 22),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      Text(
                          ready.length > 1
                              ? '${ready.length} contracts ready to sign'
                              : 'Your contract is ready to sign',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              color: plum,
                              fontSize: 15,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      Text(
                          ready.length > 1
                              ? 'Tap to review the first one from $vn.'
                              : '$vn sent your agreement - it takes about a minute.',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: plum.withOpacity(.85), fontSize: 12)),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                _Press(
                  scale: .985,
                  dim: .92,
                  onTap: () {
                    _coupleRef.set(<String, dynamic>{
                      'dismissedReadyBanners':
                          FieldValue.arrayUnion(<String>[first.id]),
                    }, SetOptions(merge: true)).catchError((Object e) {
                      debugPrint('LAZO ready dismiss: ' + e.toString());
                      _toastC('Could not dismiss - try again.');
                    });
                  },
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(6),
                    child: Icon(Icons.close_rounded,
                        color: plum.withOpacity(.7), size: 18),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 2),
                const Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded, color: plum),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Timer? _presenceTimer;
  // v66: chime, tab badge, card payments
  bool _chimeMuted = false;
  bool _chimeArmed = false;
  int _chimeLastMs = 0;
  int _cUnread = 0;
